title: Tearing crepe papers
description:
To foster the children's fine motor development, the teacher invited the children to tear various coloured crepe papers into smaller pieces, which will be used for future artwork activities. The children were intrigued by how they could tear, crumpled, and explored with the crepe papers.

Tearing papers might seem like child's play, but it is a vital fine motor skill that lays a foundation for numerous activities throughout life. As the children master this seemingly simple task, they are beginning to develop their grip strength and hand-eye coordination. Well done, PGs!

title: More than just a self portrait
description:
Today, the children were invited to create self-portraits for their black drawing books. This activity aims to help them identify their facial feature and foster a sense of identity.

Before diving into their drawings, we encouraged the children to observe their facial features, recognizing their shapes and functions. This brings awareness of the task.

As the drawing session progressed, many children approached me with questions like, “Is this okay? Is my face okay?” I redirected their inquiries, reassuring them that if this is how they perceive their face, then it is absolutely good enough.

Today’s learning experience is to remind our children that when it comes to creative expression, there are no right or wrong answers. Every interpretation is valid.

title: Pompom push!
description:
In developing the children's math concepts, the teacher introduced a matching activity where they were invited to push the pompom balls into the holes of the egg carton according to the colours (red/blue). 

Throughout the activity, some of the children enjoyed pushing the pompom balls in, while some simply loved to balance the balls on top. Moreover, the children were also very intrigued by where the ball went and also putting their finger in through the holes for sensory experience. As teachers, we encouraged the children to explore and engage in the play activity based on their preference. As this is a new activity for the children, they are beginning to learn about the foundational concept of matching as well as identifying colours. Great job, PGs!

title: December Week 5: Our Pet 'Rory' the terrapin
description:
Learning Objective: Foster curiosity and exploration.

Aurora "Rory," the terrapin, was introduced to the children as our class pet. The children were excited to meet her, and we took the opportunity to teach them how to properly care for Rory. This included explaining how to feed her, change her water, and take her for walks during outdoor playtime.

The children were thrilled to learn about Rory’s needs and enjoyed watching her during feeding time. Observing Rory as she interacted with her food sparked curiosity and wonder. They noticed how she slowly and carefully approached her meals.

The following day, the children were filled with excitement as they watched Rory walking and running around. It was a delightful sight to see her moving energetically, and the children couldn't contain their enthusiasm. They gathered around her, eagerly observing her swift movements and noticing how she explored her environment with curiosity.

This activity was conducted from the 30th December 2024 - 03rd January 2025

title: December Week 5 Weekly Highlight
description: Studies show that nursery rhymes, while sometimes outdated, help with building memory, vocabulary, numeracy, and speaking skills. Nursery rhymes are a powerful learning source in early literacy and enable children to become interested in the rhythm and patterns of language. The repetitive nature of rhymes guide children in recognising patterns and sounds, building a strong foundation for reading and writing. As children sing along, they also learn to associate words with their meanings, enhancing their comprehension skills too. This week, the children had the opportunity to engage in a nursery rhyme sequencing activity- As the teacher sang, the children searched for the correct pictures, carefully placing them in order to sequence the rhyme. It was a fun and interactive way for them to connect the sounds of the words to visual images, helping them better understand the flow and rhythm of the rhyme.

title: 绘本分享《这是谁的》
description: 老师和小朋友们一起分享绘本《这是谁的》，小朋友们认真的围坐在老师身边，眼神专注，安静地聆听着老师的讲述。老师轻轻翻开第一页，书中的清晰插图和生动文字引起了孩子们的好奇。随着故事的发展，孩子们渐渐记住了大毛熊的经典台词：“这是我的！”每当老师念到“这是……”他们都会跟着老师一起喊：“这是我的！”随着故事情节的推进，小朋友们看到大毛熊因为不愿分享而失去了朋友，大家纷纷表达自己的想法：“要分享”、“share”、“要爱朋友”……小朋友们积极参与，分享着自己对友谊与分享的理解。当故事的最后，大毛熊认识到自己错误并重新与朋友们建立友谊时，孩子们脸上露出了满足和开心的笑容。看到动物们在一起快乐地游戏，小朋友们也仿佛感受到了一份温暖的友谊。通过这本绘本，孩子们不仅领略了精彩的故事情节，还在潜移默化中学到了如何与人分享，如何珍惜友谊。

title: 合作运水果

description: 新年快乐！新年的第一次动态分享祝福大家开心快乐，健康顺遂！随着新年的开始，很多假期中的小伙伴也回到了学校中，我们也迎来了一位新的朋友缘俽，所以在一月，我们会将以学校的玩具为线索，带领幼儿熟悉新环境，帮助幼儿与新朋友和老师建立关系，本周我们阅读了绘本《小企鹅乔比》，通过这本互动故事，让孩子们感受不同的质感，孩子们也尝试在身边寻找这种不同的质感，软软的小猫，滑滑的玻璃，粗糙的篮子等等，在游乐场，我们利用呼啦圈和沙包进行了好玩的丢沙包游戏，促进幼儿大肌肉的发展，我们还发现在之前的户外活动中带回来的巨大的椰子花朵外表发生了变化，表面发生了开裂，有原来光滑的质感也变成了粗糙的质感，孩子们将这个发现分享给了老师，我们共同用放大镜观察这些变化，带领幼儿发现更多好玩的视角。

title: Scribbling with oil pastel
description: Scribbling with oil pastels offers several important benefits for young children. First, it enhances fine motor skills by strengthening hand muscles and improving grip, which is essential for tasks like writing and using utensils. Second, it helps develop hand-eye coordination, as children learn to control their movements while creating on the paper. Finally, the activity fosters creativity and self-expression, allowing children to explore colours, and lines, which supports cognitive development and boosts confidence!

title: 🎉 Happy Birthday, Mabell! 🎂
description: We celebrated Mabell turning 3 with laughter, love, and lots of fun! Here’s to another year of growth and adventure! 🎈

title: Sticky Tape Popsicle Sticks
description: The children are actively engaging with popsicle sticks and sticky tape, experimenting with various ways to manipulate the materials. They are seen lifting the sticks, using their pincer fingers to peel the tape off, and repositioning it onto different sticks. Through this hands-on exploration, the children are fostering fine motor skills, enhancing their hand-eye coordination, and learning about cause-and-effect relationships. They are also practicing problem-solving as they figure out how to attach and detach the tape. Additionally, this activity promotes independence, fostering their ability to explore and experiment freely with objects in their environment.

title: Outdoor fun and play! 🥰
description: It's only the start of the year, and already we’re seeing remarkable growth in our physical abilities. Every day, we're running faster and more steadily! In fact, now that we're bigger, we need a larger, open area to fully stretch our legs and run freely. 🤭 This is also the perfect time for Mummy and Daddy to take us to playgrounds where we can practice climbing, balance, and stability, helping us continue to develop our coordination, strength, and confidence. Playground play also supports social skills, encourages problem-solving, and boosts our overall well-being as we engage in fun, active exploration. 🥰

title: Working together to keep our mattresses!
description: We've been practicing packing away our own mattresses and sleeping bags into the cupboard after our afternoon rest. At first, the teachers would help us with the packing, but they soon noticed that we were eager to take part in the process. 😄We began showing interest in bringing the mattresses to the cupboard and placing them inside ourselves. Encouraged by this, our teachers guided us to work together to carry the mattresses and carefully place them in the cupboard. This process not only teaches us to collaborate but also helps us develop problem-solving skills as we figure out how to fit the mattresses just right. Who knows? Maybe next, we’ll try setting up our mattresses before nap time, too! 😜

title: Fireworks to Celebrate 2025! 🥳
description:
Happy New Year, Everyone!! We’re excited for a wonderful, adventurous, and fruitful 2025 ahead! As we returned to school on the 2nd of January, we eagerly shared our New Year’s Eve and New Year’s Day experiences. One of the highlights mentioned was watching the fireworks light up the night sky. Inspired by this, we decided to create an artwork based on those beautiful fireworks.

Our project is made up of three parts. The first part, which we’ve already completed, involved pasting pieces of string soaked in a mixture of glue and water onto our paper. The arrangement of the string is meant to represent the bursting of colourful fireworks in the sky. At first, most of us needed some encouragement to fish the string out of the gluey mixture, but once we got started, it became a fun and messy adventure! After placing the string onto our paper, we left our pieces to dry, ready to continue with the second and third parts later on.

title: Things We Do as a Family
description:
As part of our Term 1 topic, the children are learning about "Things We Do as a Family." We started by reading a book titled "Kevin and His Dad" by Irene Smalls, where Kevin spends time doing various activities with his dad, such as cleaning the house, fixing the faucet, and playing a race.

After the story reading, the children took turns picking a family-related object or image and shared what they did with their families. This sharing allowed the children to realize that the same activity can be done differently in different families. For instance, one child shared that she celebrated Christmas by decorating a Christmas tree with her parents, while others celebrated it by hosting a house party. Thus, the children are beginning to understand that families have unique ways of spending time together, even while engaging in similar activities.

In the weeks to come, the children will continue to build their knowledge on this topic and explore what they would like to learn more about!

title: 十二月 第三周 健康的刷牙
description:

1.锻炼幼儿区分健康的和不健康食物的能力。
2.初步了解健康的和不健康的食物。

活动过程：

本次活动通过展示健康与不健康食物的卡片、动手操作和互动游戏，帮助幼儿初步了解并区分健康食物与不健康食物。孩子们通过分组分类、模拟浇水等方式，实际体验了健康食物的益处与不健康食物的潜在危害，同时提升了他们的观察力和动手能力。教师通过简单的讲解和提问，引导孩子们思考食物对身体的影响，鼓励他们选择健康食物，逐步培养良好的饮食习惯。与此同时，介绍刷牙歌，通过简单的歌词和节奏，初步的引导幼儿学习刷牙步骤，孩子们可以在歌声中边唱边做动作，按照歌中的提示刷上排牙、下排牙以及舌头，既让刷牙过程变得有趣，又帮助他们记住刷牙的关键动作。通过这种互动式的方式，孩子们在愉快的氛围中既学会了健康饮食的知识，又培养了良好的口腔卫生习惯。

月龄较大的幼儿，老师鼓励幼儿通过分享玩具和轻触同伴小手或小脚等方式表达友好，并及时表扬他们的积极互动行为，以促进社交能力的发展。

title: Our 3D Mind Map
description:
Building on the Talking Tub activity from Monday, the children created a three-dimensional mind map of things they do with their families. They placed and connected items to visually represent family life.

As the items from the Talking Tub were limited, some children suggested taking down their family photos from the Family Corner to showcase the activities they do with their families. For example, some photos showed meals with parents, others depicted celebrations, and some were captured from overseas trips. These activities were categorized into groups such as celebrations, travelling, and day-to-day routines like eating and so on. Therefore, this activity enabled the children to better understand what they already know and encouraged them to think about what they would like to learn and explore further.

title: Maneuvering along the zig zag line
description:
Maneuvering a ball along a taped line is an excellent way for young children to develop crucial gross motor skills. This activity enhances hand-eye coordination, as children must focus on controlling the ball while keeping it on the line. It also improves balance and spatial awareness as they move around the ball, adjusting their body position to guide it. 

Additionally, it encourages concentration, by gently pushing the ball, this fun exercise lays the foundation for more advanced motor skills while fostering active play.

title: Looking at nature in a different colour
description:
As we are exploring the topic of 'Our Body Parts', the children were invited to use see-through coloured blocks (e.g. red, blue, green, and yellow) to look at the world around them in a different colour. title: 一月 第一周：去草地踢球
description:
活动目标：
1.发展平衡感，腿部肌肉的力量及协调运动能力。
2.发展空间知觉，能将大球踢远。
3.在互动中，培养社会交往技能，与他人分享的能力。

此活动于星期五进行。

2.培养自我意识和对他人的认识，说出自己的名字和同伴的名字。

活动介绍：

title: 每周活动分享
description:
亲爱的家长，
大家好！
这一周是我们幼儿学步班迎新周的第二周。我们上一周新加入的幼儿献正，义泽和Davi  开始挑战在没有父母的陪伴下独自入园。这三位小朋友很努力地在适应学校的环境，他们表现的非常棒！ 开始和同伴进行互动，他们会和同伴一起牵手，一起玩玩具，一起加入阅读活动等等。他们的适应能力值得家长们点赞。我们相信下一周他们的表现会更棒，会更加的从容。
这一周我们新加入了一位小女生晋僖，她还在慢慢地适应我们的环境，希望我们的晋僖小朋友能够早日融入集体！
教师为了让幼儿能够融入新环境，设计了很多有趣的活动。例如，准备了《我上幼儿园》的故事绘本，透过故事的图片鼓励幼儿园可以交朋友，可以有很多有趣的活动，以及有爱小朋友的老师。 同时带领幼儿一起做音乐律动，幼儿会跟随音乐扭动自己的身体，听到熟悉的歌曲会跟随老师模仿简单的动作。我们的小朋友也会自己主动到音乐区角选择自己喜欢的乐器进行探索。
我们的游乐场也多了一些新的玩具，是幼儿喜欢的篮球和足球。喜欢球类的小朋友，会抱着球做追逐游戏。喜欢脚踏车的幼儿还是会继续选择他们喜欢的款式，在游乐场练习蹬脚踏车。喜欢在操作墙上探索的小朋友也找到了乐趣，他们开始对小索道感兴趣，让小球从索道上面滚落下来，幼儿会不厌其烦的重复操作。
这一周幼儿和教师一起去了楼上的户外草坪玩耍，草坪上面为大家安装了遮阳棚，小朋友在草坪上面追逐，吹泡泡，在阳光下面挥洒着汗水。他们很享受在草坪上追逐的乐趣。
幼儿在操作角落和教师一起探索了软软的和硬硬的物品。一些幼儿和教师一起用绒球制作了一幅画。
在接下来的一周，我们会和幼儿继续进行有趣的探索和互动，帮助幼儿适应学校的生活，也请家长继续关注我们，给予我们支持，谢谢！

title: 情绪表情绘画
description:
幼儿用简单的线条画出了两个情绪表情。左边的人脸表情是开心的，有着微笑的嘴巴和圆形的眼睛；右边的人脸表情看起来有点不同，可能代表惊讶或困惑，用更大圆的嘴巴和稍微上挑的眉毛来表达不同的情绪。作品体现了孩子在表达和区分情绪方面的初步理解。

培养情绪认知能力：帮助孩子识别和表达不同的情绪，如开心、生气、悲伤和惊讶等。
发展绘画技能：练习基本的线条描绘，特别是脸部特征的构造，如眼睛、嘴巴和耳朵的表现。
提高观察能力：通过观察和模仿他人表情，增强对社会互动中表情变化的敏感性。
增强沟通能力：引导孩子通过语言和绘画解释他们的情绪或他人的情绪，培养社交技巧。

title: 每周精彩活动——（第一学期——认识字词游戏）
description:
幼儿们正在进行一个字词认知游戏活动。孩子们围坐在地板上，通过使用教具（如图卡）和指针棒来识别和指认不同的字词卡片。这些卡片上包含图像与文字，可能代表常见的物品或场景，如“牙膏”、“牙刷”、“牙医”等。游戏中每个孩子轮流用指针棒指向字卡，并说出对应的字词。

增强汉字认知：通过图文配对游戏，帮助孩子认读基础字词，培养对常见汉字的兴趣和记忆力。
发展语言表达能力：促进孩子在游戏过程中使用语言表达字词，提高词汇量和口语表达能力。
提升观察与专注力：要求幼儿仔细观察图卡并与文字配对，训练专注力和细心观察能力。
培养合作与互动：通过小组合作和轮流参与的方式，促进孩子之间的互动，发展社交技能和规则意识。

title: Weekly Update
description:
Hello Parents!

Last week, the children had a great time exploring painting techniques during our craft session. We used a watercolor palette instead of traditional paints, allowing for smooth layering of colors, and it made for an easy clean-up! After finishing their artwork, they selected their best photo of the week to add to their craft.

We also continued reading stories about transitioning to school and how we’re adapting to new routines. The children have become more aware of cleaning up their toys before moving on to the next activity.

One of the highlights was our exploration of the 2nd-floor outdoor play area. Though there were no toys yet, the children thoroughly enjoyed running around in the new space. With just a picnic table and chairs, they invented stories and even sang a happy birthday song together! It was wonderful to see their creativity in action.

Thereafter, they created a collage by sticking their shapes onto a piece of mahjong paper. During the activity, the children were both excited and curious to see how the end product would turn out. Needless to say, they're proud of their class collage.

title: Book Title: Train Station Cats
description:
In our classroom, we love utilizing pockets of time to introduce children to a variety of book genres. 

This week, we introduce a big book by local Singaporean author Ho Lee-Ling, featuring the story of three cats named Teh, Susu, and Kopi-O.

The children seem to enjoy the story, especially how the cat names sounded. We explained that in Malay, "teh" means tea, "susu" means milk, and "kopi" means coffee. Since the author is Singaporean, the book is filled with relatable imagery—train stations, coffee shops, and familiar terms like "uncle."

Our goal is to introduce more localized Singaporean literature to foster a sense of belonging among the children.

Interestingly, we've discovered that many parents and grandparents are tea drinkers less so a black coffee kopi-o drinker.

Lastly, if your child would like to share a book at the center, we welcome that wholeheartedly!

Attached to this post are photos of the book that you might enjoy reading. (Do note that it might not be in the right sequence)

description:
This week marks the beginning of Term 1, and we have introduced the children to a new concept called the Talking Tub! It will be used for every beginning of each term moving forward. 

A Talking Tub is a curated collection of materials designed to help children learn a specific theme. 

For Term 1, our theme is "Who Am I?"
The goal is for the children to interact with the materials, ask and answer questions, and explore various lines of inquiry. This exploration will guide us toward new interests and help us decide on activities or books to present.

In the photos, you'll see the children discovering aspects of themselves through engaging materials like sunglasses, perfume, and apples, allowing them to utilize all five senses. We've also included images representing the five senses to reference their ideas.

The sunglasses have been a favourite, with children constantly trying them on and posing for the camera hence, the many photos of children posing in this album.

title: 《一起来投球》
description: 本周四我们迎来了活力满满的体能课。小朋友们从最初的羞涩、陌生，在和老师们问好互动中渐渐的露出笑容。小朋友们和老师们一起做伸展运动后,开始动物模仿热身。小朋友们模仿长颈鹿抬起胳膊踮起脚走路。模仿棕熊，咚咚咚的跺脚慢慢走走。模仿小螃蟹，小手弯起横着移动加速走等等；小朋友们热身后，我们一起喝水休息。一起认识今天的教具网球，观察老师示范网球是怎样双手投向对面。小朋友们一起尝试投球练习，在反复投掷的过程中，小朋友们都很喜欢网球落地又弹起来的过程。老师带领幼儿玩放球、捡球、收球的游戏。小朋友们在游戏的过程中，锻炼了他们的手要协调能力和手部精细动作。同时收获了满满的快乐，自己成功的自信和成就感。

title: Toy Twins Matching Hunt
description: The children participated in an activity similar to treasure-hunting, where they were tasked with looking for matching pairs of toys. The children were first introduced to the concept of matching, where it was reinforced that items with exact similarities can be matched to one another. They were then provided with a basket of toys, with the toy's matching twin being hidden around a classroom area. The children were invited to observe the toys and then find their matching pairs before placing the pairs together in the basket. The children thoroughly enjoyed hunting for the missing toys and identifying their matches!

title: Numicon Matching Race
description: This week, the N2 children were introduced to Numicon - a numeracy tool used in counting and mathematic activities - which they then further explored through a fun and engaging matching race. As a class, we first looked at the Numicons that represented the quantity of 1-5. The teacher then placed matching sets of Numicons on the table, placing one piece on each end. The children were invited to choose one of the five pieces, then race across to the other end of the table, find the matching piece, and place the pair in a basket. As the children watched their friends and played a few rounds themselves, they got faster, more accurate, and more eager to take part in the matching game.

title: 《小手拍拍》
description: 老师在晨间活动和小朋友们一起唱歌问好，一起拍拍手，认识自己的身体部位和名称，并找一找都在哪里。老师出示做好的教具，邀请小朋友们自由粘贴创作自己的脸。小朋友们在粘贴的过程中，加深了对五官的认识。同时，还锻炼了手部精细动作，体会了自由粘贴的快乐。

title: Word Family - en
description: In K1, the children will begin to explore doing blending of three letters words. At first, they were shown the /e/ and /n/ letter cards and were asked to sound the individual letters one after the other. After that, they sounded the letters from a slow pace to a fast pace gradually as Ms Ariel moved the letter cards closer each time. They tried to blend the two letters when the letter cards are side by side eventually. Subsequently, Ms Ariel added a beginning letter to the blend /en/ to show that it could form a word such as 'den'. After that, they also made attempts to blend the word family with other beginning sounds. To record their learning, they chose four things that they wished to draw and did copywriting to label them.

title: Sorting Items with Textures
description: Children were introduced to the word 'sort'. They shared what they knew about the concept of sorting and suggested ways to do that. Thereafter, they were provided with a basket of items and were engaged in sorting the items according to ‘smooth’, ‘rough’, ‘hard’, ‘soft’, ‘sticky’ and ‘grainy’.

title: January Week 1 Weekly Highlight
description:
Playing with a catapult made from ice cream sticks helped the children to develop fine motor skills. By pressing down on the stick and releasing it to launch pompoms, they fostered their hand-eye coordination and control. The activity also taught them about cause and effect, as they learned how pressing and releasing the stick made objects fly. Overall, it was a fun way to foster the children's curiosity and exploration. If you are keen to try out this activity with your child at home, here’s a link that will guide you in making one- 
https://www.craftsbycourtney.com/how-to-crafts/stem-project-idea-how-to-make-a-diy-popsicle-stick-catapult/

Next week, the children will be given the opportunity to attempt to aim and shoot the pompoms into a container.

title: Favourite Food Placemat
description: This process art to create their favourite food placemats gave the children an opportunity to hone their fine motor skills by getting them to use jumbo crayons to scribble and explore making marks as they create a representation of their favourite food. After listening to their sharing, the teacher printed pictures of some of the healthy food they mentioned and let the children paste them around their drawings.

title: Jumping from One Hoop to Another
description: To make up for the rainy day, a game of jumping on hoops was played during outdoor play. Great effort for the children in trying to jump successfully with both feet from one hoop to another! We will continue to do such activities to help them improve!

title: Weekly update
description:
We’re so excited to be back with the children, and although it's been a short time with the little ones, we’re already seeing wonderful growth! It’s especially heartwarming to see the playgroup class expanding.

This week, the children are in a transition phase as they begin to build relationships and trust with their teachers. We understand that it can be concerning when little ones cry or have difficulty settling in. Rest assured, some children are starting to feel more comfortable in the classroom environment, and we know that each child will settle at their own pace.

We ask for your continued support as we help them navigate this transition. Your encouragement, especially during drop-off time, will help them be brave and strong as they adjust.

Here’s a glimpse of the little ones in action!

And don’t forget – next week, we’re hosting a tea session on Monday. We’d love for you to join us!

description: For the first term, we are learning about the body and body parts. Children named and matched the different parts of the body.

description: To mark the year of the snake, children used angbaos and decorated their paper plate snake.

title: Our Hands and Feet
description: Children traced their hands and feet as they learned about their bodies. They compared the size of the hands and feet with their friends, identifying if their hands and feet are bigger or smaller than their friends.

title: A Lizard
description:
On Monday, while going to the playground, the children saw a lizard crawling on the wall. They were fascinated with how fast it moved, how it looked, and what it ate. 

The next day, Jordan came to school with a lizard he caught at home. The children were excited to see a lizard up close. Throughout the day, they came towards the jar to look at it.

title: Water and oil art
description:
This integrated lesson plan helps children develop fine motor skills by using a pincer grasp to drop oil into water and observe its effects. 

The activity introduces basic science concepts like liquid properties and surface tension, while encouraging critical thinking as children predict and observe outcomes. They then capture the resulting patterns on paper through creative expression, strengthening both motor control and artistic skills. This hands-on activity fosters scientific inquiry, fine motor development, and creativity, making it an engaging and holistic learning experience.

title: Speech and drama 8th January
description: For the first speech and drama lesson of the year, children pretended to be farmers as they made medicine brewed from fruits in the farms.

title: Feel the breeze!
description:
On a breezy morning, children connect with nature by stretching out their hands to feel the splashing rain and observing a recently chopped tree. "Where did the tree go?" the children asked as they noticed the tree that was usually there is now gone.

This experience engages their senses, fosters curiosity, and encourages reflection on the natural world. Moments like these nurture their sense of wonder and inquisitiveness.

title: Happy Birthday, Matteo! 🥳🎂
description: We celebrated Matteo’s birthday with lots of joy! The children gathered to sing, and enjoy a jelly cake together. Happy birthday, Matteo—here’s to a year filled with love and laughter! 🎉🎂🎈

description:

title: 第一学期第一周：我最喜欢的故事画面
description:
活动目标：
1.运用想象力创作平面和立体的艺术品。
2.能够积极主动地用华语表达，态度自然。

活动介绍：
教师带领幼儿回顾故事中奥莉薇做了哪些事，并请幼儿说一说。教师向幼儿展示图画纸、铅笔、彩色笔、马克笔等材料和工具。教师邀请自由选择他们自己最喜爱的绘本画面，利用绘画的方式将其呈现出来。在创作过程中，教师从旁给予指导和鼓励。你会怎样进行构图？你选择了哪些颜色进行绘画？为什么？

title: 1st SportBall Enrichment (In-house)
description:
We’ve officially kicked off our first in-house enrichment program—Sportball! ⚽️ The children had a blast during their 30-minute sessions, learning soccer through fun games and activities that encourage teamwork, movement, and lots of laughter. 

A reminder that Sportball takes place every Wednesday from 9:00 AM to 10:10 AM, with the class split into two groups. We’re excited to see the children continue to grow their skills and love for the game each week!

title: Blend of the week: /br/
description:
This week, we explored the /br/ sound and words that have the beginning consonant blend. After playing games and coming up with ten different words, the children recapped by writing and drawing out four words. 

*You may notice that the children's spelling of the words are incorrect. Please do not worry! We're transiting to inventive spelling, whereby children stretch out words to hear the individual letter sounds. While these words may be spelt incorrectly, we accept their words as the letters made similar sounds! We will be focusing on inventive spelling for the first half of 2025, building children's confidence and interest in spelling words. :)

title: Pairing objects based on child-determined attributes
description: The children paired up items on the rug based on attributes that they decided. In a circle, the children took turns to guess the matching attribute that their friends have used to pair up two objects.

title: Blend of the week: /br/
description:
This week, we explored the beginning consonant blend /br/. We played several games for children to listen if the words have the /br/ sound, and identifying picture cards to words with the /br/ sound. 

Phonological awareness is key for children's language development, and we encourage children to blend and segment words to discern the letter sounds.  I've attached an article for your reading pleasure to better support your child's letter sound knowledge at home :)

Let's work together to support your child's language growth!

  本周K1 Bailey的活动主要围绕绘本《菲菲生气了》展开，幼儿们通过阅读绘本、观察周围的人生气时会怎样、照镜子观察自己生气的表情、并将其绘制出来、制作生气的脸、分享作品。

  除此之外，还包括幼儿们的游乐场时间和户外活动。

title: 本周动态分享
description: 在本周的活动中，我们依旧带领孩子们进行更有趣的活动来帮助孩子们适应学校生活，本周进行了感官类型的游戏，通过绘本《小企鹅乔比》探索不同的质感的游戏也在本周升级为感官盒活动，在粗糙的材料中寻找光滑的石头。老师在感官盒中投放不同质感的玩具，引导孩子们在游戏中发现和感受这些不同的质感。来到户外，眼睛也是我们感受周围环境的重要渠道，我们用不同颜色的彩片放在眼睛前，世界就变成了不同的颜色。户外的游乐场成为了最受欢迎的场地，不同长度的草坪也给孩子们带来不同的感受，孩子们在草地上奔跑、打滚儿感受着草地的柔软。新鲜的植物的气味当然是不可缺少的，教室里投放的不同的感官瓶也让孩子们探索到了不同材料所带来的气味。下周我们会邀请幼儿来选择自己最喜欢的玩具和角落，通过活动增加幼儿们对学校生活的期待。

title: Talking Tub
description: To kickstart the term and the topic "Who Am I," the children participated in a talking tub activity. They were provided with items and pictures representing different body parts and encouraged to explore the materials, describe their observations, and make connections through group discussions.

title: Matching Scavenger Hunt
description: The teacher introduced the term "twin" to the children and explained the concept of matching, highlighting what makes objects identical. Following this, the children engaged in a scavenger hunt to find matching pairs of items in the classroom. They were encouraged to exclaim, "I found it!" upon discovering a pair.

title: Matching Numicon
description: The children were also introduced to Numicon shapes (1-5). In this activity, they matched the Numicon shapes by picking one and finding its matching pair in another basket. Afterwards, they were encouraged to share their findings and describe the features of the Numicon they selected (e.g., "This is blue and has three holes").

title: Chinese Speech and Drama Trial

title: January Week 1: This is the way we wash our hands!
description:
Objectives:
1) Foster personal care skills such as hand washing, dressing etc.

The children were introduced to the song, "This is the way we wash our hands!" They managed to sing along and follow the actions. The children were curious and asked questions such as "Why do we need to wash our hands?" The children even practised to wash their hands by using sanitisers and rubbing their hands together. They were very proud to show their clean hands afterwards! 

We also visited the sinks at the school toilet and talked more about the hand soap we need to keep our hands clean. The children had lots of fun!

title: Term 1 Week 1: Toy Twins Matching Hunt
description:
The concept of matching or pairing was introduced to the children. They were invited to look for identical objects around the classroom. The children eagerly searched, and once they found a matching object, they were encouraged to say, "I found it!"

Afterward, the children had the opportunity to sit in front and share with their friends how the objects were the same. They explained their observations, saying things like, "They are the same in color," "It's the same toy," or "It's the same object."

Learning Objectives:
Children will match identical objects while building confidence in completing a matching task.  
Children will follow the teacher's instructions during the activity.

title: Jaylin's 4th Birthday!
description: Last Friday, we got to celebrate the first birthday of 2025! Happy birthday to our dear Jaylin! Thank you Jaylin's daddy and mummy for bringing yummy cakes and presents for our Florence friends! We appreciate your generous gesture! :)

title: Toy Twins Matching Hunt
description: Children identified the characteristics of "same" or "similar" with the teacher. They participated in activities to find same or similar pairs using toys and objects around the classroom. Children were also asked to share about the similarities between the two items that they have selected (e.g. colour, size, shape).

title: My First Journal!
description:
We are excited to introduce a new weekly class activity called Journal for our N2 children! We hope that through journaling, we can helping our young learners express themselves through art and eventually through literacy in writing.

Each week, the children will be presented with a thought-provoking journal question related to a topic they have explored during a lesson in that week. They will reflect on the question and respond by drawing pictures that represent their thoughts, ideas, or feelings.

These journals are to be brought back home every Friday and we encourage you to talk to your child about their journal entries for both English and Chinese over the weekend. This is a wonderful opportunity to celebrate their learning and creativity, as well as gain insight into how they interpret the world around them.

All journal books are to be brought back to school on Monday so that we can use them for their journaling on Friday. :)

title: Talking Tub
description: Teacher used a talking tub filled with objects representing different emotions. Children explored the items, described their features, and discussed the emotions they associated with each object.

title: Where did you see this number before?
description:
In this activity, the children were required to go through the stepping stones to pick a number card and pair the number with a daily experience. Most of the children were able to connect the numbers to their environment or past experiences. For example, they mentioned seeing the numbers on a clock, in the lift, on their toys at home, on a car plate, and as the level they live on.

This activity not only encouraged the children to apply counting skills and connect numbers to their world, but it also enhanced their physical coordination and awareness of their body's abilities.

title: What is your favourite thing to do with your family?
description:
In relation to this term's topic in focus, the children were encouraged to reflect on the question: "What is your favourite thing to do with your family?" They then drew various items and activities to represent their ideas and wrote down a few words to describe their drawings with the teacher's help.

It was interesting to see the variety of activities the children depicted. Some shared that their favourite activity is playing hide-and-seek, while others mentioned simple joys like eating noodles and pizza, drinking milk, and taking photos together!

title: Fireworks to Celebrate 2025! 🥳 (Part 2)
description:
We completed our special foil fireworks art project and couldn’t be happier with the final result! Our teacher helped us prepare by wrapping our papers in aluminium foil. Using our hands, we pressed and smoothed the foil over the strings we had previously glued onto the paper, making the patterns stand out clearly.

Once we were satisfied with the texture, we moved on to painting. With watercolours and paintbrushes in hand, we selected our favourite colours and painted freely. Some of us used a stamping motion, while others painted in smooth, straight strokes. No matter the technique, the end result was a stunning display of colours and patterns, resembling the dazzling beauty of fireworks lighting up the night sky! 🎆

title: Who stole my cheese?
description: Children participated in a movement activity called "What is the time, Little Cat?". They learnt about the rules of the games with teacher's demonstration before playing. Children took turns to be the cat and mouse, and were able to complete the game under the guidance of the teachers.

title: Practicing Dribble and Control ⚽
description:
In this activity, we were challenged to dribble a ball through a series of arches made from pool noodles of varying widths. Our teacher began by demonstrating how to carefully navigate the arches, kicking the ball through each one from start to finish. We were reminded to use only our feet to guide the ball and not our hands, which added to the challenge.

The task required us to control how hard we kicked the ball to prevent it from rolling too far away. As we took turns tackling the obstacle course, we realised how much effort and focus were needed to manoeuvre the ball through the arches. Many of us instinctively used our hands to bring the ball back to the next arch when it strayed too far.

After everyone had a turn, we ended the activity on a playful note by crawling through the arches, which we all enjoyed!

title: Julia Gabriel Speech and Drama!
description:
In our very first English Speech and Drama class, we had the pleasure of meeting Ms. Rachel. Her warm and animated personality immediately captured our attention and drew us into the lesson. In just one hour, she whisked us away on an adventure to "Dramaland," where we encountered fascinating characters and exciting activities.

Through an interactive story, music and movement, and a delightful poem, we were fully engaged from start to finish. The lesson was a perfect mix of learning and laughter, leaving us eager for more!

title: Wigglepods! 🎵
description: The children had their first Wigglepods lesson, where they explored music and movement in a fun, interactive, and engaging way. They enthusiastically participated in activities that combined rhythm, coordination, and creativity, making the experience both joyful and dynamic.

description: Matthias celebrated his 4th birthday on 10 January with his parents, teachers and friends.

title: T1W1活动
description:
新学期学的第一本故事书是《奥莉薇》。读完故事后，小朋友们觉得自己和奥莉薇有很多相似的地方。奥莉薇最拿手的事就是将别人累昏，小朋友们说自己也像奥莉薇一样，常常将爸爸妈妈累得要昏。他们扮演奥莉薇，玩奥莉薇玩的游戏，做奥莉薇喜欢做的事，最后倒在地上，像奥莉薇那样也把自己“累昏”。
小朋友们利用图片玩“故事接龙”，并在理解故事的基础上，大家一起制作一张“这是奥莉薇”海报，并利用海报将奥莉薇的故事。

title: 本周分享
description:
健弘分享了自己和家人在圣诞节期间去圣淘沙海底世界玩的照片。通过他的分享，小朋友们认识一种颜色很漂亮但眼睛很凶狠的黄色鳝鱼和长着猎豹一样斑点的鳝鱼，还认识了珊瑚和珊瑚礁。他还特别向大家介绍照片里的“圣诞老人”和“圣诞小矮人”是潜水员扮演的，他们在祝大家“圣诞节快乐”。
凯泽和思棋都去了台湾旅行。他们分别通过照片向大家介绍了自己的行程，并比较了他们旅行经历的相同和不同之处。思棋是和阿公、外婆、爸爸、妈妈、舅舅、姨姨，还有弟弟一起去旅行的，凯泽是和爸爸、妈妈一起去旅行的。他们都去了台北，都去了台北的夜市玩游戏和吃东西。思棋和弟弟在台北的一间商场玩电动车，凯泽在台北玩游乐园和吃棉花糖。思棋去了一个码头看海洋动物，凯泽去了阿里山看农场和云海......
两位小朋友都吃了很多好吃的东西，大家都知道了“台湾香肠”和“台湾火锅”很好吃。

title: 美术课
description: 在这节美术课上，老师引导幼儿使用粘土，通过揉搓的动作，制作小蛇，小朋友们开心的加入活动，并自信的展示自己的作品。

title: 精彩活动——第一学期第一周
description:
06/01/2025——10/01/2025

  本周K1 Bailey的精彩活动围绕绘本《菲菲生气了》展开。在语言领域，幼儿通过观察生气表情照片和对镜模仿，能够用华语描述生气时的表情特征，例如皱眉毛、撅嘴巴等，并乐意与教师和同伴交流，提升了语言表达能力和倾听能力。在创造领域，幼儿利用扭扭棒、马克笔、纸盘、吸管等材料，制作了独特的“生气的脸”手工作品，展现了他们的创造力和动手能力。通过选择材料和设计细节，幼儿表达了自己对情绪的理解，培养了审美能力和创新意识。同时，通过作品展示和协助整理材料，幼儿进一步增强了责任感与合作意识，体验到分享与团队合作的乐趣。

title: 鳄鱼与牙医
description: 老师通过讲述绘本故事《鳄鱼怕怕，牙医怕怕》，学习了解牙医与鳄鱼，并认识与其相关的字词“鳄鱼”和“牙医”。在老师的引导下，小朋友通过为牙医和鳄鱼找名字的游戏，认识了词汇：牙医、鳄鱼。

title: January Week 1 (6/1/25-10/1/2025)
description:
This week, our little ones had the opportunity to place rubber bands  on  a wooden dish drying rack.  This activity benefits the children by helping to develop their fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, and concentration. 

This week was also the commencement of the the various enrichment classes- Octaves Music, Ready Steady Go kids and Mathstro.

title: 数一数鳄鱼的牙齿
description: 老师提供带有不同数量鳄鱼牙齿的玩具，邀请小朋友使用手指点数的方法，数一数鳄鱼有多少个牙齿。小朋友能够听懂老师的指令，并完成任务，数出鳄鱼的牙齿数量，并能准确地累计到5个或以上。

title: 制作圣诞花环
description:
老师展示图片，向幼儿介绍与圣诞节相关的物品，在根据图片学习认读词语。最后，幼儿选择制作圣诞花环来装饰圣诞节。
老师准备纸盘、皱纹纸、毛球、胶水和剪刀，鼓励幼儿使用材料制作独特的圣诞花环。

title: Paper Crushing
description: In this activity, the children explored tactile sensations by crushing paper of different textures, such as crepe paper and bubble wraps. They fostered greater fine motor skills by using their fingers and hands to manipulate the paper into smaller pieces, which they then fit into containers with openings of various sizes. This process also encouraged problem-solving, hand-eye coordination, and spatial awareness through trial-and-error. It was really interesting to see how the children interacted differently with the same materials!

title: APPLE PIE 华文表演课
description: 本周APPLE PIE华文表演课正式开课的第一堂课，小朋友们都非常的激动和开心。为了让大家彼此更熟悉，老师首先通过互动小游戏和孩子们相互认识，缓解了他们的紧张情绪，也加深了他们之间的互动和友谊。接着，老师引导孩子们进行儿歌《过新年》的朗读和律动，通过肢体语言与语言的结合，不仅让孩子们在愉快的氛围中学习，还培养了他们对语言的兴趣和对表演的热情。

title: RSGK快乐体能课
description:
新学年的体能课程从本周正式开始了！小朋友们充满了兴奋和期待。新的学年带来了新的成长，第一堂课中，小朋友们积极参与，活力四射。
课程开始时，孩子们进行了一个有趣的“动物大巡回”游戏。在教练的引导下，他们模仿了长颈鹿、兔子、大象、螃蟹等动物的动作和行走方式，协调身体进行走、跑、跳等活动，既锻炼了身体的灵活性，又增加了乐趣。接下来，教练介绍了一项全新的球类活动——板球（cricket）。孩子们首先学习了“Fielding”和“cricket”这两个词汇，并在教练的带领下轮流尝试进行板球的游戏活动。在活动过程中，小朋友们都非常积极，充满了参与的热情，甚至主动捡起旁边的球并交给教练，展现了他们的团队精神和热爱运动的态度。

title: 金蛇贺岁
description:
蛇年即将到来，老师精心准备了玩偶蛇，带领小朋友们进行有趣的互动游戏。首先，老师向孩子们展示了玩偶蛇，鼓励小朋友们仔细观察蛇的身体特征：两只眼睛、长长的舌头、圆圆的头部以及细长的身体，但没有腿。通过这一环节，孩子们对蛇有了初步的认知。接着，老师引导孩子们了解蛇的行进方式——爬行，并讲解了蛇在野外的危险性。老师还特别提醒孩子们在遇到蛇时，要保护自己远离蛇，增强他们的安全意识。
然后，老师带领孩子们开始创作春节装饰——金蛇。小朋友们在红纸上使用金色颜料绘制出自己认识的蛇，充分发挥他们的创造力和动手能力。孩子们还为蛇黏贴上眼睛和舌头，细致入微地完成每一个细节，使每一条蛇都充满了生动的个性。作品既富有节日气氛，又展现了孩子们的艺术才华。大家一起感受到了浓厚的春节氛围，也在创作中体验到了乐趣和成就感。

title: Term 1 Week 1
description:
Dear parents,

The teacher prepared a "Talking Tub" filled with objects and images on the topic of Talents and Abilities. The children explored the items, with the teacher prompting them to discuss what each object might represent and how it relates to talents and abilities. Children shared their thoughts with the class, described the items they found most interesting, and explained why. 

For Math Mind, children drew outlines of various shapes (e.g., circles, triangles, squares) on colorful paper. They cut out the shapes, sorted and matched them based on their chosen attributes, such as color, size, or the number of edges. After matching, they glued their sorted groups onto a poster to create a colorful collage. 

Guided Reading Book: My Tooth
Content words: tooth, loose, Mum, Dad, Grandad, sister
Sight words: my, is, I, will, get, your, out, said, no, do, not, want, away

The teacher showed a list of sight words to the children from the focused Guided Reading book. To familiarize themselves, children did the following:
Say it: Read the word aloud.
Clap it: Clap the syllables.
The children were also given the opportunity to spell the sight and content words using the laptop.
At home, emphasize sight words while reading aloud and encourage your child to identify them. Continue to reinforce the sight words with repeated exposure no matter which activity you choose (e.g., looking around the print environment in parks, malls, etc.).

Letter Land:
Consonant Blends - /br/ 
Children were guided to blend /b/ and /r/ to create the -br consonant blend. 
Break, branch, breakfast, brick, brush, brown

Digital Literacy:
Children watched a video on technology devices as a recap of what was talked about in K1.
Afterwards, using tangible equipment/devices, children recalled basic computer components/technological devices such as: mouse, keyboard, monitor, iPad, computer desktop, scanner, and identified new devices such as: printer, headphones, etc.

Kind regards,
Teacher Karen

title: 我是牙医
description:
幼儿们阅读故事绘本《鳄鱼怕怕 牙医怕怕》后对牙医的角色非常感兴趣，并在讨论过程中说出了自己的感受，例如：有的幼儿说我以后想做牙医；有的幼儿说我喜欢使用工具帮助鳄鱼治疗牙齿。

老师准备了很多关于牙医的工具，并显示给幼儿们宠物狗的牙齿，有的牙齿是蛀牙，有的牙齿掉下来，这时候需要幼儿们扮演成牙医帮助小狗治疗牙齿。幼儿们在这项活动中了解的牙医的工作，近距离体验了如何使用这些工具。

title: 旋转字卡

title: 角色扮演鳄鱼和牙医
description:
幼儿们跟随绘本中的角色进行故事演绎，有的幼儿选择鳄鱼，有的幼儿选择牙医。在扮演角色前幼儿们都会说一说自己对角色的看法和感受，例如：有的幼儿会说我喜欢鳄鱼，因为鳄鱼的嘴巴很大；有的幼儿说我喜欢牙医，因为我可以治疗牙齿。等等。

在幼儿们扮演角色时，他们也会跟着绘本中的内容进行对话。
例如：
鳄鱼：我的牙很痛！
牙医：我看见了鳄鱼，我很害怕！

这些简单的对话能够帮助幼儿们更好的理解绘本中的内容情节，并为幼儿们的学习带来了很大乐趣。

description:
此活动帮助幼儿识别和表达基本情绪（如开心、生气、害怕、悲伤等）。
引导幼儿理解情绪的多样性，培养情绪管理的初步意识。
促进幼儿对他人情绪的共情能力，学会关心和尊重他人的感受。

幼儿通过涂色或粘贴五官来表现不同情绪。
为脸谱加入夸张的表情细节，比如上扬的嘴角表示高兴，下垂的眉毛表示悲伤。
教师引导幼儿展示作品，用语言表达脸谱的情绪特征和原因，培养其语言表达能力和情绪反思能力。

title: 艺术工作坊《如何让牙齿更加洁白？》
description:
在绘本教学《鳄鱼怕怕 牙医怕怕》的故事中幼儿们了解了鳄鱼见到牙医害怕的原因，因为鳄鱼的牙齿里有一颗蛀牙，这颗蛀牙黑黑的黄黄的，鳄鱼捂着嘴非常痛苦。

通过鳄鱼痛痛的情节幼儿们了解到保持牙齿清洁的重要性，老师为幼儿们准备了一些图片关于日常生活中常用的护牙用品，例如：牙刷，牙膏，洁牙器，探针，镊子，牙镜。幼儿们通过选择 - 认知 - 粘贴的同时讲述自己是使用哪些用品来进行牙齿清洁的？很多幼儿选择了牙膏，牙刷和水杯。他们告诉老师：我能每天起床后刷牙。有些幼儿选择了探针，他们告诉老师：我看见妈妈/爸爸在家使用过。

幼儿们的分享和手工制作都非常有趣，幼儿们通过动手练习更加深了对口腔护理和牙齿清洁的重要性。提高培养幼儿们良好的生活习惯的认知。

title: Weekly Update
description:
This week, the children had the opportunity to engage in a variety of hands-on experiences. One of the highlights was making homemade playdough, an experience they thoroughly enjoyed. They remained focused and engaged for a solid 10 minutes, actively pouring and mixing the ingredients. The children were eager to get their hands dirty and explore the textures, showing no hesitation as they touched the materials.

Later, they were engaged in an art experience where they decorated their playdough creations with various craft supplies, such as wiggly eyes, cotton buds, pom-poms, and straws. It was clear that the wiggly eyes were a favorite, with many children adding multiple pairs to their creations.

To wrap up the week, the children enjoyed a water play experience. We had two tubs of water—one filled with bubble suds and the other with food coloring. The children were fully immersed in the activity, and despite wearing aprons, their uniforms got wet from the pouring and splashing. Their excitement and enjoyment were evident as they played.

Have a great weekend!

title: Term 1 Week 2: Not-A-Stick!
description:
Learning Objectives: 

• Children will explore and express creativity and imagination by reimagining ordinary objects in new ways, enhancing their problem-solving skills, and engaging in collaborative thinking.

We started the activity by reading Not a Box by Antoinette Portis (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=svlNiELjDao), pausing along the way to spark the children’s curiosity with questions about the story and the character's imaginative use of a simple box. The discussion encouraged the children to think creatively and share their ideas.

Next, we followed up with another book by the same author, Not a Stick (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jwqxd4SfNcw). Inspired by the story, the children were invited to transform an ordinary stick into something entirely new. Each child had a turn to showcase their creation, while their peers enthusiastically guessed what the "stick" had become. It was a fantastic way to foster imagination, collaborative thinking, and joyful participation!

Initially hesitant, they demonstrated growing confidence and curiosity as they touched and squeezed the gloves for the first time. This hands-on experience encouraged the development of fine motor skills through squeezing motions, enhanced sensory exploration by feeling the texture and movement of the gloves, and fostered a willingness to try new experiences.

title: Term 1 Week 2
description:
Good Morning Parents,

This week, we explored the themes of self-awareness, creativity, and organization through a variety of hands-on and engaging activities. 

We started the week with the story "My Five Senses," which introduced the children to the incredible ways we experience the world around us. The story sparked curiosity as we explored how our senses help us discover and understand our environment.
When creativity was in full swing as the children created their faces using dough. This activity encouraged self-expression and fine motor skills as they shaped and decorated their unique features. Each creation was a wonderful representation of individuality!
The little ones also got to start on their first time in rock climbing. They were so excited to try out this new experience.

During midweek, we began our exploration of sorting by organising toys into three colours. The children demonstrated impressive focus and teamwork as they identified and grouped items by colour, laying the foundation for more complex sorting tasks.
The next day, we built on the previous day’s activity, we extended our sorting challenge to seven colours! The children enjoyed this activity as it honed their attention to detail and deepened their understanding of colour recognition and categorisation.

We concluded the week with journal writing, focusing on our unique hairstyles. The children shared their reflections through drawings and words, celebrating the diversity and beauty of individuality within our group.

This week was filled with opportunities for self-discovery, creativity, and learning. We’re excited to continue exploring and growing together in the weeks to come!

新的学期开始了！这是幼儿高班第一周幼儿们体验华文新课程的活动照片，希望家长们能感受到幼儿们的成长与收获。

老师与幼儿一起在麻将纸上面创作鳄鱼，并鼓励幼儿们能说出一说指一指鳄鱼的身体部位及名称等，幼儿们还能用肢体进行表演鳄鱼，幼儿们非常喜欢参与此活动。

我们还一起学习了歌曲《鳄鱼怕怕 牙医怕怕》，老师鼓励引导幼儿尝试感受歌曲旋律，并尝试用动作表达出歌曲内容。幼儿们在多次的聆听后能尝试做出喜欢的动作进行表达自己，尤其是害怕的表情！

幼儿们还一起探索了玩具鳄鱼的牙齿，并尝试进行数一数牙齿，可以看出幼儿们能用小手点着牙齿进行数数。幼儿们还一起进行玩华文词语游戏，在游戏中幼儿们能听老师的指令进行跳跃到字卡上面，逐渐熟悉词语：鳄鱼和牙医。

幼儿们第一次在华文拾趣本子上面，他们画出了这一周中自己喜欢或印象最深刻的情景。幼儿们的画面中出现最多的是鳄鱼和牙医，还有下雨和太阳等。

title: Sharing is Caring! 🧺🍌🍎🍞
description: The children sat in a circle with their play food items in a basket placed in front of them. They were invited to pick a food item they like to eat and share it with their peers. As they offered the food to a friend, they were encouraged to say or ask “Do you want to share?" or “Would you like to have some?”. A fun way to practice sharing and communication skills! 🥰

title: 5 Senses Mystery Bag
description: As the children continue to learn about their body and their senses, they were invited to play with a mystery bag where they were asked to use their sense of touch, smell, and hearing to guess what items were in the bag. The challenge was to use anything but their sense of sight! The children were curious about what items could be inside the bag, and the teacher asked prompting questions to help them reflect on what they were feeling, smelling, or hearing. Some of the objects that they explored were playdough, a tambourine, biscuits, a scent bottle, and a rubber toy. The teacher guided the children in thinking about which of their senses were being used to explore the items, and in learning the appropriate vocabulary to describe them,

title: Rainbow Sorting
description: The teacher introduced the concept of sorting to the children, highlighting that sorting means to group similar items together. The children first displayed their understanding of sorting by grouping different types of toys together: pom poms, flower connectors, and beads. The teacher then guided the children to further sort the pompoms, this time into their groups of colours. They then continued to explore the materials by sorting all the different materials by colour, into the coloured cups.

title: Chinese New Year Snake Craft
description: In preparation for their Chinese New Year celebration, the children created paper plate snakes, as part of welcoming the Year of the Snake! They first painted paper plates, using the paint colours of their choice. After allowing it to dry, they then used child-safe scissors to practice cutting along a spiral line. Once their snakes had taken shape, the children then added googly eyes and shiny sequins to their snakes, bringing their festive decorations to life!

title: Leora's Birthday Celebration 🎂🎈🥳
description:
Leora celebrated her 3rd birthday with her family, teachers, and friends, making it a day to remember! We sang the 'Happy Birthday' song and enjoyed a unicorn-themed birthday cake.

Sending Leora lots of love and wishing her a very happy birthday!

title: Making a Picnic Mat (Crepe Paper Bleeding Technique)
description: In relation to our theme of 'Food,' we started our process artwork by creating a picnic mat using the crepe paper bleeding technique. Children were given strips and pieces of crepe paper. After choosing the colour they want to use, they arranged the strips or pieces on the drawing block. Then, they tapped the paper with a paintbrush dipped in water to allow the colours to bleed.

title: Sorting all my toys!
description: The children explored different types of toys and helped to sort them according to size (big/small) and colours.

title: Olympia's 4th Birthday Party!
description: Happy birthday to our dear Olympia! Thank you for sharing presents and your birthday cake with all of us!

title: January Week 2 Weekly Highlight
description: After listening to the story Shark in the Park by Nick Sharratt, instead of telescope; the children were given their very own binoculars made from kitchen rolls. Excitedly, they held them up to their eyes and began exploring the classroom. "Look up!" the teacher encouraged, as the children scanned the ceiling. "Now look down!" they crouched low, peering at the floor. "What do you see to the left?" and "Can you spot something to the right?" they were asked, all the while practicing using their binoculars to look in different directions. As they explored, the children laughed and pointed, enjoying the chance to familiarize themselves with prepositions and their new, fun tools.

title: Art on a Plate
description: To continue our process artwork, we decorated half of a paper plate using various elements of art. We incorporated lines, colors, and scribbles to create texture and visual interest. The different shapes and patterns we created will serve as the base of our hamburger artwork.

title: Talking Tub
description: In our "Talking Tub" activity, the children explore various objects, describing what they are, where they've seen them, who uses them, and any other relevant insights. To deepen their thinking and introduce our Term 1 focus, we then challenge them to connect two items, either linking a previously discussed item with a new one, or finding connections between two items they haven't yet explored. This encourages them to make associations, spark new ideas, and begin to understand the overarching themes we'll be exploring this term.

title: Annie Apple
description: The letter and sound /a/ are introduced using the engaging character of Annie Apple. Through Annie Apple, children learn to identify words that begin with the /a/ sound. This learning is reinforced with pre-writing activities, such as a simple apple craft involving pasting and painting. These activities help children develop fine motor skills while connecting the sound to a visual representation.

title: 寻找观察小蜗牛
description: 在一次户外活动中，小朋友们来到了雨后的花园里，开始寻找小蜗牛。一个孩子惊喜地发现了一只小蜗牛，这个发现引起了大家的兴趣，纷纷开始寻找更多的蜗牛。在老师的指导和帮助下，孩子们找到了多个蜗牛，老师戴上手套，小心地拿起蜗牛与孩子们一起观察，并进行点数。整个活动既激发了孩子们对自然的好奇心，也让他们在互动中了解到了蜗牛的生活习性和特点。

title: Creating an artwork based on 'The Story Machine' by Tom McLaughlin
description:
As we delve into the topic of 'My Talents and Abilities', the children were introduced to the book 'The Story Machine' by Tom McLaughlin. We explored and discussed how Tom may not have a knack in spelling but he has a forte in illustrating pictures using letters of the alphabet. 

To encourage children to explore new abilities, they attempted to create a picture using letters of the alphabet too! They chose an item that best represented them and used letters to fill the picture up. Look at them unleashing their creativity :-)

title: Journal Friday: I want to be good at...
description: Apart from exploring their talents and abilities, we also took time to reflect on skills that the children want to work on or to become better at. :-)

title: Blend of the week: /cr/
description: This week, we explored the blend /cr/ and the children came up with 25 words! What a record! :-)

title: 探索音乐玩具：
description: 有趣的音乐玩具让幼儿感觉好奇又好玩，不停地用手按压玩具上的按钮，让玩具发出音乐声，活动通过玩玩具、探索出了和阅读书籍，促进幼儿对因果关系的理解。

title: 悬挂着的云朵：
description: 悬挂着的云朵让幼儿十分喜欢地不停的伸手去抓摸，活动提供轻柔、适宜的材料，以发展婴幼儿的触觉能力。

title: 墙上的图片
description: 老师把一些图片贴在幼儿能够看到和触摸到的墙上，当幼儿看图片时，老师会与他们谈论看到的图片，发展幼儿的目光集中和专注力。

title: 本周动态分享
description: 在很开心能够和家长们在过去的一周中与家长们见面交流，在本周我们持续关注孩子们的心理状态进行更加新奇有趣的活动，让孩子们选择自己在学校最喜欢的活动，分享自己最喜欢的朋友是谁？孩子们用拥抱和手工作品来呈现了自己的喜好，他们在教室中找到了自己最喜欢的玩具，利用这些玩具进行了印画的活动，来到自己最喜欢的朋友的身边，用拥抱表达自己的喜爱，在众多的活动中，除了对玩具的喜爱之外，感官盒活动、小汽车、玩偶、和游乐场是最受欢迎的几个活动。除此之外，我们将之前从中巴鲁公园带回来的椰子树上的“花苞”解剖开来，我们发现这个“花苞”打开来以后是和我们捡的另一个圣诞小树是一样的！孩子们很好奇这其中的关联，我们也通过解刨活动找到了答案。下周我们将继续关注孩子们的喜好，用这样的方式促进孩子们在新环境的探索，下周请为幼儿们从家里带来最喜欢的玩具，我们将在下周共同进行讨论和分享哦！

title: 推倒它
description: 堆高的玩具积木被幼儿好奇地轻轻一推倒了，游戏为婴幼儿通过机会，理解行为和结果之间的联系。

title: 大鹅，生日快乐！
description:
老师为小朋友们精心布置了一个有趣的环境和情景：大鹅的生日到了，于是，老师邀请小朋友们一起来为大鹅送上生日礼物。孩子们需要跳过“阶梯路”，穿越一座“小桥”、爬过一个“山洞”，才能抵达大鹅的家。在这段旅程中，小朋友们表现得非常积极，每送完一个礼物后又兴奋地向老师要求再多一次。
在跳过阶梯路时，老师向小朋友们介绍双脚跳的技巧，引导小朋友们进行双脚跳；在穿越小桥的过程中，老师耐心地引导小朋友们张开双手保持平衡，有的小朋友可以快速走过小桥，而另一些小朋友则需要老师的鼓励和支持，才能稳稳地走过。通过老师的帮助，大家都顺利地穿越了小桥；接着他们需要匍匐前进，爬过“山洞”。每个人都一步步克服障碍，勇敢地向前迈进，最终把准备好的“生日礼物”送到大鹅的家里。大家都感到无比开心和满足。

title: 舀舀小汤圆
description: 春节快要到了，老师为幼儿们介绍了传统的小吃——汤圆。为了让孩子们更好地理解，老师使用了大毛绒球假装成汤圆，并与小朋友们一起进行扮演游戏。老师引导小朋友们先数一数盘子里的汤圆，感受汤圆的数量。接着，孩子们用汤匙模仿将汤圆从锅里舀到自己的小碗里，然后假装吃汤圆。通过这个有趣的游戏，小朋友们不仅了解了汤圆，锻炼了手眼协调能力和精细动作的能力，还在欢声笑语中感受到了春节的传统文化。

title: 撕粘贴纸
description: 幼儿将老师贴在墙上的黏贴纸撕下来，活动通过精心的环境创设，发展了幼儿的视觉和触觉能力。

title: Playgroup
description: Let's meet the PG friends!

title: 冷和热
description: 幼儿手拿冰块和温水瓶二种温度材质的东西感到十分好奇，活动通过精心创设的环境和有目的的互动，培养了幼儿的好奇心和探索精神。

title: 套进去
description: 老师给幼儿一个可以拿出，然后再套进去的玩具，幼儿会想办法把玩具拆开，然后再一一套进木杆中，活动促进了幼儿手眼协调能力。

title: 翻看书本
description: 幼儿自己拿书本专心的翻看和触摸图书上的图片，老师在边上讲述书本上故事，发展幼儿对词语与图片、物体之间的意识，能指认图片和物体。

title: 推和拉：
description: 幼儿开心地用推拉玩具在课室里来回走动，活动促进了幼儿的身体健康，发展了幼儿控制身体的能力。

title: 玩套圈
description: 老师给幼儿一组玩具圈，让幼儿自由探索，老师在边上告诉他手里拿的套圈的颜色、大小和材质。初步发展幼儿对科学概念的感知。

title: 叠上去：
description: 大块的积木被幼儿一一叠了上去，幼儿十分高兴，活动发展婴幼儿的平衡感。

title: 户外游乐场
description: 幼儿对户外游乐场的一切事物都十分好奇，不停地玩着不同的游乐设施，活动为幼儿提供移动、翻滚和爬的空间和机会，以满足其发展的需要。

title: 每周活动分享
description:
Hi,大家好！又到了我们每周精彩分享时刻了。首先让我们一起欢迎姚定廷小宝贝加入幼儿学步班这个大家庭。希望她能很快适应新的环境、教师和同伴们，与大家一起快乐成长。

本周教师继续带领班级幼儿围绕着“过渡到学校”这一主题开展一系列有趣的活动。心理社会方面，为了帮助本月新加入班级幼儿更好的与教师和班级同伴建立起良好的依恋关系，我们在每天早上的圆圈时间进行了点名活动。在活动过程中教师会介绍宝贝们和教师们的名字，每位小朋友都可以在出席版上粘贴自己的照片，还可以帮助班级教师把照片也粘贴到出席班上，从而更好的认识彼此。同时，我们还组织了躲猫猫（Peekaboo）的游戏，这个游戏不仅有趣，还能帮助孩子理解“消失与出现”的概念，增强他们的安全感和信任感。身体动作方面，我们进行了室内游乐场活动和户外活动。在游乐场游戏中，教师引导宝贝们进行爬过隧道，玩球和骑三轮车等游戏，这些活动增强了他们的身体协调性和运动能力，促进他们粗大动作的发展。户外散步、追泡泡和玩沙池也是本周的重要活动，宝贝们在自然环境中奔跑、玩耍，享受户外活动的乐趣。语言方面，教师带领宝贝们一起阅读了故事绘本《你好，幼儿园》。绘本讲述了小动物们在幼儿园里开心地学习各种本领的故事。通过这个故事，我们帮助新入园的小朋友更好地适应新环境，提高幼儿在学校学习生活的幸福感。宝贝们不仅学会了新的词汇和表达方式，还增强了他们的听力理解和语言表达能力。音乐与律动方面，教师带领宝贝们一起欣赏了新年歌曲，并使用乐器如沙球、响板、摇铃和小鼓等进行演奏。这不仅能培养孩子的音乐感知能力，还能锻炼他们的手眼协调能力和节奏感。

总的来说，这一周宝贝们在各个方面都有显著的进步。让我们一起期待宝贝们更多的的精彩表现吧！下周见！

title: Term 1 Week 2: Rainbow Sorting Garden
description:
Objectives:
1) Children would group objects based on two characteristics, such as colour and shape, to develop their matching and sorting skills.
2) Children will use artistic elements like colour and form to express their creativity and emotions through craft activities.
 
The children participated in an activity in which they were provided with matching “flower pots” labelled by two attributes, such as “Red Circles” or “Blue Triangles.” The children began by selecting two coloured papers of varying attributes and drawing various flower designs.  After which, they took turns “planting” flowers in the correct pots. 

This activity was conducted on the 15th of January.

title: 第一学期 第二周- 认字游戏
description:
活动目标：
1. 幼儿喜欢参与认字游戏，能学会认读词语：生气、菲菲、我、哭、画画。
2. 能积极地用华语表达自己的想法。

活动介绍：
      今天，小朋友们开始学习认读新词语。学习之后，我们玩了两个有趣的认字游戏。

      游戏一：一位小朋友站在台上，把词语卡放在额头上；其他小朋友看到词语后，用动作提示台上的朋友猜出额头上的词语。
      游戏二：一位小朋友站在台上，看了词语卡后，用动作表演让台下的小朋友猜出对应的词语。

      本周词语：生气、菲菲、我、哭、画画

title: 我的表情变变变
description: 小朋友们能够认真倾听老师讲解活动规则，并积极参与表演环节。在活动中，小朋友们生动地表现出“高兴”、“伤心”、“生气”和“害怕”的表情和动作。通过表演，加深对情绪的理解，小伙伴们互相交流，分享自己的感受，表现出极大的学习热情和良好的社交能力。

title: 情绪表情
description: 小朋友们学习高兴、伤心、害怕、生气等情绪及其对应的词汇，并在活动中通过观察和模仿加深理解。在创意活动环节，教师邀请小朋友使用松散材料如毛线、纽扣和纸板，制作了丰富的情绪表情，展现他们的创造力和动手能力。

title: Exploring Emotions Through Colour
description: In this activity, we explored the connection between emotions and colours using crepe paper. When presented with red crepe paper, most of us associated it with "anger" and showed angry expressions. With green crepe paper, some of us linked it to "fear," while others connected it to "sadness." Next, in small groups of three or four, we glued the coloured crepe paper to the top half of an A3 sheet of paper. Once the top half was completely covered, we took turns using a spray bottle filled with water to soak the crepe paper. As we watched, the water interacted with the crepe paper, causing the colours to bleed and blend together, creating a vibrant, colourful artwork. This activity not only gave us the opportunity to practise turn-taking and collaboration as we worked together to create our masterpiece, but also allowed us to observe how colours mix to form new shades, helping us understand that emotions, like colours, are often a blend of many different feelings within us.

title: RSGK - Baseball
description:
During our RSGK session, we practised the overhead throw and focused on maintaining the correct stance. First, we stood sideways with our feet shoulder-width apart. Each of us was given three beanbags. We picked up the first beanbag and brought it up to our ear. With our free hand, we pointed in the direction we wanted to throw, using it to aim. Then, in one smooth motion, we twisted our bodies forward and released the beanbag, propelling it through the air.

We repeated this process with the remaining two beanbags. Once all three beanbags had been thrown, we quickly collected them and returned them to the basket. Afterwards, we sat down to give our friends their turn to practise.

title: 制作生气脸谱
description: 幼儿学习《菲菲生气了》的绘本故事后，了解故事中菲菲生气的原因和生气时的面目表情。接着，老师拿出一些美术材料，例如：冰棒棍、毛根、线条、毛球等等。鼓励幼儿使用这些材料来制作自己生气时的样子。最后再说一说，为什么会生气。

title: 第一学期第二周活动照片
description:
Hi家长们好！
本周幼儿学习了句式：我害怕鳄鱼。并尝试用蜡笔画出自己害怕的东西是什么，幼儿们能发挥自己创作力，画出自己害怕的动物及不喜欢的黑夜等，并能用语言尝试说出及解释为什么等。

老师与幼儿一起探索了关于情绪的脸谱，幼儿们都能清楚的分辨出：害怕、生气、高兴和伤心脸谱。并能与老师一起进行认识词语。幼儿们很喜欢照着镜子做出不同情绪的脸部表情，个别幼儿能进行描述眼睛、嘴巴眉毛的变化。

老师展示不同形状的纸壳及一些自然物品，鼓励幼儿尝试探索认识并选择喜欢的物品创作自己喜欢的情绪脸谱，看得出幼儿很喜欢进行探索，因此在创作方面下周会继续进行。

幼儿们的攀爬课程开始了！在教练的陪伴指导下挑战自我！
幼儿们在音乐课中非常投入及享受！

title: 2025 - the Year of the Snake
description:
We are all super excited with Chinese New Year just around the corner! Since 2025 marks the Year of the Snake, we created our very own snake artwork to celebrate. We started with paper plates, which we painted red using sponges—red being a colour traditionally associated with luck and prosperity.

Next, we decorated our plates with colourful stickers. Peeling the stickers from the sheet required plenty of focus, eye-hand coordination, and fine motor control as we carefully removed and placed each one onto our painted plates.

Once we had completed our designs, our teacher helped us cut the plates into spiral patterns, transforming them into spring-like shapes when lifted. To finish our snakes, we added two googly eyes, bringing them to life.

We were absolutely delighted with our creations and can't wait to show them off! Be sure to look for our snake artworks displayed in the foyer as part of our Chinese New Year decorations.

title: 亲子活动---一起阅读绘本故事《刷牙》
description:
Hi家长们:

陪伴孩子阅读其实是父母给他们的最好的礼物之一！本周向您推荐的亲子阅读绘本是《刷牙》。您可以带您的孩子去图书馆借阅该绘本，或者通过点击以下链接来打开该绘本的网上电子图书版本进行阅读，愿你们能够共同享受这段美好的亲子共读时光。

title: 制作圣诞树
description:
与幼儿圣诞节时，大家对圣诞树非常感兴趣，十分积极的分享自己摆放出来的圣诞树或是在外面看到的圣诞树。讨论过后，大家觉得来做圣诞树并装饰在课室里。

title: Term 1 Week 2
description:
Dear Parents,

The children listened to the story Not a Box by Antoinette Portis. They were engaged with questions asked by the teacher about the story and the character's imaginative use of a box. After the story, they were invited to transform a simple cardboard box (or other items) into anything they imagined—such as a rocket, a car, or a house. In small groups, they discussed their creations and explained why they chose their designs. The activity concluded with a sharing circle where children reflected on their abilities ("What I made") and discussed areas they can improve ("What I want to try next time").

For Math Mind, children compared a group of objects and communicated the differences based on two or more attributes (PRAISE). They observed illustrated fruits of various sizes, colors, and shapes. Afterwards, they compared two groups of fruits they observed by arranging paper cutouts provided by the teacher based on attributes like “small red fruits” versus “large yellow fruits.” The activity concluded with a reflection on how fruit bowls differ across cultures, allowing children to share insights into fruits they enjoy in their homes or traditions (e.g., giving oranges during Chinese New Year). 


Phonics:
Consonant Blends - /cr/
Children were guided to blend /c/ and /r/ to create the -cr consonant blend. 
Crack, cry, crush, cream, cross, crow, croak, crawl


Guided Reading Book: My Tooth
Content words: tooth, loose, Mum, Dad, Grandad, sister
Sight words: my, is, I, will, get, your, out, said, no, do, not, want, away

Kind regards,
Teacher Karen

• How are the senses used in the story?
• How do we use our senses to understand the world?
• Why do you think our senses are important?

The children then shared examples of how they use their senses in everyday life and discussed why it’s important to take care of them.
After the story, the teacher filled a bag with various objects (e.g., a ribbon, shaker, perfume, pine cone, sponge) and invited the children to use their senses to identify each item. As an extension activity, the teacher encouraged the children to sort pictures of different items into categories based on the senses they engage

Next, they switched gears and became sailors, rowing a boat together by mimicking the motion of oars. This activity helped the kids practice teamwork, and creativity, all while having fun with their friends. It was a day filled with imaginative play, showing how simple objects can transform into exciting adventures!

title: 每周精彩活动——（第一学期——第三周—观察我的牙齿）
description:

教幼儿认识每种牙齿的形状和功能：
门牙：用来切断食物（像剪刀）。
犬牙：用来撕碎食物（像小尖刺）。
臼齿：用来磨碎食物（像小石磨）。

认知发展：引导幼儿初步认识牙齿的外形、种类和功能。
健康意识：帮助幼儿了解爱护牙齿的重要性和正确的护齿方法。
观察能力：培养幼儿通过观察和触摸感知牙齿特征的能力。

title: 学习刷牙步骤排序
description:
通过绘本教学《鳄鱼怕怕牙医怕怕》的教学展开，拓展教学内容的延伸，幼儿们学习了健康安全方面的知识《如何正确的刷牙？》幼儿们首先分享了自己在家中刷牙的情况，有的幼儿会告诉老师：我早晨在家刷牙，我的牙齿白白。有的幼儿分享：我喜欢我的牙刷，我的牙刷是蓝色的。

老师向幼儿们提出焦点问题进行思考：刷牙的步骤有哪些呢？幼儿们分别说出了自己的想法，有的幼儿说：使用牙刷刷牙/用水漱口等等。幼儿们分别拿到一个刷牙排序图，按照自己的刷牙顺序进行排序，从第一步到第五步分别使用阿拉伯数字表示并粘贴在对应的图片下方，最后幼儿们展示自己的排序板讲述自己的刷牙步骤。

通过本次练习，幼儿们增强了语言表达能力，与老师同伴分享自己的想法，活动中幼儿们学习到了正确的刷牙方式和步骤，按照常规排序练习幼儿们对事物的逻辑思维与规则。

title: 第一学期第三周活动更新
description:
亲爱的家长您好：
这一周是绘本《菲菲生气了》的第三周，在这一周教师和幼儿根据绘本一起谈论了有关情绪的话题。教师和幼儿一起寻找“生气了该怎么办？” 的解决办法，幼儿会用哪些方式来帮忙自己缓解生气这个情绪。
活动中教师鼓励幼儿说一说自己生气的时候是如何抒发自己的情绪，以及带领幼儿去向不同的老师或工作人员做访谈，问一问他们是否会生气，生气的时候该如何缓解情绪？之后教师和幼儿一起总结分享他们访谈的结果，并且把访谈解决生气的办法给标记出来，大家一起相互学习。
同时教师也访问幼儿—你自己生气的时候，你会用怎么样的方式来缓解自己的情绪。幼儿都能够说出和画出自己的想法。
活动中教师和幼儿一起学习的认读词汇：听音乐，画画，跑步，读书，唱歌。教师鼓励幼儿用绘画和形式把自己的想法记录下来。在接下来的活动当中，教师会带着幼儿一起利用这个制作的海报去向同伴展示分享如何应对生气的情绪。

title: Term 1 Week 3 Weekly Highlight
description:
Here are two simple activities parents can try at home to help their child practice sorting by two attributes:

Button Sorting
Gather a collection of buttons in various colors and sizes. Encourage your child to sort them into groups based on two attributes, such as color and size (e.g., "Blue and Big" or "Red and Small"). You can make it more fun by using bowls or containers for sorting.

Toy Sorting
Use your child’s toys, such as cars or blocks, and ask them to sort by two attributes like color and type (e.g., "Red Cars" or "Yellow Blocks"). Once sorted, you can discuss their choices and even build something with the sorted items together.

description:
尊敬的家长您好，
这一周是我们的主题“ 适应新环境，老师” 的第三周。 很高兴和大家分享，我们一月初加入的宝贝们已经熟悉了课室的环境和常规流程。他们开始对这个课室产生了安全感，他们在课室里面会主动地去不同的地方探索。幼儿们也开始熟悉其他的同伴，对同伴不会感到陌生，和同伴肢体接触也没有问题。

他们会一起做小组活动；和同伴一起坐下来喝水；一起拿着音乐器材做律动；也会跟着教师的步伐转换不同的常规。

title: T1W3 Weekly Update
description:
This week, we combined creativity, self-expression, and hands-on learning to explore our environment, prepare for celebrations, and broaden our understanding of inclusivity. We began the week by taking photos of our classroom space. The children eagerly explored their environment, capturing details from their unique perspectives and showcasing their curiosity and creativity. You will find photos taken by the little ones in the next album!
During circle time, the children shared their feelings about the photos they had taken. They expressed excitement, pride, and joy while discussing their favorite areas and what makes the classroom special to them.

In preparation for Chinese New Year, we crafted festive decorations in the shape of a snake. The children enjoyed learning about the significance of the snake in Chinese culture while creating beautiful and colorful designs. We also engaged in a fun matching activity, where the children paired related objects. This task encouraged critical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail, making learning both engaging and interactive.

We wrapped up the week with two meaningful activities. First, we welcomed a guest speaker from SPD who shared insights on understanding and embracing differences. The talk provided the children with valuable lessons on empathy, inclusion, and how we can all work together to support and celebrate one another.
Later in the day, the children participated in a journal-writing session, focusing on the concept of size. They reflected on and documented what is taller than them or what they are taller than, using drawings and descriptive words.

This week was a wonderful blend of creativity, cultural learning, and fostering an inclusive mindset. We look forward to continuing this journey of growth and discovery next week!

Have a lovely weekend!!
Tr Jia Yan

description:
Learning Objectives: 

• To understand the structure of a story, including the importance of a title page, setting, and storyline development.

• To encourage self-awareness by identifying and articulating individual talents.

This week, we’ve been exploring how everyone has unique talents and can use them to solve problems in creative ways. As part of this learning journey, the children have embarked on an exciting project to create their own short illustrated storybook!

The storybooks feature a main character inspired by themselves, showcasing how they use their talents to overcome a challenge. It’s been wonderful to see their imaginations come to life and their confidence grow as they express their ideas through art and storytelling. We can’t wait to see how their stories unfold!

One highlight was the spray bottle activity, where they sprayed colored water onto white paper. This simple yet engaging experience helps develop fine motor skills, as the children were encouraged to press the spray bottle and control the flow of water. In addition, the little ones continued to engage with the rhyme “Off to School We Go” (to the tune of “A Hunting We Will Go”). You can find the rhyme in the album, and we encourage you to sing it with your child at home!

title: Animals Sensory Play
description: The children engaged in a sensory play activity featuring animals commonly associated with hay, such as cows, horses. The setup included various animal figures and sound buttons that played corresponding animal sounds. The children were encouraged to explore the textures of the hay and match the sounds they heard with the appropriate animal figures. This activity fostered sensory exploration, auditory discrimination, and cognitive skills as the children identified and matched sounds to visuals. Additionally, it supported language development as they practiced naming the animals and imitating the sounds. Through this interactive experience, the children also enhanced their fine motor skills by manipulating the sound buttons and animal figures, while engaging their curiosity and strengthening their understanding of animal habitats and characteristics.

title: Chinese New Year Fashion Walk! 🎉
description:
Thank you parents for your spontaneity in taking a fashion walk with your child! Not forgetting the shy and cute poses that were done! Kudos to everyone! :) 
*Do reach out to me if you want the video. :)

title: 第一学期 第三周- 调查访问：生气的时候该怎么办？
description:
活动目标：
1. 幼儿喜欢参与认字游戏，能学会认读词语：生气、菲菲、我、哭、画画。
2. 能积极地用华语表达自己的想法。

活动介绍：
      今天，小朋友们进行了一个调查访问。他们走到学校里，向老师和阿姨们提问：“生气的时候该怎么办？”听完答案后，小朋友们用马克笔将自己听到的内容画在纸上，记录下每个人的消气方法。

      本周词语：唱歌、听音乐、跑步、看书、做游戏

title: Talking Tub - Making Connections
description: In this activity, the children were invited to pick two items that they could make connections based on the topic in focus "Learning about my family". They shared the person or people who use the items, how they use them and when do they do that. They took turns to listen to others' thoughts and showed respect for what they heard. The brown string was used to indicate the connections formed. Their ideas were written on the pink post-its.

title: Family Portrait
description: As part of the topic in focus 'Learning About My Family', the children created unique family portraits using foam shape stickers. This activity followed a sorting exercise where they practised categorising the stickers based on two attributes: shape and colour. Through this process, they developed foundational math and organisational skills while exploring their understanding of family dynamics. For the artwork, the children selected foam stickers to represent members of their family. They arranged and pasted them on an aluminium foil which was used as the base. Then, they attached more art materials like yarns, buttons and sequins. Later on, they also added drawings to personalise the background. The children showcased the unique qualities that make each family special.

title: Take Home Activity - My Family Tree
description: Using the book named ‘A World of Families’ by Trish Holland as a provocation, the children recapped how each family is unique in their own ways. After that, they took turns to share their family tree collage with their peers and Ms Ariel. They talked about the designated family members and their names. Moreover, they also shared interesting facts about them. Through this experience, the children explored family diversity within the class.

title: 绘本分享：《好忙的除夕》
description:
上个星期五，彤安妈妈来到学校，给小朋友们讲了绘本《好忙的除夕》。通过绘本，小朋友们了解到除夕的热闹和大家忙着准备过年的情景，比如打扫、贴春联、做年夜饭等等。讲完故事后，彤安妈妈还准备了春联，让小朋友们一起用彩色笔填色。

谢谢彤安妈妈的用心分享，让我们度过了一个有趣的下午！

title: Word Family - ed
description: The children were introduced to the word family 'ed'. They made attempts to blend three letter words and explored those with four letters. Subsequently, they drew and copywrote the new words that they gained awareness to. At last, they recapped the words by reading them aloud.

title: Lucas's Birthday Celebration 🎂
description: Happy birthday Lucas! 🥳

title: 本周动态分享
description: 在本周我们进行了以“最爱的玩具”主题的活动，来增强幼儿对学校的依恋，我们在班级中设置了我最爱的玩具的角落，用来放置孩子们愿意分享的自己的玩具，在这一整周的过程中，我们让幼儿拥有自己玩具的完全主动权，允许幼儿分享或者独享自己的玩具，在相对其他幼儿的玩具感兴趣的时候表达自己的想法，也小心照顾其他人的玩具，此活动促进了孩子们群体游戏的发展，很好的提高了孩子们的社会交往能力，我们通过一些图片的分享，带领幼儿回忆在家中和学校中的成就瞬间，对同伴表达赞赏，快来看看我们的精彩瞬间吧！

title: RSGK-快乐体能课
description: 本周课程开始时，孩子们继续通过进行一个有趣的“动物大巡回”游戏来热身。在教练的引导下，他们模仿了长颈鹿、兔子、大象、螃蟹等动物的动作和行走方式，协调身体进行走、跑、跳等活动，既锻炼了身体的灵活性，又增加了乐趣。接下来，教练继续向幼儿介绍板球（cricket sport）。孩子们首先学习了技能“hitting”，并在教练的带领下轮流尝试进行进行击打。在活动过程中，小朋友们都非常积极，充满了参与的热情，甚至主动捡起旁边的球并交给教练，展现了他们的团队精神和热爱运动的态度。

title: 除旧迎新过春节
description: 在春节即将到来之际，老师首先向托班的小朋友们介绍了春节期间的一项重要习俗——大扫除。老师告诉小朋友们，大扫除是为了迎接新的一年，清洁和整理家里，让一切都焕然一新。随后，老师邀请小朋友们一起动手，帮助打扫课室。活动的目标是通过这一过程，培养小朋友们的动手能力、团队合作精神以及爱护环境的意识。老师耐心指导每个小朋友，同时鼓励他们积极参与，并不断夸奖他们清理得干净、认真。小朋友们也在活动中表现得非常积极，互相合作，课室瞬间变得整洁亮丽，并且在打扫的过程中，有小朋友清理到其他小朋友已经清理过的物品或者位置时，小朋友还会通过语言提醒：“我擦了”“I clean already!”。活动不仅让他们感受到了节日的气氛，也在实践中学习到了责任感和集体意识。

title: Tacing the lined path with a ball!
description:
In this activity, we were invited to roll a ball along a designated line. This task helped support the development of our hand-eye coordination while also strengthening our arm muscles. It further supported the growth of our perceptual and gross motor skills as we focused on guiding the ball smoothly along the path.

Our teacher first demonstrated how to roll the ball forward along the defined line on the floor while simultaneously moving our legs. It seemed simple at first, but when it was our turn, we quickly realised how much coordination and focus were needed to synchronize our hands and legs. Once in a while, the ball would veer off course, requiring us to bring it back and start over. Despite the challenges, we had a great time with this activity.

title: 画蛇添福——拉拉蛇
description: 活动开始前，老师将不同颜色的彩纸修剪成蛇的形状。活动开始，老师首先向小朋友们展示这些彩纸，邀请小朋友们观察并说一说老师手里拿的是什么，是什么颜色，并鼓励他们选择自己喜欢的颜色的蛇进行装饰。接着，老师提供了马克笔和蜡笔，让小朋友们自由选择自己喜欢的颜色和彩笔，开始装饰蛇身。在装饰的过程中，小朋友们可以在蛇身上画点或画线，发挥自己的创意和想象力，尽情装饰每一条蛇。这个活动不仅锻炼了小朋友们的手部协调能力和色彩搭配能力，还培养了他们的创造力和独立思考能力。

title: Outdoor Fun at Level 1!
description: We had so much fun on Level 1! The wide, open space and the cool breeze on our faces made it perfect for running around and playing with bubble wands. The strong wind helped blow even more bubbles everywhere, which made it extra exciting. At one point, a few of us started running around the big pillar, and before long, more friends joined in. Ms. Andrea made it even better by pretending to be a big monster, chasing us around and making everyone laugh and giggle as we tried to run away.

title: How tall are we?
description: We used the large Lego blocks to build towers as tall as our friends! Together, we stacked the blocks and counted how many it took to match their height or even hide them completely. This activity helped us develop our motor skills, social skills, and understanding of basic measurement, while also practising counting, teamwork, and turn-taking.

title: Term 1 Week 4: “What Do You Do With Your Family” Music & Movement Celebration
description:
Objectives:
1) Children will produce their own patterns using percussion tools and classroom instruments to enhance the family-themed song.
2) Children will confidently incorporate new family-related words into their singing and chanting.

The children listened to the song: "What Do You Do With Your Family" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_z5xcqEjSes) and participated in creating simple rhythmic and melodic accompaniments using classroom instruments. Before singing, the children were also introduced to some family-related words, such as “grandma,” “grandpa,” “fishing,” “listening to stories,” etc.

They were also encouraged to use these terms as they sang or chanted in rhythm, such as tapping or shaking instruments in time with the music to represent different family members and moving their bodies (e.g., swaying, stepping gently). By focusing on kind words and caring actions within families, the children deepened their awareness of the importance of showing appreciation and compassion towards one another. 

This activity was conducted on 27th January 2025.

title: Chinese New Year Celebration Photos!
description: Here are some photos taken during our Chinese New Year Celebration 2025!

title: 第一学期第三周活动照片
description:
Hi 家长们好！

本周幼儿们探索了不同情绪的脸，逐渐对不同情绪的表达及相应的华文词语：高兴、害怕、生气及伤心，有了进一步的理解和认识。也能尝试用不同颜色的心形表达不同的情绪等。老师提供多种材料并鼓励引导幼儿尝试创作自己喜欢的情绪脸谱，幼儿能发挥自己的创作力进行制作脸谱。

老师与幼儿一起探索了关于方位词语：上和下。老师展示了牙齿模型鼓励引导幼儿观察并认识上牙和下牙，然后提供玩具鼓励幼儿能利用小桌子为参照物，尝试听老师的口令进行展示玩具在桌子上面和下面，加深幼儿对上面和下面的理解，幼儿们能积极认真的参与活动。

蛇新年即将到来，幼儿们最近都能模仿说出：新年快乐！蛇年大吉！年年有余等，也能在老师的鼓励引导下尝试使用剪刀剪出自己喜欢的小蛇。

幼儿们也很积极的展示了自己的华文名字！可以看出幼儿们满脸的自豪感！展示出“我可以做到！”

在公园我们一起开心的运动！观察周围的自然环境，发现很多美丽的公鸡！

title: 亲子活动--听口令玩游戏，初步理解上与下
description:
Hi 家长们好！

这个星期我们初步探讨了方位--上与下，您在家里也可以跟您的孩子一起玩蹲下跳上的游戏。在游戏中，您可以借助桌子或其他物品作为参照物，桌子上面或高过桌子的物品所处的方位为上方，桌子下面或低于桌子的物品所处的方位则为下方。您可以跟您的孩子轮流给出口令，当喊出物品名称时，另外一方需要先判断该物品的方位，然后再做出相应的动作，上方的就跳起来，下方的则蹲下去。

title: T1W4 Album: “I Am Special” by Kiboomers
description:
“I Am Special” by Kiboomers

OBJECTIVES:
1. Children will be able to learn the lyrics of the song and follow the actions that corresponds to it
2. Children will listen and get to know the song “I am Special” with their friends.

The children were introduced to the song I Am Special by Kiboomers, where they learnt the lyrics and actions (e.g., I - point to yourself, You - point to a friend, we - everyone hold hands or hug) while emphasizing the importance of each child’s unique qualities. As children learn the song, they practiced singing together and take turns sharing what makes them special. 

This activity was conducted on 27 January 2025. 

Happy Chinese New Year!

title: K1 Term 1 Week 4 Weekly Updates
description:
For this week, children extended their drawing of their family members and proceeded to draw their own family members on piece of drawing paper. 

Once they have completed it, they will be cutting out the individual family members' drawing and will be pasting it on the family tree that they will draw independently.

Children continued to pick up new skills for their rock climbing lessons. For this week's session, they even got to try the various courses of the wall that became more challenging after each round.

Lastly, children continued their current issue discussion about climate change and were encouraged to draw the different ways that they could do their part to protect the Earth.
