title: January Week 4: Water and Pipette Transfer
description:
Learning objectives: 
1. Foster a beginning interest and curiosity in the natural environment through observation, exploration and play. 
2. Foster beginning Numeracy concepts through free exploration (basing measuring, counting, etc.)

Yesterday, the children had a delightful time exploring and discovering through a hands-on activity in class! They were given droppers filled with different coloured liquids, which they squeezed into containers, observing how the colours mixed together in fascinating ways. Their faces lit up with wonder as they watched the transformations and changes happen before their eyes.

In addition to the exciting visual experience, the children also counted the drops of liquid they added to their containers, helping to reinforce their numeracy skills in a fun and engaging way. This activity encouraged both observation and experimentation, and it was heartwarming to see their curiosity bloom as they explored the world of colour mixing and counting.

Date of activity: 27 January 2025

title: 第一学期 第二周：记忆翻牌游戏

教师和幼儿一起玩记忆翻牌游戏，翻牌时鼓励幼儿说出情绪名称并模仿对应表情，对于未找到匹配卡片的幼儿，鼓励其坚持尝试，完成任务。游戏结束后，教师带领幼儿围坐讨论，说说自己或朋友在什么情况下会感到高兴、伤心、生气或害怕。

title: Ringing the Prosperous Snake year 🐍🐍🐍
description: Using plastic cups, paper and bells, the children made a wind chime. From designing the cups to cutting spirals, the children did it all by themselves!

title: Term 1 Week 2: Match and Celebrate Pairs
description:
The children were invited to match pairs of objects presented to them. This activity provided an opportunity for them to grasp the concept of pairing and to explore the relationships between objects that are commonly paired together.

The teacher introduced the activity, The Talent Story Challenge  by discussing how everyone has unique talents and can solve problems in different ways. title: Term 1 Week 4
description:
This short but eventful week was filled with music, creativity, and festive celebrations as we embraced the spirit of Chinese New Year. We started the week on a joyful note by singing a song about our uniqueness. The children explored rhythm and coordination by using percussion sticks to accompany the song, making it an engaging and interactive musical experience. This activity encouraged self-expression and reinforced the message that everyone is special in their own way.

We continued preparing for Chinese New Year by putting the finishing touches on our decorative snake. The children took pride in their creations, adding final details with care and excitement. Through this activity, they deepened their appreciation for festive traditions and symbolism.
Returning from the celebrations, we reflected on the things the children can do now, especially during Chinese New Year. During journal writing, they shared their thoughts through their drawings—whether it was giving mandarin oranges, receiving red packets, enjoying television programs with loved one or eating with extended family. This activity helped them recognise their growing independence and the special moments they experience during this time.

This week was a wonderful blend of music, creativity, and celebration. We look forward to more exciting learning experiences in the coming weeks!

Have a Lovely Weekend!!

在新加坡，春节期间人们会带两只桔子用一个漂亮的袋子装着登门拜年；双数有吉祥的寓意，两只代表着“好事成双”；而临走的时候，主人家也会回赠客人两只桔子。
老师带着橘子来到学校，向小朋友们展示橘子，介绍这一传统习俗，接着老师并引导小朋友们尝试拿住橘子说出新年祝福：“新年快乐，大吉大利！”

title: 数一数，尝一尝
description:
老师给大家带来了橘子给小朋友们。首先，老师邀请小朋友们一起数一数橘子，看看有几个。小朋友们都看着老师的手指一个个点过橘子，跟着老师一起数数：“1，2，3，4，5……”有的小朋友还尝试自己用手指指着橘子来进行点数。接着，老师引导幼儿使用不同的感官来感受一下，小朋友们首先用鼻子闻了闻橘子的味道，，然后再鼓励大家自己动手剥橘子，尝一尝它的味道。小朋友们在老师的鼓励下都坚持自己剥开了橘子，体验到了亲手剥水果的乐趣。
在品尝过程中，小朋友们尝了一口，有的特别喜欢，开心地对老师说：“还要！”有的小朋友虽然不是很喜欢橘子的味道，但他们仍然在老师的鼓励下勇敢地进行了尝试，并且敢于表达自己的感受。老师鼓励大家勇于尝试不同的食物，每个人的口味都不一样，最重要的是不怕尝试，勇敢分享自己的体验！

title: 20-24 Jan
description:
Hello Parents!

Last week, the children worked on a fun snake craft as part of our Chinese New Year celebration. We used an egg carton as the base for the snake, and the children painted it in their favourite colours, which ended up blending into a rainbow of hues! It was wonderful to see their creativity come to life. The children will bring home their crafts after the Chinese New Year celebration on 12th February.

We also read a book about Chinese New Year traditions, discussing customs like cleaning the house. We used this opportunity to remind the kids about cleaning up our classroom by returning toys after playtime. The children learned about the animals of the Chinese zodiac and how their craft represented this year’s animal. They also picked up the phrase “Xīnnián kuàilè” while practicing the gesture of bringing their hands together.

title: 26-30 Jan
description:
Hello Parents!

Happy Chinese New Year! Wishing you all a prosperous year ahead!

Our snake craft has finally dried, and the children added eyes to their snakes using glue to stick it on the carton. They were so proud of their creations. We also revisited the book we read last week about Chinese traditions. To wrap up the activity, we played a fun game where the children had to find the red banners and “Fú” 福 signs around the school—and they spotted them all! We hope you liked the “Fú” decorations the children made with coloured pencil scribbles they brought in last Tuesday. 

We also revisited our lesson on big and small, and soft and hard concepts by using everyday items in the classroom. The children did very well by recalling the concepts and were able to identify and describe the objects!

Here are some photos of the children with the Chinese decorations, taken on New Year’s Eve.

title: 每周活动分享
description:
亲爱的家长们，春节快乐！本周我们和宝贝们一起度过了充实又特别的一周，因为迎来了华人新年也就是春节，整个班级都洋溢着欢乐的氛围。

本周教师带领幼儿阅读了故事绘本《好忙的除夕》，通过生动有趣的画面和故事内容，帮助幼儿了解除夕的传统习俗。宝贝们听得津津有味，对过年的期待又增添了几分。此外，我们还组织幼儿进行角色扮演，拿着两个橘子互相拜年，说些吉祥话祝福语。宝贝们在这个过程中不仅锻炼了语言表达能力，还感受到了新年的欢乐氛围和传统习俗的魅力，增进了彼此之间的情感交流。

在心理社会方面，教师组织班级幼儿进行了有意识的集体游戏。教师准备了大张麻将纸和彩色印泥，带领幼儿一起玩手印画。孩子们对手印画充满了好奇和热情，纷纷用小手蘸上印泥，在纸上留下了自己独特的手印。然后，他们在自己手印旁边贴上自己的照片和名字。完成后，引导幼儿轮流找一找自己和同伴的手印。这个活动不仅锻炼了孩子们的观察能力和交往能力，还让他们在集体活动中体验到了合作的乐趣，增强了自信心和归属感。

我们也一起进行了户外散步活动，并在游乐场丢球和踢球，促进宝贝们粗大动作的发展。孩子们在户外尽情地奔跑、玩耍，享受着阳光和新鲜空气。丢球和踢球游戏让宝贝们的手眼协调能力和身体控制能力得到了锻炼，他们在游戏中欢笑、追逐，释放了满满的活力。

短暂的一周结束了，接下来我们将围绕“我和我的身体”展开精彩探索活动。我们会通过各种有趣的游戏和活动，帮助宝贝们进一步了解自己的身体，培养他们的自我意识和健康生活习惯。让我们一起期待宝贝们在下周的活动中能有更多的精彩表现吧！

Teacher Karen

Term 1 Week 5: Family Hopscotch Activity
description:
Objectives:
1) Children will explore a creative twist on a familiar game.
2) Children will identify and discuss the printed words on the hopscotch grids.

In this activity, the traditional hopscotch grid were replaced with grids labeled with family-related activities instead of numbers (e.g., “Cooking,” “Playing Games,” “Gardening,” “Reading Together,” “Going to the Park”). 
The children then took turns picking a number and then hopped to the grid of the corresponding number. When they landed on a grid, the children attempted to read or recognize the word and match the words to the corresponding picture. To make the game more interactive, the children were also encouraged to act out or explain how their family does that activity. This activity encourages the children to try a new way of playing hopscotch, practice reading and recognizing words related to family life, and collaborate to manage turn taking and decisions about the game’s rules. 

This activity was conducted on the 3rd of February 2025.

title: Term 1 Week 5
description:
This week, the children explored textures while creating DIY Numicon pieces. They began by sorting a messy floor display of materials—bubble wrap, plastic sleeve bags, paper bags, cardboard, and envelopes—into groups based on texture (smooth, bumpy).

Using a paper punch, they cut circles from their chosen materials and pasted them onto rectangle-shaped paper, designing their own Numicon pieces. The next day, they continued making choices independently, fostering self-awareness and autonomy.

Together, the class completed Numicon tiles from 1 to 10, now proudly displayed in the classroom! It was a fantastic hands-on learning experience.

title: 前进的毛毛虫！
description: 老师准备好道具，邀请小朋友们通过互动与合作，体验一场既富有趣味又充满挑战的冒险之旅。活动开始时，老师在活动区域设置了各式各样的障碍物，旨在锻炼小朋友们的灵活性、平衡能力和协调性。小朋友们将呼啦圈组合成一条毛毛虫，在老师的引导下，通过模仿毛毛虫的前进方式，假装寻找不同种类的水果。每当毛毛虫“吃到”一种水果，它就变得越来越长，而小朋友们也在过程中逐渐学会如何稳住呼啦圈，保持团队的整体协调性。随着毛毛虫逐渐变大，遇到的障碍也随之增多，小朋友们在躲避障碍的过程中不仅锻炼了体能，还培养了团队合作意识和解决问题的能力。小朋友们积极地投入活动，在不断挑战自己的过程中，学会了保持平衡，协调身体，并不断尝试以更好的方式通过障碍，吃到更多的水果。在活动的过程中，小朋友们开始还需要老师的引导和帮助，随着他们掌握合作的技巧，他们可以走的更稳，即使毛毛虫变成了非常长的毛毛虫，他们都能够绕过老师布下的障碍，成功完成任务。

title: 《好饿的毛毛虫》
description:
老师和小朋友们一起分享绘本《好饿的毛毛虫》，看到毛毛虫吃了很多很多的水果，可肚子还是好饿好饿。小朋友们都觉得非常有趣，并且会跟着老师说：“毛毛虫的肚子还是好饿好饿呀。”当毛毛虫吃了很多的食物肚子痛的时候，小朋友会分享他们的经验：“不可以吃很多”“肚子痛”。在故事的最后，毛毛虫变成了漂亮的蝴蝶。小朋友们也开始的伸出双手假装飞翔的动作。并且随着老师唱儿歌《蝴蝶》的节奏挥舞双手。

小朋友们还一起学习了儿歌《好饿的毛毛虫》，家长朋友们在家也可以和小朋友们一起唱儿歌，做律动。

title: 小蛇蜕皮
description: 老师邀请小朋友们参与活动：小蛇蜕皮。小朋友们通过使用呼啦圈来模拟“小蛇蜕皮”的过程。小朋友们在老师的引导下将呼啦圈放在地上，模仿蛇的形态，借助呼啦圈的环形结构，逐步穿过它们，仿佛小蛇正在蜕去旧皮，迎接新的成长。这个活动不仅锻炼了小朋友们的灵活性和协调性，还促进了他们的身体感知和空间认知能力。大部分的小朋友们会双手拿住呼啦圈，然后穿过头顶。有的小朋友会将呼啦圈拉到身体后面，然后在放置呼啦圈时，又套回自己的身体。通过不断的重复探索，他们会尝试将呼啦圈拿起然后钻出来，将呼啦圈向前翻转套在路障上；或者脱掉呼啦圈后换手拿住呼啦圈……随着小朋友们不断重复穿越呼啦圈的动作，他们在享受游戏的过程中，也提高了身体控制能力和灵活度。

title: 绘本《好饿的毛毛虫》🐛
description: 教师为小朋友们带来一本有趣的绘本故事，首先是引导幼儿思考，毛毛虫是小小的还是大大的，小朋友们说是小小的，那么它如何才能长大呢？宝贝们说要吃饭～是的没错！让我们一起看一看毛毛虫都吃了什么好吃的呢。第一天吃一个苹果，第二天吃两个梨子，第三天吃三个李子，第四天吃四个草莓，第五天吃五个橘子，第六天吃了很多很多的东西，小朋友也会争先恐后的说自己喜欢吃什么。不过我们的毛毛虫最喜欢吃的还是叶子🍃，慢慢的毛毛虫长大了，给自己穿了一件棕色的衣服，最后变成了一只美丽的蝴蝶🦋

title: Field trip to Science Centre
description:
On Thursday, 6 February, the children visited the Science Centre, it is a significant experience as the children went on a field trip for the first time without their parents. Through the field trip, they learned skills such as following instructions, navigating public spaces, looking out for one another, and staying together as a group.

The field trip featured two main segments. The first was a workshop titled "A Fruitful Day," led by two farmers, Kylie and Bokie. The children discovered how different colored foods impact their bodies. They also learned various fruits and vegetables, they explored aspects such as texture and scent.

Following the workshop, the children enjoyed free play in an open area that included a dino pit for sand play, a supermarket, and a climbing space. We encouraged them to explore these spaces freely. Children were also encouraged not to lingering too long in one area to fully experience all the available activities.

title: RSGK-宝贝们运动起来！
description: 又到了我们快乐的锻炼时间，教练们为小朋友带来新的活动身体的游戏。第一个环节，模仿动物绕圈热身，本周我们会发现小朋友们模仿动物的样子越来越生动了，很清楚的可以看出在模仿大象长长的鼻子等。第二个环节，教练示范动作，将足球放在“小山”🏔上面，放稳后，抬起双手做准备动作，抬腿将足球向前方踢出。小朋友们两两一组，来感受我们的活动，在过程对于宝贝们比较难一点的地方在于将足球放稳在小山。第三个环节，推一推足球，小朋友一排做好，教练依次将足球在地面缓缓推给小朋友们，引导小朋友运用同样的动作将足球推给教练，每个宝贝都做的很棒🥰

title: Term 1 Week 5
description:
This week, we officially started a new routine with the children. During morning circle time, we encouraged them to write their names on a piece of paper. This activity helps them recognise the letters in their names and become familiar with letter forms. The children spent time using coloured markers to write and express themselves.

We also took time to teach the children how to use markers properly. They learned to be gentle with the marker nib, as too much pressure can damage it. Here are some helpful tips we shared:
•	“Put the cap back on after using the marker.”
•	“Place the cap on top of the marker while you’re using it.”
•	“Place your fingers near the tip of the marker.”
•	“Press the marker gently onto the paper.”

In math, we explored the concepts of "same" and "different." The children used dough to create three-dimensional shapes of similar and varied objects. Afterward, they observed each other's creations and shared only nice words about their friend’s work.
On Friday, we used the projector to share highlights from their trip to the science center!

title: 庆祝Lucian权峄的生日🎂
description: 大家一起为Lucian唱生日祝福歌🥳，伴着动听的歌声，开始切蛋糕啦🎂，宝贝们都很有耐心等待自己的蛋糕，拿到蛋糕后开始享用，甜甜的蛋糕沾在每个小朋友的嘴边，都显示出他们的快乐🥰美食让大家感到开心，美好的祝福氛围更是让我们沉浸其中～。Lucian和爸爸妈妈一起为小朋友们准备了礼物，我们都有感受到满满的心意💝

title: 舞狮
description: 通过阅读故事和了解中国传统习俗， 小朋友们主动要求配合着音乐来舞狮。

title: Thinker box enrichment class
description:
It was an exciting start for our little learners at Thinkerbox, as they dove into a fun and interactive first session!  The class kicked off with a blend of group and individual activities that not only sparked creativity but also honed essential skills.

One of the highlights of the day was focusing on listening skills and understanding the importance of following rule as part of the foundation for a productive and engaging learning environment. 

Through various visual and hands-on activities, the children were encouraged to use their fingers to trace along lines, helping them develop fine motor skills while strengthening their focus. This simple exercise also introduced numerals and various quantities, allowing the children to signify numbers by tracing and counting with their fingers. 

We can't wait to see how they grow in the upcoming sessions!

title: 🐝 Exploring Creepy Crawlies with a Fun "Pollen Transfer" Activity! 🌼
description:
This February, our little explorers at Thinkerbox are buzzing with excitement as we dive into the fascinating world of creepy crawlies! 🐞🐜 As part of our theme for the month, the children got hands-on with a pollen transfer activity inspired by the hardworking bees.

In this activity, the kids used tongs to carefully transfer "pollen" (represented by small yellow pom-poms) into bee hives, practicing precision and patience. This activity was a wonderful way to enhance their fine motor skills, helping them strengthen their hand-eye coordination while learning about the important role bees play in nature.

The children had so much fun mimicking the bees' process, gaining an appreciation for the wonders of the natural world!

title: 🦗 Interactive Creepy Crawlies Board Display 🐞
description:
We had a blast taking part in an interactive Creepy Crawlies Board Display!  The children were given the opportunity to decide where to place their creepy crawlies on the board, with each bug featuring its very own face attached; giving them a personal touch! 

As we move forward, we're excited to improvise and make this display even more interactive. Each week, children will be able to choose a new creepy crawly from a selection of paper cutouts. They'll indicate their favourite by pasting their face cutout over the creepy crawly they choose for the week, allowing them to explore different insects while promoting versatility in their learning. 

This activity not only sparks their curiosity but also encourages them to learn about a variety of creepy crawlies, one week at a time, making it a fun and ongoing exploration of the insect world!

title: Exploring Nature Through Creepy Crawly Lenses!
description:
Our little adventurers took their learning outdoors for a truly unique experience! The children participated in an activity where they brought out paper cutouts of various creepy crawlies, all part of our theme for the month. 

Armed with these cutouts and cardboard lenses, the children explored nature through a new lens, literally! They got to observe how the natural world around them serves as the perfect backdrop for these tiny creatures, enhancing their connection to the environment. As they looked through their lenses, they were amazed by how the creepy crawlies seemed to come to life against the outdoor scenery.

This activity was not only fun but also encouraged curiosity and an appreciation for the beauty of nature in all its tiny details. It’s a wonderful way to spark learning about creepy crawlies and the environment!

title: 照镜子游戏
description: 小朋友们将奥莉薇最喜欢做的事创编成动作， 通过聆听老师的指令来玩成照镜子的游戏。

title: 新年快乐，Happy CNY !
description: 各位家长朋友们新年快乐！在本周，我们开始探索我和我的身体的主题，在班级中，教师投放了大量的孩子们的生活照片，孩子们从照片中找出自己，认出朋友，通过这样的方式培养自我意识。身体发展中我们在老师的保护下进行了攀岩活动，这对四肢协调能力和肌肉力量是很好的锻炼，在中巴鲁公园的旅行中，我们进行了自然美发师的活动，我们捡了很多花和叶子，为自己或插或贴的完成了漂亮的头发，我们将作品陈列出来，孩子们很喜欢在作品前互相讨论分享自己是如何制作的。我们的新故事《从头动到脚》很好的让孩子们认识身体的各个部位，在这一个月中，我们会带领孩子们认识自己的身体，提升自理能力。

title: T1W5: Self-Portrait
description:
The children were invited to create self-portraits by making marks and using playdough. This hands-on activity allowed them to express their individuality through tactile experiences, combining the creativity of mark-making with the flexibility of playdough. After making their self-portrait, the children had the opportunity to share what they liked about their creations. 

Learning objectives:
- Children will observe how similar/different they are from their peers
- Children will cut dough with a cookie cutter or plastic knife.

The activity was conducted from 3 to 4 of February.

title: 每周活动分享
description:
尊敬的家长您好，
这一周是二月的第一周，我们二月份的探索主题是“我的身体” 。 这两个星期我们会和幼儿一起探索我们的身体部位，例如：头，手，脚的位置以及肚子的位置。
教师在活动中通过故事《从头动到脚》，鼓励幼儿模仿教师的动作，一起动动我们的身体部位，知道我们的身体部分可以做哪些运动。同时通过儿歌《头肩膀膝盖脚》鼓励幼儿和教师一起做律动，并且学习指认我们这些身体的部位，说出头，肩膀，膝盖，脚的位置在哪里。
在角落活动当中，教师也为幼儿提供了身体部位的拼图，让幼儿从拼图当中了解认识身体的部位。这一周我们去了中巴鲁公园游玩，幼儿第一次在没有家长的陪伴下独自活动，他们表现得非常的棒！他们牵着甜甜圈在公园里面散步，他们对公园里面的花草以及小公鸡，小狗很感兴趣，矗足在一边观看小狗们玩耍。他们也很享受在沙池里面玩沙。
这一周也进行了我们本学期的第一次户外郊游。相信在这次的郊游活动中幼儿和家长一起体会到了亲子游玩的乐趣，期待我们下次的郊游。 
下一周，我们会在农历十五元宵节 2 月 12 日 （星期三） 这天有一个庆祝活动，我们真诚邀请家长能够加入我们的活动，期待您的到来！

title: 情景表演---如果我生气了，你会怎么做？
description: 教师请幼儿谈谈父母平时如何照顾他们的情绪，同时幼儿也要学会用肢体动作和较连贯的语言来安慰家人。

title: 走走走
description: 我在努力的学习迈步向前走，相信我！我很快就会成功了

title: 鞭炮声声
description: 鞭炮声中一岁除，劈劈啪啪迎新年！

title: February Week 1: Navigating the Obstacle
description:
Learning objectives: 
1. Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, bend, kick, throw, etc.)
2. Foster curiosity and interest in a well-planned environment

This week, the children participated in a fun gross motor activity where they navigated through a simple obstacle course. They began by using their balance and coordination to walk across stepping stones, followed by lifting one foot at a time to cross over a pole. It was truly a joy to watch the children confidently work through each challenge, strengthening both their physical skills and their self-assurance. Their progress was evident, and they seemed to gain a real sense of accomplishment as they completed the course.

Date of activity: 6-7 February 2025

title: January Week 2: Obstacle Course!
description:
Objectives:
1) Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, climb on playground equipment, bend, kick, throw, etc).

The children eagerly tackled an obstacle course filled with exciting challenges, including jumping from a height, balancing, and climbing. They had an amazing time!

title: January Week 3: Throw it in!
description:
Objectives:
1) Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, climb on playground equipment, bend, kick, throw, etc). 

The children were encouraged to use their hands to throw the ball into a bowl. Some friends found it challenging due to the bowl's small size, but they stayed resilient and successfully completed the activity. They had so much fun!

title: January Week 4: Let's Draw!
description:
Objectives:
1) Foster an interest in art (drawing, painting, modelling, collage work, etc.)

The children explored the art space, selecting their favourite colours and eagerly scribbling on the mahjong paper. They also enjoyed sharing and discussing their drawings with friends.

title: February Week 1: Ball Hunt
description:
Objectives:
1) Foster curiosity and exploration.

Small balls were hidden all over the field, and the children were invited to search for and collect them. They successfully found all the balls and added their own creative twist by using a marker as a pretend bowl, imagining they were gathering ‘meatballs’.

title: Art exploration: Matisse's collage technique
description: This week, we explored Matisse's famous art pieces - 'The Sorrows of the King' and 'The Snail'. We talked about how Matisse used collage technique to create his artworks. The children tapped on the newly founded knowledge to create their Matisse-inspired artworks! :-)

title: Journal Friday: I like Van Gogh/Matisse's artwork because...
description: As we explored two vastly different artists and their artworks, the children sat down to reflect and share their thoughts on why they prefer one over the other.

title: Phonics: /fr/ sound
description: This week, the children were introduced to the beginning consonant blend - /fr/.

title: Blend of the week: /fr/
description: This week, we learnt the /fr/ beginning consonant blend. Please recap the words with your children!

title: Our N1’s First Field Trip of 2025! 🚍
description:
The Very Hungry Caterpillar Show brought to life Eric Carle’s beloved classics, including The Very Hungry Caterpillar, Brown Bear, Brown Bear, What Do You See?, 10 Little Rubber Ducks, and The Very Busy Spider, along with other familiar characters from his stories. 🐛🐞 Since these books were well-known to the children, they excitedly pointed out the animals and insects they recognised.
From the moment they boarded the bus, our children were filled with excitement, chatting eagerly with their friends on the way to the theatre. During the show, they demonstrated excellent audience etiquette, staying quiet and attentive while following the teacher’s instructions. They also expressed their appreciation and wonder for the performers, clapping enthusiastically at the end of each segment.

title: Ready, Steady, Go! ⚽️
description:
In this week’s RSG lesson, the children engaged in activities such as maneuvering around cones as different animals, playing soccer, and learning how to kick a soccer ball. They pretended to be animals like elephants, giraffes, crabs, and kangaroos while carefully navigating around cones placed in the middle. This activity encouraged creativity and imagination through role-play while also enhancing their motor skills, including tiptoeing, hopping, and spatial awareness.
Next, the children were introduced to a soccer ball and learned how to kick it. They stretched their arms out like an airplane for balance and used one leg to kick the ball. This exercise helped develop their coordination, balance, and motor skills. 👣

title: Activities we do
description: The class played a game of hopscotch and learnt how to read words like games, cook, swim, sports and etc. They took turns throwing a beanbag onto the hopscotch and hopped to that specific dot and attempted to read the word!

title: Textured numicon
description: Children helped to sort out different textured material - sparkly pipe cleaners, pipe cleaners, crepe paper, cellophane, and straws. They then chose a numicon of their choice and created their own version with the materials provided!

title: Activities we do II
description: Following the previous hopscotch activity, the class picked up a word from the list of words they have learnt and illustrated it out!

title: Weekly update
description:
This month, we are exploring the interest "All About Me," with a focus on body parts. The children were introduced to the story "Ten Little Fingers and Ten Little Toes" by Mem Fox. As they listened to the story, they wiggled their fingers and gave high-fives to their teachers. Some of the children even wiggled their toes, but their toes were hidden inside their socks, which led to an amusing reaction when they realized their toes weren’t visible!

The children were also introduced to the song "Head, Shoulders, Knees, and Toes" by Super Simple Songs. You can play this song at home and join your little ones in dancing along, transitioning from slow to fast movements. The children especially enjoyed the fast-paced part when they had to point to their body parts.

The children were invited to a body tracing experience. They lay down on a large piece of mahjong paper while the teacher traced their bodies. However, most of the children weren't quite ready to engage in the tracing experience this time. We will continue to encourage them next week.

Finally, the children shared photos from their Chinese New Year celebrations with their families. They were excited and curious as they showed their photos to their friends. Thank you to everyone for sharing such wonderful memories!

Happy Weekend!

title: Self-Portrait
description:
This week, the children continued their exploration of self-identity and their unique qualities by creating self-portraits using a variety of art mediums.

First, they were invited to observe their facial features in a mirror and share their observations. They then sketched their faces on paper, paying close attention to the details they noticed.

Next, they were provided with watercolors to paint their portraits. Once dried, the children personalize their artwork further by selecting either yarn or straws to represent their hair.

title: Numicon Colour Sort
description: The children were invited to sort Numicons by color, this time placing them into sections drawn with chalk. After identifying the colors and sorting the Numicons accordingly, they explored further by using the chalk to trace the shapes of the Numicons, draw, and decorate the different sections.

title: Term 1 Week 5: Textures Hunt
description:
Learning Objectives: 

• To explore and identify different textures in the environment and describe their attributes.

• To develop observational and sorting skills through group collaboration.

This week, we continued our exciting exploration of textures! We read The Mixed-Up Chameleon by Eric Carle, where the children made thoughtful guesses about the possible textures on the chameleon's body.

Following the story, we went on a texture hunt around the classroom. The children eagerly shared the different textures they discovered, describing attributes such as rough, smooth, bumpy, and soft. They then worked together to sort and match textures with their peers.

Date of activity: 7 February 2025

title: Candy House in the Mountain 《山间有座糖果屋》
description:
The children had an immersive experience watching the Mandarin play Candy House in the Mountain 《山间有座糖果屋, which engaged their sense of hearing.

The play featured a single talented actor who portrayed multiple characters, accompanied by a dedicated team responsible for creating captivating music and sound effects. An additional screen gave the children a behind-the-scenes glimpse of how the sounds were made — from splashing water and rustling leaves to the charming whistle of a bird.

It was a wonderful opportunity for the children to appreciate the creative elements that bring a story to life through sound and imagination!

title: Happy Birthday Jared!
description: Thank you for the goodies and cake!🎂🥳

title: T1W5活动
description:
这周是第五周，小朋友们对绘本一《奥莉薇》的学习内容和过程进行了总结。大家一起利用图片讲奥莉薇的故事、用棒偶进行角色对话，还一起创编故事“我的朋友奥莉薇”，并绘制一本自己的故事书。
小朋友们还总结了我们参观美术馆的学习成果，根据自己的参观体验总结出十条“参观美术馆行为规范”，并一起合作制作了一张海报。

title: 《菲菲生气了》故事排序
description:
幼儿从神秘箱中抽取一张故事图片，尝试用华语描述出图片上的内容，然后再根据图片的内容按照故事发展的顺序进行排序。通过活动能够锻炼幼儿对图画的观察能力，并用简短的句子来描述图片内容，还能加深幼儿对故事内容的理解。
小朋友们很厉害，他们能够合作并且按照正确的顺序完成故事排序。

title: 本周分享
description:
健弘分享了自己去马来西亚过华人新年在机场的经历。他说自己喜欢在机场玩，并比较了马来西亚的吉隆坡飞机场和新加坡的樟宜机场，觉得自己更喜欢吉隆坡飞机场，因为他在那里吃到了巧克力，樟宜机场没有卖巧克力的地方。当他这么说的时候，小朋友们纷纷发表意见说新加坡的樟宜机场也有很多巧克力卖，小朋友们对他在机场搭自动人行道很感兴趣。健弘说，吉隆坡机场的自动人行道很长，很好玩。姐姐跑的比他快，因为他要推行李车。
健弘还和大家讨论了能不能在机场喂鱼的事，因为他看到有人在喂鱼，但是鱼池边上的拍子写了“不可以喂鱼”。

title: 消气的方法
description:
幼儿学习儿歌《生气歌》，通过儿歌内容，大家一起讨论，当我们生气时，可以用哪些方法赶走生气的情绪。
幼儿们开动脑筋，想出了很多不同的方法，非常棒！最后幼儿在画纸上画出适合自己的方法。

title: 亲子活动--我会照顾好牙齿
description:
Hi 家长们好！

这个星期我们学习了如何做一个会照顾牙齿的好主人，孩子们也知道早晚要刷牙，吃饭过后要漱口，少吃糖等健康习惯。我们希望通过这些活动能帮助孩子们了解照顾好个人健康是对自己负责任的行为。您在家里也可以鼓励和提醒孩子们饭后和睡前要刷牙、漱口等。另外，我们也学习了儿歌《刷牙歌》，以下是儿歌歌词，您可以在家里和您的孩子一起复习儿歌。

幼儿们也带回家一个适合此年龄的牙刷及关于照顾牙齿的英文说明，请家长协助幼儿使用及讲解给幼儿相关的知识。多谢家长的支持与配合。

title: 蛇年美术作品
description: 在蛇年来临之际老师准备了一些美术材料如:马克笔，颜料，彩色纸等，鼓励幼儿观察蛇的形态用颜料画出蛇，鼓励幼儿画出不同的图案，鼓励幼儿用彩色纸来粘贴出一些新年元素如:红包，金元宝，橘子等。

title: 小小设计师
description: 在老师出示了奥莉薇不同穿着打扮的图片后,请幼儿一起讨论大家平时穿的衣服和装扮,老师提供了铅笔、剪刀、胶水以及废旧布料,鼓励幼儿发挥想象力,自由选择喜欢的材料进行创作,为自己设计衣服和鞋子.

title: 作品展示与分享《小小设计师》
description: 鼓励幼儿能主动用华语介绍自己的作品,如:自己使用了哪些材料,设计了哪款服装以及这样创作的原因。在欣赏同伴的作品时,鼓励幼儿分享他们对作品的想法和感受.

title: 我喜爱的活动
description: 教师带领幼儿玩照镜子的游戏,请幼儿通过"照镜子"的方式进行模仿一些幼儿们喜爱的活动如:画画、唱歌、跳舞、跑步等,之后,老师将句式"我爱..."写在白板上,鼓励幼儿使用句式来说说他们平时最爱做的哪些事以及为什么。

title: 最受欢迎的活动
description: 老师请幼儿回忆在上一节课中都说了哪些他们爱做的事,之后老师将这些事情记录在白板上,老师为幼儿分发3张小卡片鼓励幼儿画出自己的脸制作投票卡,鼓励幼儿从这些事情中选出三件自己喜欢的事情并投票,最后,老师引导幼儿以柱形图的形式来摆放他们的投票卡,鼓励幼儿用序数词来表示数量的顺序,如票数最多的为第一,依次为第二、第三...

title: Thinkerbox Enrichment
description:
The children had their first Thinkerbox lesson this week. In Thinkerbox, the children participate in activities that foster creativity, problem-solving, critical thinking, and hands-on learning. To kick off the lesson, they were introduced to a variety of prompt cards containing instructions such as "Sit Up Straight" and "Raise Your Hand." Each instruction was paired with a corresponding action to help the children remember and apply it. The children practiced each instruction until they were able to carry out the action without needing to refer to the cards.

In the second half of the lesson, the children were divided into two groups to engage in activities designed to enhance their problem-solving and critical thinking skills. One activity involved the children being shown picture cards with either a numeral or an image of a hand indicating the number. In the other activity, they were given a picture card with dotted lines of varying straightness connecting a car to a house. The task was for the children to trace the dotted lines from the car to the house using their fingers.

title: Nature as a backdrop
description: This month, we will be exploring creepy crawlies. For this activity, we were given cardboard cutouts featuring various creatures, such as a "snail," "bee," and "worm," to name a few. While outdoors, we were encouraged to observe how nature serves as a beautiful backdrop through the lens of these cutouts. Additionally, this provided a great opportunity to learn how nature also acts as excellent camouflage for these creepy crawlies.

title: 第一学期第五周 活动照片
description:
Hi 家长们好！

本周幼儿们学习了儿歌《刷牙歌》，幼儿们能在老师的鼓励下跟着老师一起念出儿歌句子，并能以小组形式围成圆圈在吹泡泡游戏的过程中跟着变换动作说出整个儿歌句子。希望家长能在家与幼儿一起复习此儿歌。

幼儿们在摸一摸猜一猜的游戏中认识了实物牙刷、牙膏及杯子，并在老师的鼓励引导下认识了其词语。也鼓励幼儿能大声的念出词语及拿着实物说出名称。幼儿们在角落游戏刷牙排序中尝试进行活动，逐步对刷牙步骤进行巩固。

title: Excursion to watch The Very Hungry Caterpillar Play
description:
We went on our first excursion of the year to watch the theatre production of The Very Hungry Caterpillar by Eric Carle. Everyone was filled with excitement as we boarded the big bus to head to the theatre. Upon arriving, we were amazed by the crowd of tourists gathered around the area, which made the experience even more thrilling. The theatre staff ushered us to our seats, and we were grateful for the booster seats provided, ensuring we had a clear and unobstructed view of the stage. We were also reminded that photos and videos were not allowed during the performance.

Once the lights dimmed, the play began, and we were immediately captivated by the four talented actors who brought the story to life with their animated expressions. We were pleasantly surprised to experience not just one, but four of Eric Carle’s beloved stories: Brown Bear, Brown Bear, What Do You See?, 10 Little Rubber Ducks, The Very Busy Spider, and of course, The Very Hungry Caterpillar. The stories were told in such an entertaining and lively manner, and with the help of large puppets, we couldn’t help but shout out the names of our favorite characters.

After the performance, we enjoyed a small snack before boarding the bus back to school, where we had lunch and a much-needed nap.

title: 二月 第一周：水中的事物
description:
活动目标：
1.通过玩水的活动，探索物品的沉浮。发展幼儿对材料属性的认知，养幼儿对科学概念的认识。

2.培养与他人分享的能力和尊重他人的意识。

活动过程：
教师准备了幼儿经常玩的玩具，邀请幼儿把玩具依次的放入水中，观察每个物体是浮在水面上，还是沉到水底。教师提出问题“为什么某些玩具会漂浮，而另一些玩具则沉到水底？”鼓励幼儿勇于探索答案，和朋友讨论。幼儿对水中的物体浮沉现象产生浓厚兴趣，教师简单介绍浮力的概念，让幼儿知道有些物体浮在水面是因为它们的密度较小，而有些物体沉下去则是因为它们的密度较大。通过操作和讨论，帮助幼儿理解浮力和物质密度的基本概念。


此活动于星期五进行。

The teacher introduced the concept of a "Community Talent Board" to celebrate each child’s talents and abilities. title: Family Activities Chart

Continuing with the theme "Things We Do as a Family", the children chose an activity they enjoy doing with their family and illustrated it on a drawing paper. After completing their individual drawings and labels, their artworks were placed side by side, creating a class chart to facilitate discussions about the similarities and differences in family activities.

This activity helps children appreciate the diversity of experiences within their class while building confidence in expressing their ideas both visually and verbally.

title: Rock Climbing

They had opportunities to climb different sections of the rock wall, starting with the easier ones and progressing to slightly more challenging ones. The children also learnt to recognize footholds and handholds by playing games such as running towards them and tapping the ones they could identify!

title: Term 1 Week 6 Album: Fingerprint Exploration
description:
OBJECTIVES:
- Children will use tools to help them focus on an object and define the characteristics they are observing
- Children will describe the lines (eg. straight, wavy, zigzag, dotted, spiral, thick, thin) that they see as they observe their fingerprints. 


This week, the teacher provided ink pads and paper for children to press their fingers onto, creating clear fingerprint impressions. Using magnifying glasses, children examined their fingerprints and compare the unique patterns with their peers, discussing swirls, loops, and lines. They then talked about the similarities and differences that they are seeing. Children also reflected on how each fingerprint is one of a kind, just like their individuality, and encouraged them to manage any frustration or excitement by taking turns and using kind words during comparisons.

This was conducted on 11 February 2025.

title: exploring the Letter Dd
description: In this lesson, the children focused on recognising and understanding the phonic sound of /d/, as well as identifying pictures that start with the letter Dd. We began with songs and stories featuring the Letterland character, Dippy Duck, to introduce the sound. The children sang the Dippy Duck song to reinforce the /d/ sound and then took part in an art activity, painting stamping toy animals such as dinosaurs, donkey, and dog on a “d” cut out.

title: Term 1 Week 6: “Kevin and His Dad” Story Leaves
description:
Objectives:
1) Children will visually depict selected scenes from “Kevin and His Dad” on their chosen leaves and rearrange these images to retell the story in their own words.
2)  Children will grip and manoeuvre markers or sponges steadily as they draw/paint on leaves.

During this activity, the children did a recap about their focus storybook, ‘Kevin and His Dad’ by Irene Smalls and discussed about the sequence of events in the story. Next, the children worked in pairs and used dried leaves to paint. After the paint had dried, the pairs chose to illustrated different scenes, characters, or symbols from the story using markers or child-safe paint. The children then gathered as a class to sequence the story leaves.

This activity was conducted from 11-12th of February 2025.

title: Exploring Sound
description: In our Curious Work lesson on exploring sound, children experimented with how different amounts of liquid inside glass affect the sounds they produce. Using a metal spoon and food coloring, they observed variations in pitch and tone. Additionally, they explored vibrations by tying a thread to a metal fork and bringing it near their ear, discovering how sound amplifies through vibration. These hands-on activities encouraged children to actively engage their sense of hearing in fun and meaningful ways.

华文演绎老师教导幼儿唱《狮子》儿歌，鼓励幼儿跟着老师一起唱出来，并随着儿歌歌词做出相应的动作。

老师出示小熊玩偶引起幼儿的兴趣，为幼儿读《是谁吃了我的大饼？》故事。过程中，老师扮演出动物们的动作，鼓励幼儿猜一猜是哪个动物吃了小熊的大饼（如：小兔子、老虎、小鸟等。），并鼓励幼儿一起复述问句‘’小兔子，是不是你吃了我的大饼？‘’来询问动物们是不是它们吃了小熊的大饼。此外，老师也鼓励幼儿们观察大饼上的齿痕，鼓励幼儿观察看看是哪个动物吃了大饼，并鼓励幼儿说出‘’一样‘’或‘’不一样‘’来表达自己所观察到的。

title: 参观全民牙科诊所
description:
带领中班幼儿参观牙科诊所是一个很好的实践体验，不仅能帮助他们减少对看牙医的恐惧，还能培养良好的口腔卫生习惯。
幼儿了解牙科诊所的基本环境和设备。
幼儿认识牙医的工作，减少对看牙的恐惧。
幼儿学习正确的刷牙方法和口腔护理知识。

参观牙科诊所：
认识环境：由牙医或护士带领孩子们参观，如候诊区、诊疗室等。
认识工具：牙医介绍牙镜、探针、洗牙机等基本工具，让孩子们观察（可提供玩具工具进行互动）。
体验环节：
让孩子坐上牙椅，感受升降功能。
观看牙齿模型，学习如何刷牙。
听听“牙医工具”的声音，如洗牙机的震动声。

刷牙演示：
牙医使用大牙齿模型演示正确的刷牙方法。

颁发小礼物和总结：
诊所可赠送牙科小礼物（如儿童牙刷、牙膏，还有退牙时，装牙齿的小牙盒）。
教师总结：“今天我们学到了什么？”“回家后要怎么保护牙齿？”

title: 出游 :  HUB 全民牙科诊所
description:
13/02/2025

     今天是 N2 Donaldson 的首次出游日：参观Q&M全民牙医诊所。首先我们参观牙医诊疗室，孩子们尝试躺在床上，体验自动升降椅，接着用特殊的吸管吸走水杯里的水，然后用大拇指体验特别牙刷的触感，紧接着牙医向孩子们展示牙齿模型，展示正确的刷牙方法：牙齿的外缘、凹槽、内侧都要兼顾，刷牙总时长不超过2分钟，还要记得漱口两次。最后，牙医诊所还为孩子们提供了免费的牙具旅行装以及可以装牙齿的项链。

title: 3-7 February
description:
Hi Parents!

This month, we started a new theme focusing on body parts. To help the children become familiar with their bodies, we sang songs like “Head, Shoulders, Knees, and Toes,” “Freeze Dance,” “Move to the Beat,” and “I Can Move My Body.” The children explored different parts of the face (ears, eyes, nose, cheeks, chin), mouth (lips, teeth, tongue), and hands (fingers, nails, wrists). They also had fun matching pictures of the same body parts, which they did with ease!

The children enjoyed playing outdoors, where they set up an obstacle course using hurdles and practiced jumping over them. They also had a great time at the park! The weather was perfect—windy and not too hot. The children collected natural items for their Chinese craft and worked on it with Laoshi. 

To top it off, they climbed up the hill, which was a proud moment as they explored a new elevated space and worked on balancing to avoid tripping or falling.

title: 《大大和小小》
description:
教师为小朋友们准备了绘本《好饿的毛毛虫》里面的大毛毛虫和小毛毛虫，大叶子和小叶子🍃，大蝴蝶和小蝴蝶🦋，还有几种水果。让我们的宝贝先回忆一下上周出去看的剧目还有印象吗？引导幼儿说一说小毛毛虫怎么样才能变大大，小朋友们说要吃东西，没错！

教师边唱儿歌边出示不同的水果照片🍎🍐🍓🍊，让幼儿看看哪个大，哪个小，小朋友们都回答的很棒，提问之后时候都能准确说出哪个水果是大大的，哪个水果是小小的，依次比大小后，再比一比叶子的大小，毛毛虫吃了它之后会变大大，会穿上棕色的衣服，最后变成了蝴蝶～引导幼儿说一说大蝴蝶和小蝴蝶，并感受它们是怎么飞的！在这个过程锻炼孩子们会比较大小的思维能力，让他们对大和小有了更进一步的理解😊😊

title: 绘本《蜗牛的小路》
description:
教师引导幼儿想一想蜗牛是怎么行进的，是飞飞还是爬爬呢？接下来我们一起看看蜗牛的小路是什么样子。这只蜗牛很不一样，它喜欢艺术，身上的壳是五颜六色🔴🟨🔷️🟢🔶️的，引导幼儿识别颜色并说出华语。

我们顺着蜗牛的小路继续往下走，出现了好多美丽的画作呀，我们一起欣赏画面中都有着什么，小朋友们会主动指出绘本中的事物，观察的很仔细，我们继续寻找属于蜗牛的画像，到了后面我们看到一副画面，是由不同颜色的色块组成的，引导幼儿说一说这是蜗牛的画像吗？经过比较画面的特点，我们找到了属于蜗牛的画面。

孩子们在过程中对艺术画作有了一个初始的视觉启蒙，对颜色的识别更加准确，能够更多的捕捉画面中的重点👍！

教师为小朋友们准备了蜗牛🐌身体的画纸和不同颜色形状的色块🪅，建立在我们已经共同阅读过绘本的基础，宝贝对五颜六色的蜗牛壳也很感兴趣，接下来就让小朋友们自己动手拼一拼，贴一贴。
教师引导幼儿选择自己喜欢的色块，然后进行粘贴，给蜗牛拼上独一无二的壳，每个宝贝都特别有自己的想法，很认真仔细的用小手操作🥰。在过程中培养孩子们的想象力和创造力，发展手指的精细动作！

title: February Week 2 Weekly Highlight: Traffic Light Craft
description:
Objective: Foster an interest in art 

The children were invited to create their own traffic light craft using red, yellow, and green paint! With paintbrushes in hand, they eagerly got to work, transforming plain paper plates into bright, colourful signals. Some carefully dotted their brushes around the plate, while others experimented with different strokes and movements. A few were especially curious about the texture of the paint, gently touching it with their fingers or even painting on their own hands before continuing their masterpiece. It was really lovely to see each child fully immersed in the process, exploring the paintbrush and the colours of the traffic light while having fun with art!

title: 精彩活动——第一学期第六周
description:
10/02/2025——14/02/2025

  本周K1 Bailey的精彩活动从语言斗和来创造两个领域出发，围绕绘本《朱家故事》展开。旨在通过绘画与故事讨论培养幼儿的书写与绘画技能。幼儿在活动中将学习正确握笔，并熟悉不同绘画工具的使用，如铅笔、蜡笔和马克笔。

  活动以《如果妈妈不在家，你会做什么？》为主题，教师通过故事复述、提问与讨论，引导幼儿思考妈妈不在家时可能发生的事情及其影响。幼儿分组讨论并以长轴画的形式合作创作，表达自己的想法。同时，活动强调团队协作、责任感与表达能力，在完成作品后，幼儿共同展示并整理工具。

title: Term 1 Week 6 Weekly Highlight
description:
This week, the children engaged in a Splatter Painting & Sorting Activity, combining teamwork, exploration, and creativity.

In small groups, they hunted for related objects such as writing tools (rulers), art tools (paintbrushes), and toys (Unifix cubes). These items were then used to create splatter effects in their painting. Before starting, we discussed how to take turns so that everyone could experience different tools and techniques together.

Through this hands-on activity, the children explored how different tools create unique splatter effects, experimenting with movement, pressure, and paint application. This experience encouraged problem-solving, collaboration, and sensory exploration, while also reinforcing turn-taking and respect for shared materials.

title: 华文拾趣《朱家故事》
description: 这个星期我们一起共读了绘本《朱家故事》，绘本里面朱太太太忙了！她既要洗碗，又要做饭，又要熨衣服，还要吸地板，负责照顾朱先生和两个儿子。当朱太太不在家时，家里变得脏脏的，乱乱的。这个周五我们讨论了，我们可以帮妈妈做些什么呢？我们可以帮妈妈叠衣服，可以帮妈妈洗碗等等，并尝试写一写妈妈这两个字。

title: Weekly Update
description:
Hi Parents!

This week, the children continued exploring the different parts of their bodies, focusing on body parts like legs, feet, toenails, ankles, stomach, and back. They were also able to recall the body parts we learned about last week and felt very proud when asked to point to them on their own bodies.

description: 教师准备好彩色颜料、海绵拍、保鲜膜、假眼睛、彩纸、棉棒若干。老师邀请幼儿一起制作情绪小怪兽。介绍材料，请幼儿自由选择自己喜欢的颜料，挤压在卡纸上，盖上塑料薄膜。在用小手或海绵拍按压拍打。在把保鲜膜撕开，使用棉棒给彩色怪兽造型，在粘贴小怪兽的眼睛嘴巴。一只只活泼可爱的小怪兽就做好了。

title: weekly update
description:
Another fun week has passed for the little ones! They continued their body tracing activity, and this time, they were encouraged to color their tracings using crayons and hand stamps.

They also enjoyed a game with "peek-a-boo friends," where they opened lids to reveal and identify pictures of their friends. As the children are still building relationships with their peers, this experience helped them recognize their friends within the classroom.

Additionally, the children explored different types of containers. Some were focused on opening the lids, while others enjoyed stacking them. It was amazing to see how engaged and focused the little ones were during this exploration. This activity is a great way to keep your little ones busy at home as well!

The children were also invited to participate in a gross motor activity, where they had fun popping bubbles by jumping and running.

Lastly, the little ones were introduced to a new rhyme titled “All of Me.” While listening to the rhyme, they were encouraged to perform different actions such as clapping their hands, hugging tightly, and more. You can find the rhyme in the album.

title: Apple pie
description:
教师为小朋友们带来一个有趣的故事。我们的小熊朋友发现自己的曲奇🍪被咬了一块，他想知道是谁吃了它的饼干，请小朋友们一起找一找！
教师分别出示不同的动物，观察它们的牙齿跟被咬曲奇是否一样呢？有小鸟🕊、有老虎🐅、有河马🦛等不同的动物，发现都不是这些动物吃的。
最后教师引导幼儿发现，曲奇上的牙印跟小熊自己的一样，原来是它在睡着的时候不小心吃了一口。在趣味的故事中，促进幼儿观察力的发展。

很开心再次回到班级中，昨天是我最近一段时间以来最最最开心的一天❤️ 很想念大家，我们从户外玩到室内，开心的度过了幸福而美好的一天！

title: Learning with Playdough: Extending the Caterpillar! 🐛
description: In this fun activity, children use playdough to create small round shapes to extend the body of a caterpillar, with its head already printed on the card. As they roll and count the playdough balls, they practice one-to-one correspondence and early counting skills. This activity also helps develop fine motor skills, and concentration.

title: Creating Our Dramatic Corner: The Bee Hive Adventure! 🐝
description:
In this exciting painting activity, the children are stepping into the role of beekeepers! They’ll be painting a large box to represent a huge bee hive, using honeycomb patterns to bring the space to life. This is Phase One of creating their very own dramatic play corner, where they will soon become protectors of the bees in their imaginative world.

As the project unfolds, there will be plenty more fun additions to the dramatic play area, bringing even more opportunities for role-playing, and exploration. We can't wait to see how their dramatic play corner develops! 

Do stay tuned for more updates as this exciting adventure continues!

title: Exploring Visual Discrimination with Thinker Box!
description:
This week, they are honing their visual discrimination skills—learning to observe and distinguish between different colours and patterns. This activity encourages them to pay close attention to details, helping to strengthen their cognitive abilities and problem-solving skills.

By engaging in this fun, hands-on activity, the children are not only improving their focus and attention to detail, but also laying the foundation for more complex tasks in the future.

title: Butterfly Craft with Cake Filters!
description:
Our little artists are having a blast creating their own beautiful butterflies using cake filters! The process starts with children scribbling various shapes and patterns onto the cake filter with colourful markers. Once the design is complete, they drop some water onto the filter paper, watching in awe as the ink spreads and creates a stunning, blended effect across the paper. 

The filter paper were then folded in a pleated manner, and voilà— they’ve got the wings of a butterfly! To complete their masterpiece, pipe cleaner were then added to form the butterfly's body, bringing their creation to life.

This craft activity not only sparks creativity but also introduces children to the fascinating concept of how colours can blend and spread when water is added. It's a fun, hands on way to develop their fine motor skills and understanding of cause and effect.

title: Diaper Bag Success!
description:
We’re excited to share that the children are now able to take their own diapers from their personal diaper bags! This small yet significant milestone allows them to feel a sense of self-reliance and independence as they begin to take ownership of their routines.

Thank you to all parents for preparing a separate diaper bag for your child. This thoughtful preparation has made it possible for the children to practice this new skill and take an active role in their daily care. It’s amazing to see them becoming more confident in managing their personal needs, and we’re so proud of their progress!

title: 🎉 Happy 3rd Birthday, Kieran! 🎂
description:
Wishing the happiest of birthdays to our wonderful Kieran, who has now turned 3 years old! It’s been such a joy watching you grow, learn, and bring so much fun to our classroom.

在庆祝新年的活动中，小朋友们与家长一起进行写“福”字的活动，包汤圆，煮汤圆，吃汤圆，让小朋友们很开心，最兴奋地是小朋友们和家长欣赏了舞狮表演，热闹又喜庆。

description: This week, Max and Zac shared about their favourite item and favourite activities during the weekend. Max talks about his cat boy costume, and Zac shared that he enjoys playing with his ball with his family.

title: 体能活动中的竞技与合作
description:
小朋友们自由选择同伴，进行比赛
比赛规则：1.身体平躺将头顶的呼啦圈依次套在锥形标记上。
                  2.双脚和一只手支撑身体离开地面，单手将呼啦圈依次套在追星标记上。
                  3.和同伴一起将两个呼啦圈用肚子顶住呼啦圈移动至锥形标记处，并且不可以同手扶着，也不能坠落。

小朋友们能够理解游戏规则并且具有遵守规则的意识，看到小朋友犯规也能够提醒朋友和老师，当朋友落后的时候也主动的帮朋友喊加油。在最后的合作中小朋友也能够和对方沟通和商量，例如：“有点远、在那边、小心”等等。当所有活动完成的时候一起分享喜悦相互击掌。

通过游戏和活动小朋友们体验到在活动中的角色的转变，也感受到个人竞技和团队合作的不同，可以通过沟通，分享自我感受到方式培养幼儿的团队意识、表达能力和社交能力。

title: 《逃家小兔》
description:
我们开启了新的绘本故事书《逃家小兔》，绘本讲述了一只小兔子对它的妈妈说：“我要跑走了！”妈妈却回答他“你要是跑走了，我就去追你，因为你是的我小宝贝呀！”。于是小兔子想象自己变声小鳟鱼，妈妈说，那我就变成捕鱼的人来抓你，小兔子变成石头，妈妈就变成爬山的人... ...无论小兔子变程什么，妈妈总能找到它，于是小兔子就只能乖乖的回家了。

老师和小朋友一起模仿故事中小兔子和兔妈妈的角色，当小朋友扮演想做鱼的小兔子时，老师便扮演捕鱼的兔妈妈，去抓小兔子。在游戏的过程中，小朋友们感受“逃”的意思和感受，并且能够匹配小兔子和妈妈扮演的角色，理解角色之间的因果关系。

小朋友分享：“因为兔妈妈很爱小兔子，所有无论小兔子变成什么，兔妈妈都能找到它。”、“兔妈妈很爱它”、“我们做太阳、老师做云朵，要把我们遮起来”等等。

title: English Speech and Drama 🎭
description:
For this week’s drama lesson, the children began with a movement game, pretending to be different animals while following the instructor’s singing and guidance. They crawled like cats, slithered like snakes, flew like birds, and even swam like sharks!
Next, they met a new friend, Holly the owl! The children were thrilled to have a new furry companion in class and eagerly played airplane games and hide-and-seek with Holly. They also practiced phonetic syllables starting with the “p” sound, reinforcing their early language skills.
To wrap up the lesson, they gathered for a short story-reading session, bringing a fun and engaging end to their imaginative adventure.

title: Ready, Steady, Go! 🏃🏻‍♀️➡️
description:
This week’s lesson built upon last week’s skills, focusing on soccer and kicking. As always, the children began with their warm up, practicing animal walks around cones. This activity not only gets them moving but also enhances their spatial awareness as they navigate around obstacles.
For the soccer component, the instructors introduced a new challenge, the running kick! In this activity, children practiced their gross motor skills by running a short distance and coordinating their movements to kick a ball off a cone. The excitement was contagious as they eagerly took on the challenge, laughing and smiling alongside their friends. It was a fantastic session filled with energy, growth, and fun!

title: 第一学期第六周 活动照片

Hi 家长们好！

首先温馨提示：关于庆祝华人新年活动照片和参观科技馆的照片已经放进Even Management ，家长们可以进去欣赏活动照片了。

本周幼儿们在公园中欣赏落叶及拿着小桶收集喜欢的叶子和树枝，还赤脚走石头路体验感受脚底被按摩的不同感觉。幼儿们愉快的在大自然中体验感受，开心极了！

title: 亲子活动--与幼儿一起分享故事《猜猜我有多爱你》
description:
Hi家长们好！

   说：“我更爱你！”小兔子为了表示自己的爱会胜过大兔子的爱，它想尽办法，用各种身体动作、看得见的景物等来描述自己

title: Term 1 Week 6: Global Art
description:
Learning Objectives: 

•  Children will explore and create artworks inspired by global cultures, appreciating the talents and skills involved in creating them. 

Our classroom transformed into an "International Art Museum," where the children explored various art styles from different cultures. They were introduced to famous artistic techniques such as Aboriginal dot painting, African tribal masks, Mexican papel picado, European impressionism and Abstract.

Through this experience, the children learned that art is not just about creating something beautiful but also a way to express ideas, emotions, and stories. They discussed the different skills required for each style—patience in creating intricate patterns, boldness in selecting colours, or storytelling through symbols.

Inspired by the artworks, the children were given an opportunity to create their own mini masterpieces. Many naturally gravitated towards impressionism, abstract painting, dot painting, and papel picado, experimenting with colours, textures, and patterns to bring their artistic visions to life.

Date of activity: 11th February 2025

description:
小朋友们从这周开始学习第二本绘本故事《逃家小兔》。大家通读故事后，玩“故事接龙”游戏熟悉故事内容。在熟悉了故事内容基础上，大家讨论一些有关的问题，如“为什么小兔要离家出走呢？”、“小兔为什么要变成不同的东西逃走？”、“为什么妈妈总是能变成比小兔更厉害的东西来抓住小兔？”等等。在学说故事的同时，小朋友们还通过游戏的方式学认读词语和用词语说句子，并在“华文拾趣”本上画出自己最喜欢的故事画面。
这周，小朋友们在中巴鲁公园散步的时候，发现了一个好玩的问题。他们发现一棵大树的主干上“长”了很多和树枝上不同的树叶。回来后，大家就这个问题进行了一番讨论，通过仔细观察图片发现，原来这些树叶不是长在树干上，而是长在一根爬在树干的藤上。
在周五总结这周活动时，大家一起回顾了所学过内容，并在自己的“华文拾趣”本上用绘画的方式记录下来和大家分享。

title: 本周动态分享
description: 很开心可以和大家一起度过一个欢乐的元宵节，我们的新年也正式结束了，本周在我和我的身体的章节，我们来到了认知自己的五官和身体部位的步骤，通过游戏、绘本、儿歌等等方式带领幼儿认识自己的身体部位的名称，《身体音阶歌》和《头肩膀膝盖》这两首儿歌成为孩子们十分喜欢的两首儿歌，现在很多幼儿已经能够准确的指出自己的身体部位了，在本周的《从头动到脚》故事的阅读中，孩子们会在跟着故事情节大喊：“这个我会！”并跟随故事情节做出相应的动作，我们从更多不同的故事书中找到不同的五官，也找到自己的五官。在下周我们会慢慢的开始进行“我的五种感官”的主题，为孩子们提供更多的材料，帮助孩子们体会自己的五种感官，增加对自己的认知。

title: Buzz..Buzz... Little Bumble Bee! 🐝
description:
We learned a new song to enhance our exploration of bees! With its simple, cute, and catchy tune, we quickly picked up the lyrics and dance moves. The song has become a favourite, and we often request to hear it throughout the day. You can join in the fun and sing along with us at home by following this link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8rSa6QL4aPY&ab_channel=CedarmontKidsVEVO.

In addition to singing, we discovered fascinating facts about bees! We learned that they live in beehives, create honeycombs, and play a vital role in transferring pollen from flowers to make honey. To bring this to life, we took on the role of little bees, carefully carrying pollen from flowers to the hive. Using tweezers, we picked up small pompoms, transferring them with precision before placing them into the individual holes of the honeycomb. This hands-on activity not only deepened our understanding of bees but also helped strengthen our fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. 🐝

title: RSGK - Running kick ⚽
description: In RSGK, we practiced our running kick, focusing on coordination, balance, and accuracy. We began by warming up our legs with dynamic movements before progressing to the main activity. Taking turns, we ran towards the ball with controlled speed and aimed to kick it forward using the inside of our foot. Throughout the session, we encouraged one another, celebrating successful kicks and making adjustments when needed. This activity not only helped us develop our gross motor skills but also built our confidence in handling sports equipment and understanding movement dynamics.

There were lots of challenges, frustration, difficulties.. But I'm proud to say that the K2 children overcome these odds and created a chair that they're proud of! :)

title: 每周活动分享
description:
Hi，大家好呀，又到了和大家分享宝贝们本周精彩活动的时刻！本周我们继续围绕“我的身体”这一兴趣主题，开展了一系列丰富多彩且富有意义的活动，孩子宝贝们在欢乐中学习，在探索中成长。
在本周的活动中，我们和宝贝们一起深入了解了自己的身体。通过生动有趣的儿歌《头、肩膀、膝盖、脚》和《一根小手指》，大家一边欢快地唱着歌，一边用小手准确地指出自己身体的各个部位。每一次的互动都充满了欢声笑语，宝贝们在轻松愉快的氛围中，认识了头、肩膀、膝盖、脚、肚子、手指和脚趾等身体部位，对自己的身体有了更直观的认识。
我们还一起探索了身体能够做出的各种动作。从简单的伸展、弯曲，到复杂的蹦跳、旋转，宝贝们尽情地展示着自己身体的灵活性。在这个过程中，他们不仅锻炼了肌肉力量，还提高了身体的协调性和平衡感。
精细动作的训练也是本周的重点内容之一。我们准备了不同颜色洞洞的纸盒，以及不同颜色的绒球，让幼儿用手捏住绒球，把绒球塞进洞洞里面。也准备了各种大小不同的瓶子，带领幼儿玩拧瓶盖游戏。 宝贝们全神贯注地用小手完成每一个动作，虽然一开始可能会有些笨拙，但在不断的尝试和练习中，他们的小手越来越灵活，精细动作能力得到了很大的提升。
本周的美工活动中，我们为宝贝们们准备了喷壶、彩色颜料和厚纸巾，让他们用独特的方式进行美术创作。孩子们发挥自己的想象力，将彩色颜料装入喷壶，然后对着纸巾喷射。瞬间，一幅幅色彩斑斓、充满创意的美术作品就诞生了。看着自己的作品，孩子们脸上洋溢着自豪和喜悦的笑容。
天气晴朗的日子里，我们带着孩子们来到二楼的户外游乐场，开启了一场清凉的玩水之旅。我们一起在水池里捞小鱼，一起撩水嬉戏，感受着水花飞溅的快乐，笑声回荡在整个游乐场。除了玩水，我们还一起把水灌入各色水壶去浇花。我们也一起玩起了泡泡。当五彩斑斓的泡泡在阳光下飞舞时宝贝们兴奋地追逐着、欢呼着。他们用小手去抓泡泡，看着泡泡在手中破裂，感受着大自然的奇妙。在这个过程中，宝贝们不仅享受了户外的新鲜空气和阳光，还培养了观察力和想象力。
通过本周的活动，宝贝们在身体认知、动作发展、创造力等方面都取得了很大的进步。让我们一起期待下周精彩继续吧！

Teacher Karen

title: Fingerprint observation
description:
As part of their ongoing exploration of themselves and their uniqueness, the children were invited to observe their fingerprints. They began by pressing their fingers onto an ink pad and making prints on a sheet of paper. Afterward, the teacher encouraged them to compare their prints with their friends and share how each one was unique. Questions such as, “What do you see in your fingerprint?” and “How do your fingerprints look different from your friend's?” guided their observations and sharing

title: Term 1 Week 7: Family Science Fun: Making Ice Cream Together
description:
Objectives: 
1) Children will illustrate and describe the changes they observed during the experiment
2) Children will use descriptive words (e.g., “cold,” “melting,” “shaking”) to explain each step of the process and the results of the experiment.

The children participated in a hands-on science experiment that replicated a fun family activity: making ice cream. The experiment demonstrated how liquids turn into solids through freezing. The children combined cream, sugar, and vanilla in a small resealable plastic bag and then placed it inside a larger bag filled with ice and salt. They shake the bags for a few minutes to create ice cream. The children received mixed results; some of their ice cream froze, and they enjoyed a yummy treat, while some did not shake the bag enough; hence, it could not harden as intended. Nevertheless, all the children enjoyed their ice cream/milk shake and said it was yummy and creamy! 

This activity was conducted on 18th of February 2025.

title: How Tall Am I?
description:
After listening to the story Titch by Pat Hutchins, the children were invited to share how they had grown since they were babies. They enthusiastically expressed their thoughts, saying, "I am bigger," "I grow tall," "I'm not a baby," and "I am a big boy/girl."

Building on this discussion, the teacher introduced an activity where the children would measure their height using a piece of string. Each child was guided to lie down on the floor while the teacher assisted in cutting a string that matched their height.

Next, the children were provided with Numicon pieces, and their peers were encouraged to help measure their height by placing the pieces one by one from head to toe, counting the total number together. As part of their ongoing exploration of the question "How Tall Am I?"The children used their measured strings to compare heights. They observed differences in length, engaged in discussions about who was taller or shorter, and shared their observations. Finally, they placed their strings beneath their photographs as a visual representation of their height.

title: Alexandra Park Connector Walk
description:
Hi Parents,

On Thursday, the children embarked on their first walk to Alexandra Park Connector, and it was a success! They followed their teachers closely, remained quiet, and stayed alert while crossing the roads.

During the walk, we took time to observe the traffic lights—watching them change from red to green—and discussed how both pedestrians and motorists responded. The children quickly noticed that some people crossed the road even when the light was red. They were eager to intervene, which led to a discussion about road safety. 

We explained that while crossing on a red light is unsafe, it is not our place to correct others directly. Instead, we focused on reinforcing safe road habits for the children themselves. This was also an opportunity for them to learn the term "jaywalking," and some even shared that their parents do it too (oops!). We encouraged children to gently remind family members to practice safe road habits.

As we continued observing the traffic lights, the children noticed how the lights transitioned from red to green, followed by a flashing green light with a countdown. They learned that the flashing green light signals that they should speed up slightly, as the light will soon turn red.

On our way to the park, we introduced the concept of shared spaces, explaining that the boardwalk is used by everyone. Since we were a large group, we reminded the children to be considerate by giving way to others and expressing gratitude when others made space for us. Through this, we reinforced the importance of good manners in public spaces.

In this album, you will find photos of children observing traffic lights, watching children play from Alexandra Primary School, and greeting two safety officers who were on the boat (which they attempted to chase after). 

Though it was just a short walk to Alexandra Park Connector, it provided the children with many authentic learning opportunities.

We hope that you can also reinforce safe road habits when out with your child. Starting young helps them develop lifelong habits to keep themselves safe.

Thank you!

Regards,
Debra

title: 周活动——第一学期第七周
Weekly Update
description:
Hello Parents!

This week, we continued our arts and crafts focused on “My Body.” We added details like eyes, nose, mouth, and hair, using torn newspaper. Some children had fun tearing the paper, which is great for developing fine motor skills. You can try this activity at home if your child enjoys it – it will keep them busy for about 10 minutes. All you need is some newspaper (easier to tear), glue, and a piece of paper to paste the torn pieces!

We also discussed how our eyes, nose, ears, and mouth help us every day. We used phrases like, "I use my eyes to see the birds," "I use my ears to listen to the birds singing," "I use my mouth to taste and eat my food!" and "I use my nose to smell yummy food!" This helps the children remember the phrases and expand their vocabulary while learning to speak in short sentences.

Additionally, the children have been very imaginative in their pretend play. For example, they might say, “We are riding the bus to go to work/office” (using kitchen plates as they pretend to drive a car), “Mummy will fetch you later, okay?” “This is your coffee. I made you coffee,” or “There’s a fire! I am a fireman!” (using tubes in the playground to pretend to spray water).

title: 说说我们的华文名字

教师为小朋友们准备了每个人的头像和英文名中文名，今天我们一起来看看宝贝们能知道自己的华文名字吗？

教师请小朋友们先看照片，这是谁呀，有好多小朋友会抢答说出这个朋友的英文名，那么他/她的中文名会知道吗，经过引导和教师重复示范，小朋友们有认真聆听和重复其他有幼儿的华文名字，宝贝们都很棒👍👍，最后教师说出一个华文名字，请这个小朋友举手示意，可以把姓名头像卡片带回家哦，小朋友们都很积极，回家后也希望和爸爸妈妈说一说自己的华文名字。

title: 寻找小蜗牛🐌
description:
活动开展如下：经过倾听绘本和制作蜗牛的壳，幼儿对蜗牛的兴趣仍然存在，我们一起去户外找一找蜗牛在哪里呢！

教师引导幼儿想一想，蜗牛喜欢在什么地方玩呢？是飞飞的高高还是爬爬的低低的地方，小朋友们现在知道是爬的低低，所以我们一起蹲下来找一找看一看，转动闪亮的小眼睛搜索蜗牛的踪迹🤩。
过程中宝贝们找的特别认真，用小手指出来，让其他朋友一起看看，我们想要找到更多，不过由于最近的天气晴朗，没有下雨☔，所以蜗牛不爱出来呢，没关系，下次我们再来跟蜗牛打招呼把！

在活动中，锻炼幼儿的观察能力和细心耐心的品质，还能初步了解蜗牛在什么天气条件下爱出来玩。

title: 《夹出毛毛虫》
description:
教师为小朋友准备了有洞洞的纸盒，上面放置了一些“毛毛虫”，并且提供一些镊子可以让幼儿使用。
教师先做示范，使用镊子夹住毛毛虫，让它能够出来。再请小朋友们依次尝试，在刚开始的时候会出现对不准的情况，经过鼓励，宝贝们可以夹住毛毛虫啦，再多进行几次尝试，宝贝们的动作越来越快，夹的又快又准，很棒哦👍👍

在活动中锻炼幼儿的手眼协调能力，发展手指的精细动作。

title: 《行进的毛毛虫》
description:
教师为幼儿准备了若干呼啦圈⭕️和障碍物🔺️，我们一起来体验一下毛毛虫如何从小小变大大行进的。
首先教师做示范，和其中一个小朋友配合串成一条短短的毛毛虫行进，幼儿都很感兴趣，开始正式活动。
我们的毛毛虫队伍变长了一点，有三个小朋友，大家开始行进的时候没有着急走的很快，遇到障碍物知道要避开，和前后的朋友配合的很好😊。随后我们增加难度，四个小朋友五个小朋友一起串成一条长长的毛毛虫，需要有幼儿注意前后朋友走路的速度，不能太快可能会摔倒，也不能过慢可能会在转弯处停住，需要保持均匀的速度。整体我们的宝贝做的特别好，出发前拿好自己的呼啦圈，出发后在行进过程中顺顺利利，转弯的时候大家一起配合，为小朋友点赞🥰🥰🥰

在活动中锻炼了幼儿的团队协作能力，学会和其他朋友一起完成任务。

title: 户外活动-寻找树叶🍂🍃
description:
到了我们呼吸呼吸新鲜空气的时间⏰️，教师带领幼儿去大自然里走一走，在过程中我们听到了鸟声，叽叽喳喳，还循着声音看到了好几个黑色的小鸟在树上。目光往下移动，请我们的小朋友看看地上有没有树叶呢？
转动闪亮的眼睛找一找哪里有树叶，很快小朋友们找到一个又一个，并捡起来让大家看一看，每个宝贝都找到自己想要捡的树叶，最后我们让树叶“回家”，掉落的叶子还可以成为土壤新的养分哦

在过程中锻炼幼儿的观察能力，促进孩子们寻找关键事物的能力！

title: Loose Parts Bunny Run
description: In this activity, children explore placing various loose parts into tunnels decorated as bunnies, with different tunnel sizes inviting experimentation with shapes and dimensions. They enjoy using heavier objects like large stones, noticing the sounds produced as they roll through. This activity fosters hand-eye coordination, spatial awareness, and problem-solving as children determine which objects fit. It also encourages sensory exploration through different textures, weights, and sounds, promoting curiosity and engagement in open-ended play.

title: Scoop and Play Exploration
description: In this activity, children used various types of spoons and ladles to scoop colourful plastic balls, strengthening their hand-eye coordination and fine motor skills. This playful exploration helps develop the dexterity needed for self-feeding as they grow. Through this activity, children enhance their grip control, refine wrist movements, and build confidence in using utensils, supporting their independence in daily tasks.

title: Activities of the Week!
description: February Week 3

title: "Here is the beehive"
description:
The song "Here is the Beehive" provides a wonderful opportunity for young children to learn about numbers, vocabulary, and rhymes in a playful and engaging way. As children listen to the song, they are introduced to counting through the imagery of bees. The song’s lyrics encourage them to count up to five bees, helping to reinforce number recognition and the concept of counting in a fun, interactive manner.

After hearing the song, children are invited to engage with felt bee props that they can manipulate. As they move the felt bees according to the lyrics, they deepen their understanding of the song’s content, reinforcing their number skills and fine motor skills through hands-on play. Each bee corresponds to a specific line in the song, helping children physically connect the numerical values with the lyrics and the bees they move.

Additionally, this activity introduces vocabulary related to bees and nature. Words like "hive," "buzz," and "fly" expand the children’s language skills. Repeating the song and interacting with the felt bees also introduces them to rhyming patterns, as they become more familiar with the rhythm and melody of the song.

Overall, this experience supports early childhood development by fostering an understanding of numbers, enriching vocabulary, and encouraging auditory learning through rhyme and repetition.

Please find the link to the song in the post.

title: 《猜猜我有多爱你》角色扮演 - 兔妈妈和小兔子
description: 绘本阅读《猜猜我有多爱你》中的角色幼儿们都能够基本了解，幼儿们尝试使用头饰和动作表达故事中的内容，幼儿们分别制作简易的头饰表达自己想要扮演的角色分别饰演了兔妈妈和小兔子，有的幼儿学着妈妈的动作表达自己对小兔子的爱，有的幼儿跟随妈妈的动作模仿自己对兔妈妈的爱，幼儿们能初步了解表达爱的不同方式，例如：我伸长手臂的高度代表我有多么爱妈妈；我对妈妈的爱就像河流一样长；我倒立在树旁代表我爱妈妈从头到脚趾。

title: ✨ Creating the Bee Hive Dramatic Corner: Phase 2! ✨
description:
The children have been hard at work in phase 2 of building their very own bee hive dramatic corner! To make this space even more inviting and magical, they’ve decorated the door frame with rich brown paper, giving it a rustic, beehive-like appearance. Additionally, beautiful bees have been to the decorations, bringing the space to life!

But that's not all; fairy lights have been strung up, creating an enchanting illusion of honey glowing and illuminating from the hive. The children are now surrounded by the warm, inviting glow of their imaginative world!

Stay tuned as the children continue their creative journey. Next, they’ll be working on their very own bee keeper outfits to complete the dramatic corner and bring the hive experience to life! We can’t wait to see their transformation into little bee keepers and watch their imaginations soar!

title: 探索声音 - 击打瓶子
description: 幼儿们能够在各种不同的乐器中探索到不同的声音，那么其他材质的物品可以发出声音吗？幼儿们使用各种不同的工具，例如：汤匙，筷子，叉子，木棍等等进行击打瓶子的动作，听一听能够发出哪些声音，从活动中幼儿们从不同的角度来探索声音的奥秘，例如：一个空瓶子和一个装水的瓶子在击打过后能够发出怎样的声音？这些声音一样吗？幼儿们在老师的引导下说一说自己的看法并了解音乐的旋律。

title: Sneak Peek of the Bee Hive!
description:
The children couldn’t wait to share a sneak preview of the bee hive they’ve been working so hard on! While it's not quite finished yet, they’re already buzzing with excitement as they pose inside their almost completed dramatic corner. From the brown paper and bee cut-outs to the twinkling fairy lights, you can already feel the magic starting to come together!

Stay tuned for more as the bee hive continues to bloom!

title: 早期阅读《晚安》听觉体验
description: 幼儿们使用耳机来进行早期阅读《晚安》的听觉体验，在活动中，幼儿们能认真专注的聆听阅读本中的内容，并跟随老师一起边听边点读，从而在听觉的体验中幼儿们跟能够结合声音来与书本中的词句来理解音字结合。

title: Creepy Crawlies Puppet Theatre
description:
The children have been diving into the world of puppet theatre, bringing their very own creepy crawlies to life! Each child was given a set of puppets to choose from, and they eagerly picked their favourite creepy crawler, whether it was a wiggly worm, a busy ant, or a spooky spider! 

Once they selected their characters, the fun really began! They animated their puppets, creating stories and coordinating with their friends to build exciting adventures. From team-ups between ants and ladybugs to daring journeys through the grass, the children worked together to weave their own tales and share their creativity with each other.

This activity is a great way for the children to develop their imagination, storytelling skills, and teamwork. It’s incredible to watch them work together, using their puppets to create dynamic, interactive play scenarios.

title: 第一学期第七周照片更新
description: 这一周小朋友们同老师一起讨论了“如果妈妈不在家，我会帮忙做什么？”小朋友们说出很多自己可以帮忙做的事情，并且用绘画的形式表现出来，在老师的引导下，小朋友们将自己的绘画作品进行线条图形装饰，并且做成画轴 的形式进行展示。这一周我们也去了户外公园进行游戏，老师在早期阅读中还带小朋友们进行了装饰文字的游戏。

title: Nature's Parade
description: The children were invited to collect twigs and leaves during their outdoor time for an activity. They worked closely with their friends to gather the materials, talking excitedly about finding similar twigs or leaves. Back in class, the children were encouraged to observe the twigs and leaves, comparing them to find out which pieces were small/short, and which were big/long. They then engaged in a sequencing activity, where they worked in groups to place their twigs or leaves in order, from smallest to biggest, or shortest to longest.

title: Journal Reflection
description: For this week's journal reflection, the children were asked, "What would you like to do on the weekends?" The children shared that on Saturdays and Sundays, they would not come to school. When asked what else they would like to do on these days, some children shared that they would like to play with mummy and daddy, go swimming, or find lots of animals, while some others shared their creative imaginations of playing with monsters and dinosaurs!

title: 二月 第三周：户外体验-看马
description:
今天的户外活动我们去D'Resort 的马场看马，他们的名字叫Soniya和Ah Mui。
我们看到他们在草地奔跑还有吃草，好开心。

title: 二月 第三周：你一半我一半
description:
活动目标：
通过谈话、歌曲、故事和儿歌，培养聆听和理解能力。

活动过程：
老师准备绘本《你一半我一半》和水果模型，向幼儿描述故事内容，配合故事内容鼓励幼儿使用水果模型模仿故事情节进行“你一半我一半”的活动，在过程中培养幼儿聆听故事、学习分享。

title: February Week 3
description: Octaves and Ready Steady Go Kids enrichment classes

title: 二月 第三周：摇一摇拉一拉
description:
活动目标：
婴幼儿是自信、好奇和投入的学习者。

活动过程：
老师将物品藏在纸杯中并用橡皮筋和纸巾将纸杯盖住，鼓励幼儿摇一摇猜一猜纸杯里有什么东西，幼儿可以用手指将纸巾戳破也可以尝试将纸巾从橡皮筋拉出来，通过活动过程培养幼儿的好奇心及促进幼儿精细动作发展。

title: Teaching Respect and Patience in Our Classroom
description:
Dear Parents,

In addition to our regular lessons, we also focus on building essential life skills, such as respect and patience. We watched a video showing different ways people demonstrate respect, followed by a discussion on how we can show respect to one another. One key takeaway was the golden rule: Treat others the way you want to be treated.

To reinforce patience and respectful communication, we introduced a technique, holding the hand of the person we want to speak to while waiting for our turn. This helps children practice waiting patiently and respecting ongoing conversations.

We appreciate your support in reinforcing these values at home.

Warmest Regards, 
K2 Teachers

title: 第一学期 第七周：《我最喜爱的故事页面》
description:
活动目标：
1.运用不同的绘画工具进行艺术创作。
2.为幼儿提供机会赞赏和鼓励同伴，重视他人的努力与贡献。


活动过程：
通过阅读绘本《猜猜我有多爱你》，引导幼儿观察不同画面中兔子的变化，并请他们分享自己最喜欢的画面及原因。接着，幼儿使用蜡笔、彩色铅笔等材料，将最喜欢的画面通过绘画方式表达出来。在展示作品后，教师鼓励幼儿共同收拾材料，培养责任感。最后，幼儿围坐交流，分享自己使用的工具、颜色，并讨论小兔子和大兔子的不同之处，进一步加深对绘本内容的理解与体验。

title: February Week 3 Weekly Highlight
description: After listening to the story, "Pete the Cat and the Perfect Pizza Party", the children were invited to create their own pizzas by choosing and adding various "toppings." This activity is a wonderful opportunity for the children to express their creativity and imagination, allowing them to explore different combinations and engage in hands-on learning while having fun. Additionally, it helped to foster their fine motor skills as they carefully picked up and placed the various materials onto their "pizzas."

title: 第一学期第七周活动照片
description:
Hi 家长们好！

本周老师与幼儿一起多次温习绘本故事后，幼儿们选择了自己喜欢的故事画面，并尝试使用不同彩笔进行绘画创作，然后进行了展示分享。幼儿们在绘画过程中能看出非常乐意在画纸上面涂涂画画，大部分幼儿能够控制笔的方向。也能够用简单的华语分享自己的作品。

老师与幼儿进行讨论关于兔子的种类和不同颜色的兔子，发现幼儿们对不同颜色的兔子特别感兴趣，并能说出非常多颜色的兔子。他们学习了句式：兔子是白色的。也鼓励幼儿能在句式中用不同颜色替换白色，也可以用不同物品替换兔子。最后幼儿们很有兴趣的画出来自己喜欢的小兔子。

幼儿们还展示分享了从家里带来的玩具兔子和故事书。幼儿在展示分享中能在老师的鼓励引导下使用华语进行分享。

我们学校二楼的种植园基本已经布置好了！幼儿们在户外活动时，可以随时进行观察及照顾这些植物花卉及蔬菜等，促进了幼儿们的感官体验和探索精神，激发了幼儿们对自然科学的兴趣。

title: T1W7活动
description:
这周，小朋友们对故事书《逃家小兔》进行的深入的学习和讨论。
学习句型：如果你变成......，我就变成......
利用故事图片讲故事
故事创编和剪贴画《逃家小兔》等。
此外，小朋友们还参观了“lee kong chian museum”认识环境保护对野生动物的重要性。

title: weekly update
description:
The little ones continued exploring body parts, focusing on the features of their faces. We finished the body tracing activity from last week, with each child pasting their picture onto the traced outline. They were introduced to the different parts of the face and encouraged to create their own faces using their pictures, pasting them onto a face template. They were also invited to add yarn or strings to represent hair.
The children were active, developing their gross motor skills as they practiced walking and balancing on the balance beam. To enhance their fine motor skills, they explored using tongue depressors, pulling them out of Styrofoam and placing them back in.

They also engaged with various musical instruments while listening to the song "Head, Shoulders, Knees, and Toes."

At Tiong Bahru Park, the children were absorbed in sensory exploration as they played with the sand.

Happy Weekend!

title: English Speech and Drama
description: During their English Speech and Drama enrichment class, children brought to life everyday activities like eating, sleeping, reading, and playing, showcasing moments shared at home with their loved ones. They dramatised building houses and doing household tasks in different parts of the home, fostering creativity, imagination and teamwork. At the end of the session, children received stickers for their amazing performance!

title: Colourful Peacock Craft
description: After reading ‘Birds of a Feather’ by Sita Singh, the children brought the story to life by creating a peacock craft. They started by selecting colorful feathers and pipe cleaners, each child choosing their favorite shades for the peacock's vibrant tail. The feathers and pipe cleaners were carefully attached to an ice cream stick with glue, creating a stunning tail.

title: Fun in the Outdoors
description: Even in the heart of the city, the children are finding moments of connection with nature! On their outdoor exploration, they tuned into the sounds of birds, explored dried leaves, twigs, and fallen flowers, and soaked in the warmth of the morning sunlight and wind. A beautiful reminder that nature is always around us.

title: Bird Feathers Colour Matching and Sorting
description: Feathers of different colours were hidden around the classroom and the children were invited to search for the hidden feathers. They were encouraged to count the number of feathers they found and sort them according to colour. They matched and poked the feathers onto the premade bird dough.

title: Happy Birthday Freya!
description: Thank you for celebrating your special day with us! :)

title: Term 1 Week 7: Our KidZania Plan!
description:
Learning Objectives: 

• To help children understand different occupations and their roles in society.
• To develop decision-making skills by voting on key areas of interest.
• To introduce the concept of financial literacy by exploring earning and spending money.

In preparation for our upcoming trip to KidZania, the children participated in a class discussion to decide on five key areas they would like to visit. Using a voting process, they selected the top occupations they were most excited to explore. If time permits, they will have the opportunity to visit additional areas with teachers or parents.

Through this discussion, the children learned about different jobs, whether each role allows them to earn or spend money, and how these experiences align with their interests. To extend their learning, they illustrated their chosen occupations, which we will be compiling into a special parent-child booklet.


Date of activity: 20th February 2025

title: CNY Performance (Pasir Ris Central)
description:
Our long-awaited Chinese New Year performance took place last Saturday, and the children’s hard work truly shone on stage! After weeks of dedicated practice, they delivered a fantastic performance that made us all proud.

We were also honored to have MP Desmond Tan join us for the celebration. A big thank you to all the children for their wonderful efforts and to our supportive parents for cheering them on!

title: ThinkersBox
description: During this class, the children were invited to use toy counters to follow different lines and search for matching images of boys and girls.

title: Reading of ‘The Very Hungry Caterpillar’ and ‘The Very Busy Spider’ 🐛🕷️
description: This week, we revisited Eric Carle’s stories, focusing on creepy crawlies, which the children are very interested in. Since they recently watched a live performance of these stories at the Victoria Theatre, they were excited to remember the different animals that visited the spider and the foods the caterpillar ate. They eagerly shared their thoughts and answered questions during storytime, helping to build their love for stories and confidence in speaking and listening. 📚

title: Creating a colourful ladybug garden! 🐞
description: This week, for our craft activity, the children created their own ladybugs using paper plates and paint. They were excited to choose from a variety of colours, including orange, green, and red, and were already discussing their choices even before the activity started. After painting their ladybugs, they used sponge tools dipped in black paint to stamp spots onto the wings. The final result was a vibrant and colourful ladybug garden, which is now proudly displayed in our classroom! This activity encouraged the children’s creativity and love for art while allowing them to explore colours and different painting techniques.

title: Hot and Cold
description:
The teacher prepared two bottles and filled it up with both warm and iced water. Upon receiving, Isaac picked up both bottles and explored with it. When Isaac hold up a bottle, the teacher would let him know that it's cold and he would imitate the word "cold". 

This activity develop connection between words, picture, objects (naming pictures and objects)

title: Transition to Playgroup week 2 - Getting to know my new classmates!
description: The teacher brought Isaac to the Playgroup class and introduced him to his new teachers and friends!

title: Transition to Playgroup week 1- Trying out childcare's menu!
description: The teacher brought food from the childcare and introduced it to Isaac.

title: Outdoor Play
description:
Isaac went to the playground with his peers and explored the area and the facilities!

This activity develop a beginning understanding of the physical properties of materials through exploration.

title: T1W7: Growth Timeline
description:
The children talked about their photos, from infancy to preschool years. They shared their experiences, and at the end of the activity, they brainstormed and discussed what they can do as they grow.

Learning objectives:
- Begin to verbalise what they observe with regards to their growth milestones.
- Children will talk about events from the past


The activity was conducted from 17 to 21 of February.

title: T1W7 Show and Tell
description: Children shared and talked their activities during weekends.

title: Crawling through the tunnel!
description:
The teacher placed the tunnel in front of Josiah and went over to the other side and called his name. Upon hearing his name, Josiah peeped in the tunnel and crawled towards the teacher. 

This activity develop sense of self (connecting themselves to their names).

title: Touch and feel the water
description:
The teacher placed Josiah on the bath cradle and placed the rain shower above his eye level. Josiah reached out for the water and giggled when the water touches his hand. He would track the movement of the water and touches it as it goes. 

This activity foster Early Numeracy concepts through routines, transitions, free exploration.

title: Chase after the ball!
description:
The teacher placed a rattle ball in front of Josiah and he began to crawl towards the ball. When he reaches the ball, he would push the ball away and crawled towards it. 

This activity foster gross motor development as well as hand eye coordination.

title: My first solid food in school!
description:
Josiah tried different fruits and vegetables puree in school!

This activity foster beginning healthy eating habits (through different textures and food)

title: Reaching out for toys!
description: Jaius was placed in a tummy position with toys surrounding him. The teacher encouraged him to reach for the toys by shaking and tapping them. He was smiling and showed excitement in reaching out for the toys. Jaius extended both arms forward, aiming and grabbing the toys. He also rolled his body to the side to get closer to the toys nearby. This activity fosters his gross motor development.

title: Inserting straws in
description: Elle was given a recycled egg tray with small holes. Using her pincer grip, she picked up the straws from the mat and focused on inserting them into the holes. Once she finished, she picked up more straws and found other holes to insert them in. Elle was focused and determined to complete the activity. She take her time to carefully place each straw too. This activity fosters fine motor development as well as develop focus and concentration sustained involvement.

title: Ribbons and bells
description: Jaius was lying/tummy down on the mat when the teacher held a bell shaker with colourful ribbons in front of him. He was curious and reached out his hands to touch and grab the ribbons. Jaius moved his fingers through the soft ribbons while looking at them closely. He also kicked his legs in excitement as he heard the jingling sound of the bells.
