title: We are very busy spiders. 🕷️🕸️
description:
We were introduced to The Very Busy Spider by Eric Carle, a story about a diligent spider who spent the entire day spinning her web. As various farm animals approached, inviting her to play, she remained focused on her task. By the end of the story, she had completed her web and used it to catch a fly. Through this engaging tale, we learned about persistence, hard work, and the importance of staying focused on our goals.

To bring our learning to life, we worked together to create our own spiderweb in a corner of our classroom. Using white cotton twine, we carefully stretched and secured the string from wall to wall. We had to be extra mindful to pull it taut to prevent the web from sagging, ensuring it was strong enough to "catch" our fly food. This task proved slightly challenging, requiring patience, teamwork, and plenty of support from our teacher as we figured out how to properly pull and secure the string. Once satisfied with our web, we crafted our own little "flies" by crumpling and bunching up newspaper into small balls. With great excitement, we took turns tossing them at our web, mimicking how real flies get trapped when they fly into a spider's web. This hands-on activity not only reinforced the story’s message but also encouraged teamwork, problem-solving, and fine motor skill development.

In the afternoon, as an extension of our learning, we created a simpler spiderweb to be placed in our learning corner. Using contact paper, we set up a sticky base on a table and carefully arranged strips of white cotton twine on top to resemble a spiderweb. To make the experience even more engaging, we were given two plastic spiders, allowing us to role-play and bring our web to life through imaginative dramatization.

title: Making Our Spiders and their Web! 🕷️🕸️
description:
We culminated our exploration of spiders with a multi-day art project that combined creativity, fine motor skills, and sensory play. This artwork consisted of two parts: creating a spiderweb and crafting a spider to attach to it.

To create our spiderwebs, we used white paint on black paper. We placed the black paper inside a plastic container and added a few drops of white paint. Then, we placed several metal balls into the container and tilted it back and forth, watching as the balls rolled around, spreading the paint in unique streaks across the paper. The result was a beautiful, intricate design that resembled a spiderweb. 🕸️

For the second part, we created our own spiders to attach to our webs. Using egg cartons as the body, we painted them black and patiently waited for the paint to dry. Once ready, we added googly eyes and bent pipe cleaners to form legs, which our teacher helped us attach to the body. Finally, to complete our artwork, our teacher assisted us in securing our spiders to the webs with white cotton twine, making it look like they were dangling from their webs.

title: 每周精彩活动——（第一学期——第八周--纸杯兔子）
description:
幼儿制作的纸杯兔子手工作品，通常结合简单的材料和有趣的创意，让孩子们在动手过程中感受乐趣，同时锻炼他们的手眼协调能力和创造力。以下是对纸杯兔子作品的介绍：
幼儿使用一次性纸杯（兔子的身体），作为兔子的身体，可根据喜好装饰颜色或图案。用卡纸剪出两只长长的兔耳朵，可以用粉色或其他颜色点缀耳朵内侧。
1.	粘贴五官：
o	眼睛可以用卡纸剪出圆形贴上，或直接画上去。
o	鼻子可以使用小绒球，增加立体感。
o	嘴巴可以用笔画上或剪纸贴出微笑的形状。
2.	添加兔子尾巴：在纸杯背面粘上一个小棉球作为兔子的尾巴，使整体造型更加可爱。
3.	个性装饰（可选）：可以给兔子加上胡须、蝴蝶结，甚至画上衣服或小配件，使其更具个性。
作品特点：
•	造型可爱：圆圆的纸杯身体搭配长耳朵和绒球鼻子，整体形象俏皮生动。
•	色彩丰富：孩子们可以自由搭配颜色，展现自己的创意。
•	简单易做：手工步骤简单，适合四岁幼儿操作，并能培养他们的精细动作能力。
•	表达个性：不同的表情、颜色和装饰让每只纸杯兔子都独一无二。
•	动手能力：通过剪、贴、画等步骤，锻炼幼儿的手部肌肉发展。
•	创造力：鼓励孩子发挥想象，自由设计兔子的表情和装饰。
•	情感表达：手工制作带来的成就感能增强孩子的自信心，同时也能培养他们对小动物的喜爱。
这类纸杯兔子手工活动，以实现“来创造“领域的“通过艺术品表现环境中的事物。”学习成果。   
不仅是孩子们的一次趣味创作体验，也能让他们在游戏中学习，提高他们的艺术感知和实践能力！

2. 发展小肌肉控制能力和手眼协调能力。

活动介绍：

      小朋友们在学校里认识了陶土，并尝试用陶土捏出各种不同的形状。到了陶艺教室，陶艺老师为大家展示了如何用转盘拉坯做出一个大碗，还介绍了如何用双手把陶土捏成碗或盘子的形状。

教师引导幼儿想一想蜗牛是怎么行进的，是飞飞还是爬爬呢？接下来我们一起看看蜗牛的小路是什么样子。这只蜗牛很不一样，它喜欢艺术，身上的壳是五颜六色🔴🟨🔷️🟢🔶️的，引导幼儿识别颜色并说出华语。

我们顺着蜗牛的小路继续往下走，出现了好多美丽的画作呀，我们一起欣赏画面中都有着什么，小朋友们会主动指出绘本中的事物，观察的很仔细，我们继续寻找属于蜗牛的画像，到了后面我们看到一副画面，是由不同颜色的色块组成的，引导幼儿说一说这是蜗牛的画像吗？经过比较不同画面的特点，我们找到了属于蜗牛的画面。

孩子们在过程中对艺术画作有了一个初始的视觉启蒙，对颜色的识别更加准确，能够更多的捕捉画面中的重点👍！

title: 《蜗牛与色块》
description:
教师为小朋友们准备了蜗牛🐌身体的画纸和不同颜色形状的色块🪅，建立在我们已经共同阅读过绘本的基础，宝贝对五颜六色的蜗牛壳也很感兴趣，接下来就让小朋友们自己动手拼一拼，贴一贴。

教师引导幼儿选择自己喜欢的色块，然后进行粘贴，给蜗牛拼上独一无二的壳，每个宝贝都特别有自己的想法，很认真仔细的用小手操作🥰。
在过程中培养孩子们的想象力和创造力，发展手指的精细动作！

title: Term 1 Week 8
description:
Hello Parents!!

This week, we explored personal growth, creativity, and hands-on learning, making wonderful connections between our experiences and the world around us. Following on a recap on our Science Centre field trip, we reflected on what we learned about food by creating our favourite dishes through air-dry clay modelling. The children enjoyed expressing their tastes and preferences, bringing their favourite meals to life using malleable material . This activity encouraged creativity while reinforcing their understanding of food and nutrition.
We had a thoughtful sharing session about the differences between being a baby and their current selves. The children enthusiastically discussed how they have grown—what they can do now that they couldn’t before, how they have changed in appearance, and the things they enjoy at this stage. This reflection encouraged self-awareness and appreciation for growth and development.

Our focus turned to ordering ribbons, an activity that challenged the children’s observation and sequencing skills. They carefully arranged ribbons based on length, exploring concepts of measurement and order while refining their fine motor skills. The next day, we spent the day outdoors at Tiong Bahru Park, where the children enjoyed active play, social interaction, and exploration. They engaged in climbing, running, and swinging in the warm sun.

We ended the week with journal writing, focusing on what the children like the most about being 4 years old. Through drawings and mark-making, they shared their favourite activities and friends who made the learning journey all the merrier. As we continue to part take in engaging and meaningful experiences while helping the children reflect, explore, and grow. We look forward to another exciting week ahead!

Have a lovely weekend ahead!
Tr Jia Yan

The children were introduced to word families such as 'in', 'it', 'im' and 'ip' in February. They practised blending the three-letter words and were challenged to read some that had four letters in class too. title: Textural Painting with Bubble Wrap
description: Children explored on sensory painting activity using yellow paint on bubble wrap. As they paint, they’ll feel the bumpy texture, creating a unique tactile experience. The yellow colour represents honey, that will eventually be used to make into honeycomb prop as part of the children's bee hive dramatic play experience.

title: Fossil Making with Creepy Crawlies and Playdough
description: Children had a great time making fossils by pressing creepy crawlies insect toys onto play dough. They used the toy bugs to leave prints in the dough, creating their own fossil-like shapes. It was a fun way for them to feel like Paleontologists while learning about fossils and being creative at the same time.

title: Felt Cloth "Bug in a Rug" Story
description:
Children had a blast with our Felt Cloth Bug Story activity! They were invited to unveil hidden bugs underneath a  blue rug, bringing the story to life. Each bug was carefully tucked away, and the kids got to choose which one to uncover next. As they pulled each bug out, they excitedly called out its name, learning about different insects along the way.

The best part? The children took charge in telling their own story as they arranged the bugs in any order they wanted. They became the storytellers, weaving their own bug-filled adventures as they made decisions about which bug would appear next and how the story would unfold.

This activity aims to promote language development as they practice naming the bugs, fine motor skills by handling the felt pieces, and problem-solving as they decide how to organise the bugs. It encourages creativity and confidence as children take ownership of the story and engage with their imagination. Plus, they build a deeper connection to nature through learning about insects.

title: February Week 4 Weekly Highlight (Part 1)
description:
The children participated in a fun and engaging hands-on activity where they got to create their own sandwiches using felt ingredients. The teacher prepared a variety of felt sandwich ingredients, each with a paperclip attached. The children were given a magnetic fishing rod and were encouraged to "catch" the ingredients by placing the rod near the paperclips.
Once they had collected their chosen ingredients, they used sponge bread to assemble their sandwiches. This activity fostered the children’s creativity and decision-making while also strengthening their fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.

title: Math: Sorting by Size, Length, and Kind
description: The children had a fun math activity sorting natural materials! First, they grouped items by their type – bark, dried leaves, and sticks. Then, they sorted the same materials by size, using words like "long", "short", "big", "small", and "medium" to describe them. It was a hands-on way to learn about different ways to classify objects.

title: The Letter T -- T for Tiger
description: The children had a roaring good time learning about the sound and letter 'T'! They identified words and pictures that began with the 'T' sound, like "tiger," "tire," and "tent."  They enjoyed listening to the story "The Tiger Who Came to Tea."  To finish off the lesson, they created their own tiger artwork by pasting colourful paper shapes onto a giant letter 'T'.

title: weekly update
description:
As we wrap up the month, the children continued exploring their bodies, with a focus on the parts of their faces. They completed the "My Face" art activity, which foster their interest in art. To make it more engaging, the children used different fruits like apples, oranges, and bananas to create their faces. The little ones were so excited about the activity that they couldn't resist eating the fruits as soon as they finished showcasing their creations.

The children also had a great time playing with rhythm sticks while listening to the song "Head, Shoulders, Knees, and Toes." They were encouraged to tap the corresponding body parts as the song played. Afterward, they enjoyed exploring the rhythm sticks further as they listened to some of their favorite song.

Additionally, the children engaged in an activity using bottle caps, where they collected and dropped the caps onto empty tissue rolls. For their gross motor development, they had fun playing with a parachute, lifting it up and down. Some of the children even went underneath the parachute when it was raised.

title: T1亲子活动
description:
亲爱的家长：

这周，小朋友们学用毛根做小兔子。他们想做一个兔妈妈和小兔，然后用“小兔”和“兔妈妈”讲《逃家小兔》的故事。

小朋友们都拿了制作材料回家，请您和孩子一起制作小兔和兔妈妈来讲故事。在您和孩子讲故事时，不必完全按照原版的故事内容进行讲述，您可以和孩子一起创编一个新的“逃家小兔”的故事。

请大家将照片/录制的视频在3月14日之前电邮给老师，我们将播放给孩子们观看，并请孩子分享在家里讲故事的趣事。

title: 本周动态分享
description: 在本周，孩子们带来的最爱的图书促进了幼儿们社交能力的发展，当自己作为书的主人再读图书的时候孩子们会更加的专注，调动自己的所有注意力来了解故事的内容，孩子们也展现了很好的自我认知，学会照顾自己的图书，主动的与老师朋友分享阅读，通过一周的活动，我们发现幼儿们的阅读行为明显的增加，在游戏行为中出现了很多幼儿模仿老师拿着书讲故事的情节。我们要在此特别感谢千嘉妈妈为孩子们准备的丰富的活动材料以及令孩子们十分难忘的互动时刻，千嘉妈妈带领幼儿们共同制作了很多感官教具，现在这些感官游戏出现在我们的探索区域，这里成为了最受欢迎的角落。下周开始我们会进行情绪与感受为主题的探索，在幼儿们构建对自己身体认知的关键期，带领幼儿感受情绪，捕捉自己的感受，加深自我意识。

title: 第一学期第八周活动照片
description:
Hi家长们好！

本周幼儿和老师一起观察图片中小白兔的五官，并进行分享自己所观察到的, 然后老师出示不同美工材料，鼓励引导幼儿尝试进行制作自己喜欢的兔子。幼儿们在制作过程中能使用马克笔和剪刀等制作材料及工具。幼儿们遇到困难也能及时的寻求老师的帮助。幼儿们制作完后与同伴进行了分享与展示。

本周是早期阅读的第四周,所以幼儿们进行创作了第一本爱心小书，在制作过程中可以看出幼儿们知道是在创作自己的小书，也很喜欢折叠式的爱心形状造型画面。

幼儿们还学习了儿歌《我爱你》和歌曲《跳舞歌》，并能在老师的鼓励引导下尝试用动作进行表演。幼儿们真的非常的棒！

儿歌《我爱你》：小兔子，我爱你！爱你我就手打开；爱你我就手举高；愛你我就跳一跳；愛你我就抱一抱。

title: T1W8活动
description:
这周，小朋友们进行一些认读字卡、讲故事、创编故事的活动。
《逃家小兔》故事中使用了一些常用的动词：抱、跑、追、飘、找、爬等。小朋友们玩“我做你猜”游戏来认读字卡。
大家都比较熟悉了《逃家小兔》的故事，小朋友们两两一组，用棒偶进行角色对话，演绎故事。
小朋友发挥创意，想象如果小兔还是不想回家，继续要离家出走会出现的情形。大家先在图纸上画出故事大概内容，然后，用剪贴画的方式制作出故事画面。

title: 特约专家
description:
小朋友们一直没有完成国家美术馆老师让他们设计的房子图纸，大家对设计房子完全没有概念。在讨论的过程中，健弘说可以请他的爸爸帮助大家学画设计图，因为爸爸是一名建筑设计师。
这周五，健弘爸爸特意来学校给小朋友们讲解了一座房子的组成部分，并示范给大家看设计房子要认识的形状和绘画方法。
此外，健弘的爸爸还介绍给小朋友们看专业的设计稿纸、水笔、比例尺，还有镭射测量仪等工具。
听完建筑设计师的讲解，小朋友们比较能理解设计房子的概念了，他们要用健弘爸爸给他们的设计稿子绘制一张房子的设计图，这项活动，我们下周会继续。

title: Bringing Our Peacocks to Life!
description: The children were invited to continue their process art by adding the final touches to their beautiful peacocks! Last week, they created colourful tails using feathers and pipe cleaners. This time, they crafted the bird’s body using a variety of paper and felt cloth in different shapes, colours, and textures. Adding googly eyes, sequins, beaks and feathers, each peacock became a unique masterpiece!

title: Watch me grow!
description: The children had such an enjoyable time looking through their baby photos alongside their friends! Some children shared about what they were doing in each photo, and some children asked to have a closer look at their friend's pictures. The children were then encouraged to identify which picture showcased them as an infant, a toddler, and as a 4 year old.

title: Gallery walk
description: The day after looking through their baby photos,  the children engaged in putting their photos up on display in the photo gallery. They sorted out their photos by age and pasted them up on the wall or boards. The children then walked around from wall to wall, admiring their photos and learning more about their friends and their early childhood. The photos remain on display, encouraging children to have conversations about their growth and development!

title: Ribbon Race
description: This week, the children took part in a ribbon race, where they were invited to arrange ribbons of different lengths in order. They first observed the different lengths of ribbon and learned how it could be arranged in order, ensuring that one end of the ribbon always aligned with the others for accurate comparisons. They then raced one another to gather as many ribbons as they could and worked together to arrange them in order from shortest to longest.

title: Scooping the Bird's Food
description:
After enjoying the story Stellaluna, the children were invited to imitate the mummy bird feeding her babies! Instead of using a beak, they carefully scooped pompom balls with a plastic spoon and placed it into a pretend nest with their chosen bird figurine inside. 🐣

This activity helped strengthen their fine motor skills as they practiced gripping the spoon, controlling their hand movements, and carefully transferring the pompoms. It also enhanced hand-eye coordination as they focused on scooping, balancing, and accurately placing the pompoms into the nest.

title: Weekly Update
description:
Hi Parents!

Last week, we continued exploring our five senses with the help of a parent volunteer! The children had a great time discovering how to use their senses by engaging with different materials and practicing phrases like, “I use my eyes to see, I use my ears to hear, I use my tongue to taste, and I use my nose to smell.” They also enjoyed their enrichment classes and have been participating actively with the other teachers.

We have also created a beautiful friendship tree where the children shared their favourite memories with their friends and talked about how those experiences made them feel. We displayed the tree outside our classroom. 

Additionally, here are a few video clips of the children singing and dancing in their music class. :)

title: 艺术工坊《兔妈妈和小兔子》
description: 幼儿们使用彩色纸和各种手工用具创作制作课可爱的纸筒兔妈妈和小兔子，幼儿们在手工制作的过程中可以通过撕，粘，贴，画等独立性动作练习手眼协调性，并在完成手工的制作后激发幼儿们的自信心，从独立完成一项任务中也锻炼了幼儿们坚持，好奇心品质的建立。

title: 踢球游戏
description: 幼儿们在本周继续练习关于踢球的基本动作和技巧，教练通过热身运动，大肢体伸展活动让幼儿们舒展自己的身体，并轮流带领幼儿们进行踢球射门的活动。

title: 大自然的声音
description:
在户外玩耍时，幼儿们总是对树丛中，马路上发出的各种声音充满着好奇，所以老师带领幼儿们一起去寻找这些声音，找一找大自然中这些声音的来源，幼儿们分别了解了一些昆虫的声音，例如：鸟/蜜蜂/乌鸦/蚂蚱，幼儿们选择了自己想要寻找的昆虫图片并跟随老师的脚步一起去花园寻觅声音，当有些幼儿们寻找到自己图片上昆虫时，会开心地指向天空告诉老师：我找到了小鸟。

从这项活动中幼儿们能够在大自然的环境中了解声音的来源，并结合华文的学习让幼儿们能够增强自己对大自然的好奇心。

title: 水彩画
description: 幼儿们使用蜡笔，水彩制作了可爱的画作《蜗牛》

title: Birthday Tradition Poster
description: During show and tell, the children were asked to describe and explain their family's birthday traditions using the photographs, drawings and captions on their poster. The audience were encouraged to ask questions and share one thing that they have learned from their friends at the end of their presentation.

title: DIY Birthday Party Scene
description: The children were given a large sheet of paper to create a birthday party scene. For example, a party room. They concentrated on drawing different groups of birthday related items using coloured markers. Then, they arranged each group of items in the scene. For instance, glue balloons and streamers in the top section as decorations, place food items on the table and position gifts in a corner. During the process, they were encouraged to talk about their artwork.

title: Love is...
description: Using the book named "Love Makes a Family" by Sophie Beer as a provocation, the children were asked to think about how love is being shown in their own family. They drew they ideas and coloured with oil pastels. They spread glitter glue to fill up the background of their artwork. At last, they copywrote their verbatim.

title: Ribbon Width Wonders
description: In this activity, the children were provided with ribbons with varying lengths. They worked together in small groups to arrange the ribbons from the thinnest to the widest. Afterward, they created a shared artwork by gluing the ribbons in order on the paper and painting over them with watercolours.

title: 每周活动分享
description:
亲爱的家长们：
大家好！本周教师继续带领班级幼儿一起进行探索五官的奇妙之旅，我们一起开展了丰富多彩、形式多样的活动。宝贝们在各个方面都取得了令人欣喜的成长与进步。现在，就请跟随我们的分享，一同走进宝贝们精彩纷呈的一周吧！
在心理社会活动环节，我们着重培养幼儿的社交能力和互助意识。宝贝们积极参与“指认同伴”的活动，他们用稚嫩而又充满好奇的眼睛去观察身边的小伙伴，说出同伴的名字，指一指，说一说同伴的五官在哪里；同时我们也开展了“帮助同伴拿水壶”的活动，宝贝们小小的身影在教室里穿梭，将水壶递给同伴时那真诚的笑容，成为了幼儿园里最美的风景。通过这些活动，幼儿们不仅结交了更多的好朋友，还学会了在集体生活中相互关心、相互帮助，为他们今后的社会交往奠定了良好的基础。
身体动作方面，本周我们继续专注在培养幼儿的精细动作。在“穿插吸管”的活动中，宝贝们全神贯注地将吸管准确地插入漏斗的小洞中，每一次成功都让他们欢呼雀跃。拉拉链、扭瓶盖等活动也难不倒我们聪明的孩子们，他们的小手越来越灵活，动作越来越熟练。这些看似简单的小任务，却对孩子们手部肌肉的发展和手眼协调能力的提升有着重要的意义。相信在不断的练习中，孩子们的精细动作能力会越来越强。
在培养思考能力的活动中，我们引导幼儿们利用自然区角的材料拼贴五官。宝贝们发挥自己丰富的想象力，用石头做眼睛，用贝壳做鼻子，用树叶做头发……一幅幅充满创意的作品在他们的小手中诞生。这个过程不仅让孩子们更加深入地了解了五官的形状和特点，还激发了他们的创造力和想象力。他们在探索和实践中学会了观察、思考和创新，为今后的学习和生活积累了宝贵的经验。
沟通与语言能力方面，本周我们继续和幼儿们一起阅读故事书《脸，脸，各种各样的脸》。通过生动有趣的故事和精美的图片，宝贝们对五官有了更深刻的认识。在阅读过程中，我们鼓励宝贝们模仿说出“两只眼睛，一个鼻子，一张嘴”等简单的字词，引导他们了解和使用五官的名称，并说出五官的位置。幼儿们积极参与，大胆表达，语言能力得到了有效的锻炼。
美工方面，教师为幼儿们提供了丰富多样的材料，宝贝们发挥自己的创意，认真地粘贴出五官和头发。每一幅作品都充满了孩子们对美的理解和表达。
音乐律动方面，教师播放歌曲《一根小手指》，孩子们跟随音乐的节奏，用木棍或其他打击乐器打节奏，根据歌词指出身体部位的位置。他们欢快的身影、充满活力的表情，仿佛一个个小小的音乐家和舞蹈家。通过音乐律动活动，孩子们不仅感受到了音乐的魅力，还提高了节奏感和身体协调性，同时也增强了自信心和表现力。
本周，幼儿们在户外尽情地享受着阳光和快乐。他们在户外散步，呼吸着新鲜的空气，观察着周围的花草树木，感受着大自然的美好。玩水活动中，宝贝们用不同形状的滴管吸水、挤水，体验着水的流动和变化，探索着水的奥秘。玩沙活动更是孩子们的最爱，他们用干沙和湿沙堆城堡、做冰淇淋，发挥着自己的想象力和创造力。
充实的一周很快就过去了，下周开始我们将围绕新的兴趣主题“我的家庭”开展更多有趣的活动。下周见！

title: Fire Drill 2025
description:
On Friday, the 28th of February, the children participated in a Fire Drill.
The children were guided to the evacuation route via the staircase next to the school and gathered outside the Coffee Bean area for a debrief,

Back in school, the children learnt the importance of the Fire Drill, what to expect, and where to go. 
They also understood that they should remain calm and listen to the instructions given by the teachers.

title: NFP - February 2025
description:
On the 28th of February, the children headed to Pasir Ris Park Carpark C for some outdoor activities.
They had fun playing games such as Police and Thief, Duck Duck Goose, Parachute and Blow Wind Blow.

title: K1 Term 1 Week 8 Weekly Updates
description:
For this week, children revised their Letterland letters. They then matched the content words from guided reading to the various letters that begins with the corresponding letters.

In addition, children were invited to a color mixing activity as they linked it back to the theme of family where each color represents a family member. They then represented each family member to one color and talked about the colorful creation when  the colors got mixed together. 

Lastly, children learnt about width for Math Mind using varied ribbons and proceeded to make their own craft using the ribbons provided.

title: Round the Pigs
description: In this gross motor activity, children are invited to interact with balloons designed to resemble pigs. They will explore various ways to engage with the balloons, such as throwing them, hitting them to keep them afloat, and finding creative ways to move the ‘pigs’ in and out of the ‘pig pen.’ This activity encourages the development of hand-eye coordination, spatial awareness, and body control while fostering problem-solving skills and cooperative play. Additionally, children will strengthen their arm and core muscles as they experiment with different movements and strategies to manipulate the balloons.

title: Counting with Feathers
description: In this activity, children are invited to decorate a chicken made from a paper plate using colored feathers. As they pick up each feather, they are encouraged to count along with the teacher, mirroring the counting process. This playful activity helps develop early numeracy skills by reinforcing number recognition, one-to-one correspondence, and counting sequence. Additionally, it enhances fine motor skills through grasping and placing the feathers, supports color recognition, and fosters creativity and self-expression.

title: 分享活动：我最爱……
description:
老师鼓励小朋友们和爸爸妈妈讨论自己最爱的物品，并将其带来学校。来到学校后，老师鼓励小朋友们轮流来到台前向朋友展示和介绍自己最喜欢的物品，尝试使用简单的语句：“我是……”、“我最爱的是……”来进行表达。小朋友们在来到台前分享时都有一些害羞，大部分的幼儿可以在老师的鼓励下使用简单句介绍自己和自己最爱的物品；有的小朋友在老师的引导下，能够接着老师的引导完成介绍。在聆听他人分享时，大部分小朋友们能够保持专注，并且会在朋友展示自己最爱的物品时，大声的说出物品的名称。
这个活动帮助孩子们锻炼语言表达能力，增强他们的自信心。通过分享自己最爱的物品，孩子们可以练习使用简单的句子结构来表达自己的想法，培养语言能力。同时，也能在分享的过程中提高他们的社交技能和团队合作精神。在聆听他人分享时，孩子们能够专心倾听并积极参与互动，表明他们已经开始理解和尊重他人的分享，这是他们社交能力和集体意识发展的体现。

title: 华文拾趣
description: 教师请幼儿回顾这个星期大家最感兴趣的事物或印象最深的话题。鼓励幼儿相互分享他们的想法或感受，并邀请幼儿用图画、符号或文字记录自己的想法。

title: 系列活动-《好忙的蜘蛛》🕷
description: 在系列活动《好忙的蜘蛛》中，老师和小朋友们首先一起阅读了绘本《好忙的蜘蛛》，通过故事的讲述让孩子们了解蜘蛛的生活和身体结构。随后，老师邀请小朋友们观察蜘蛛的身体特点，最后鼓励小朋友们参与美术创作活动：活动开始时，孩子们使用油画棒绘制蜘蛛网，然后用水粉描绘背景颜色，在这一过程中，老师引导孩子们观察油画棒和水粉的分离反应。接下来，孩子们使用轻粘土、活动眼睛和扭扭棒制作小蜘蛛，体验各种材料的运用。孩子们自由选择自己喜爱的颜色和材料数量，创作过程充满了乐趣和创意。在完成作品后，他们兴奋地展示自己的创作，并与朋友们分享。

title: 设计家务机器人
description: 观看家务机器人的相关视频，幼儿能够以“机器人”为主题，提出自己感兴趣的问题并探究问题的答案。 幼儿根据自己的想法和构思绘制家务机器人设计图。

title: 制作家务机器人
description:
幼儿能够根据设计图纸以及多种回收再利用的材料
制作机器人模型。教师出示幼儿从家里带来的纸盒、纸筒、塑料瓶等材料，并为幼儿提供胶带、剪刀等具。教师鼓励幼儿跟同伴商量，根据他们的设计图制作一个家务机器人送给妈妈。

title: 穿线活动——好饿的毛毛虫
description: 小朋友们在分享了《好饿的毛毛虫》绘本后，被邀请参与穿线活动中。老师首先准备了绘本中的食物道具，吸引幼儿们的注意力。老师展示了各种食物道具，邀请小朋友们一起说出它们的名称，让小朋友们回忆绘本中的内容。接着，老师拿出一条带有长长绳子的毛毛虫，并展示毛毛虫吃掉水果的过程。老师一边穿线，一边引导幼儿说出：“毛毛虫吃了……”并鼓励小朋友们模仿，边穿线边说出毛毛虫吃过的食物。通过这种的方式，帮助小朋友们复习故事情节，还通过穿线这一操作，锻炼了他们的手眼协调能力和精细动作技能。同时，小朋友们在参与的过程中能够通过语言表达来描述食物，提升了他们的语言能力。

title: Here is the Beehive, But where are all the Bees? 🐝
description:
Today, we learned a new song called "Here Is the Beehive." In the song, five little bees are hiding inside their beehive, waiting to fly out. We used a felt board with a beehive and five bees to bring the song to life. Each of us had a turn to follow along with the lyrics, first hiding the bees inside the hive and then helping them "fly out" at the right moment.

Through this song, we are able to practice recognizing rhyming words and simple counting from 1 to 5.

If Mummy and Daddy would like to sing along with us, you can find the song here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V5Bs9xydba0&pp=ygUTaGVyZSBpcyB0aGUgYmVlaGl2ZQ%3D%3D

title: Crayon Resist Spiderwebs!
description:
We continued our exploration of spiderwebs through this artwork. In nature, spiderwebs can sometimes blend into their surroundings, making them difficult to spot, while other times, they stand out beautifully against their natural backdrop.

To illustrate this, we began by using a white crayon to draw our web patterns on a white sheet of paper. At first, we realised that our drawings were invisible! But then, as we painted over them with watercolours, we were amazed and excited to see our spiderwebs magically appear on the paper. It was a wonderful way to explore the idea of camouflage while creating a fascinating art piece!

title: Practicing our balance, building our confidence!
description:
In this experience, we challenged ourselves by walking across a pathway of narrow beams at varying and increasing heights. Some of us stepped onto the mounds with confidence, moving steadily across the pathway, carefully placing one foot in front of the other. Others needed a bit more time, practice, and encouragement before attempting to cross. 

However, with each try—and with the support and cheers from our teachers—our confidence grew. By the end of the activity, we had all become more capable and self-assured, navigating the pathway more quickly and independently! Through this activity, we also practiced being patient and turn-taking.

title: Pom Pom Whisk
description:
In this activity, children will foster and develop their fine motor skills and eye-hand coordination. 

Pom poms will be stuffed in the whisk of different sizes. Children will be invited to remove the pom-poms from the whisk using their fingers

title: Our Facial Expressions
description: Children will use pipe cleaners to represent their hair and mouth. Children are given the autonomy to choose the colours and paste them wherever they want on the paper plate. They then added the googly eyes, picking out the size of the googly eyes. Children will choose if they want to display a sad, happy, or angry expression and paste the pipe cleaner to make the expression they want.

title: Making Ice-cream
description: Children recap on the various activities they do together as a family and made their very own ice-cream together as a class!

title: Balancing!
description: Children tried balancing on balancing beams and masking tape. They performed tasks while trying to balance themselves!

title: Numicons Line Up!
description: We had a race to see which group was able to gather the most numicons. Upon collecting their numicons, the children were tasked to line them up to make a long line. We then compared the line from both teams to see which is the longest/shortest.

title: K2 Resilience Camp: Water Trekkers Day 1

Dear Parents,

The children had an exciting day. They started it with Storytelling and by setting essential agreements that they are to follow for the duration of the camp. They were introduced to animal and water safety and packing practice. They then went outside for their risk assessment, drain trekking and exploration and water experiment.
They learnt that the pH scale measures how acidic or basic something is on a scale of 0 to 14. Things with a lower pH, like coca cola and vinegar, are acidic, while things with a higher pH, like soapy water and drain cleaners are basic (alkaline). In the middle, water has a neutral pH of 7.

Please enjoy browsing through the pictures of the children.

Kind regards,
Teacher Karen and Ni Laoshi

title: 每周精彩活动——（第一学期——第九周--猜猜我有多爱你）
description:
通过绘画线条和比较长度的方式，引导孩子理解“尺度”和“比较”的概念。
1. 认知目标：通过故事情境，初步理解“长”“短”“更长”等相对长度的概念。
2. 技能目标：学会用绘画的方式表现不同的长度，例如用线条、手臂张开的距离等方式表达“爱有多大”。
3. 情感目标：通过绘画和肢体动作，表达自己对家人的爱，增强亲子互动。
• 阅读绘本《猜猜我有多爱你》，让孩子关注故事中的小兔子和大兔子如何用手臂、跳跃等方式表达爱。
 身体感知：
• 让孩子用自己的手臂、双腿、全身动作来表现“我有多爱妈妈”，并用语言描述“这么长”“更长”“最长”。
 绘画创作：
• 指导孩子画一条代表“爱”的线条，可以是从短到长的对比，比如“我今天的爱这么长，但明天可能更长！”
• 也可以让孩子画一个大大的拥抱，手臂的长度可以拉长，形成有趣的对比。
对比讨论：
• 让孩子观察彼此的画作，比较“谁的爱更长？”“谁的线条最长？”并鼓励他们用语言表达自己的发现。
这种方式既能结合数学启蒙（比较长度），又能让孩子通过艺术表达情感，同时提高他们的语言表达能力。

• 在运动过程中学会遵守纪律，倾听指令，增强自控能力。

4. 健康与安全目标

• 通过体育活动提高心肺耐力和肌肉力量，增强体质。

有的虫虫会飞飞，有的虫虫会爬爬，有的虫虫喜欢唱歌跳舞，小朋友可以一一认识这些虫虫的特征，说一说它们的特征，还有的虫虫会躲迷藏，哎呀找不到它们在哪里啦？请我们的宝贝帮忙找一找，教师引导幼儿发现画面中会“隐身”的小虫虫，在这个过程中锻炼了幼儿的观察能力，并且进行适当提问发展幼儿的认知和语言能力。

title: 爬行动物拼一拼
description:
教师为幼儿准备若干个爬行动物的拼图。 首先，向幼儿说明拼图的规则，示范如何寻找匹配的拼图。
在过程中，小朋友们很认真地一一去对比，是不是同样同一个动物的另一半，有时候他们会遇到困难。 比如拼接的形状是S型又或者找到同一个动物的拼图，但是方向不准确。
在幼儿需要帮助的时候，教师及时的引导他们看一看这个动物的拼图有什么特点呢，以及他们不同身体部位是哪个位置，慢慢的小朋友们越拼越有自信。

title: 《独一无二的我》
description:
教师先为小朋友们点名，引导幼儿发现我们每个人的名字都不一样。那么我们还有哪些地方不一样吗？
请小朋友们先照一照镜子，看看自己的样子，再看看朋友。观察后说一说自己和别的小朋友不同之处，有的小朋友指了指自己的头发。跟别人不一样。 有的小朋友指了指自己的袜子。有的小朋友发现我们的衣服领口有一些不同等等……
在活动过程通过视觉观察和内在思考比较，让幼儿能够发现自己和朋友们的很多细节，增强自我认知也发展了思考能力。

title: Leafy Learning: A Creepy Crawly Sensory Bin Adventure
description:
The children created a sensory bin filled with creepy crawlies and dried leaves, using the leaves to build habitats for the bugs. As they explored the leaves, they learned basic numeracy by sorting them into big and small categories, practicing comparisons, counting, and early math concepts. 

The activity promoted fine motor skills, and sensory development while introducing nature-based learning through play. It was a fun and educational way to blend imaginative play with foundational math skills.

title: Our transition to packet milk!
description:
Our little ones have reached an exciting milestone; they’ve started transitioning to drinking packet milk! At first, it was a new experience for them, but now, some of the children are eagerly looking forward to their milk, especially before nap time or in the afternoon. It's amazing to see how this small change has sparked a sense of excitement and independence in them.

Drinking from a packet or sippy cup instead of a bottle marks a big step in their growth. Not only are they learning to handle and drink from a different type of container, but they are also becoming more self-sufficient in their daily routines. This transition is a wonderful way to build their confidence and sense of accomplishment as they take on new responsibilities, like opening the straw packaging or pushing in the straw into their packet milk. It's a simple, yet significant, part of their journey towards greater independence!

    通过活动中练习拉拉链、扣纽扣， 发展精细动作，以实现婴幼儿身体健康，并掌握控制身体的能力[感知动作 - 精细动作和粗大动作]的学习成果。

Learning objectives:

- Children will practice listening to and following instructions while engaging in a structured physical task.

The activity was conducted on 5 March 2025.

title: Term 1 Week 9: Numicon Patterns
description:
Objectives:
1) Children will arrange Numicon tiles in order of width
2) Children will design patterns using shapes and lines inspired by Numicon tiles. 

The children used the Numicon pieces to compare and arrange them from the thinnest to the thickest (landscape/crosswise). After ordering, the children then traced the outlines of the tiles onto paper, using the shapes to create a pattern such as ABAB, ABBA, AABB, ABC etc. During this activity, the children would also be encouraged to care for their friends through sharing, as well as emphasizing how taking turns and being mindful of materials fosters a positive environment. 

This activity was conducted on 5th to 6th of March 2025.

title: KidZania Field Trip (Part 1)
description:
Our long-awaited visit to KidZania finally happened, and the children had an amazing time! They were eager to earn their KidZos and carefully considered how to spend them at the end of the trip.

Through various role-playing activities, the children experienced real-world jobs and responsibilities, gaining independence and confidence along the way. It was a wonderful opportunity for them to explore different careers and understand how their talents and abilities can be nurtured in meaningful ways.

A big thank you to the parents who joined us on this trip—we truly appreciate your support! We hope this experience has inspired our children to continue exploring and learning beyond the classroom.

title: 每周活动分享
description:
尊敬的家长您好，
很快到了我们三月份的学习主题分享，这个月探索的是“ 我的家庭。” 我们将会和幼儿一起认识了解自己的家庭成员有哪些，以及认识同伴的家庭成员。 通过介绍家庭成员学习词语：爸爸，妈妈，哥哥，姐姐以及延伸到爷爷，奶奶，外公，外婆等词语。
同时感谢家长们为我们提供了家庭照，为我们的活动提供了帮助。这一周我们开始把家长提供的家庭照片打印出来，借助家庭照和幼儿一起认识自己的家庭成员。在探索中，看得出来幼儿通过教师提供的照片能够指认出家庭成员，并且能够叫出称谓。同时幼儿也能够指认同伴的家庭照片， 他们在看拿到同伴照片的时候，会把照片送给同伴。
星期一是我们的户外探索—玩沙玩水活动， 这一周幼儿在楼上体验了玩水活动，他们都非常尽兴，享受了共同玩水的乐趣。 星期二幼儿参加了音乐律动活动，从幼儿和音乐老师的互动当中，我们能够看得出来幼儿已经开始熟悉我们的音乐老师了。 他们能够很自如的和音乐老师进行互动，也可以看得出来幼儿很享受音乐活动中带来的快乐。
这一周从星期三开始我们的Thinking box的课外活动也开始了。 幼儿在第一节课的时候展现了对这个课程和老师的喜欢，他们能够在老师的指导下和教师一起互动，一起做游戏，可以看得出来幼儿在活动当中很专注。期待我们下一周的活动能给幼儿带来更多的惊喜。这周四由于天气的影响，我们没有去公园探索，转而在学校附近散步，看一看周遭的环境。在多次的练习下，班级幼儿在出去探索的时候秩序非常的棒，而且他们的脚步越发的稳健，能够灵活的大步行走。
这一周我们班级来了一位新的朋友紫萱，希望我们的紫萱小朋友能够快速适应我们的集体生活，熟悉同伴和老师，和小朋友一起快乐成长！

这周，小朋友们进行了三天的户外水道探索活动，虽然有点辛苦，可是大家乐此不疲。过程中，他们学习了怎样判断水的酸碱性，了解新加坡水道的流向，以及在户外探索活动中需要的一些自我保护方法。同时，也在活动中看到了小朋友们展现出来的勇敢和坚强的学习品质。

title: Mini Beasts Observation 🕵🏻
description:
This week, we introduced a Mini Beast Observation Corner in our discovery area!🕵🏻 The children explored various insects, learning their names, such as grasshoppers, beetles, and scorpions. Using magnifying glasses, they eagerly examined these creatures up close, excited to observe insects they had never seen before.
Adding to the excitement, we welcomed a class pet, which are caterpillars that will soon transform into beautiful butterflies! 🐛🦋 The children learned how to care for them, including feeding and handling them gently. Inspired by their observations, they even worked together to form a human caterpillar! What a creative way to start the morning~

title: 科学课
description: 在本次的科学课中小朋友们用有趣的饼干搭配书面文图的形式去探索了太空的奥秘，大家在这个过程中了解到了太阳照射与地球转动之间的影响。小朋友用奥利奥饼干的黑白之分去感受太阳照射之处的光亮，与没有照射之处的暗夜一面。

title: 责任立约卡
description: 为了引导小朋友们对家务有更多的了解，以及培养大家的家庭责任意识，所以在本周我们和小朋友一起完成了责任立约卡的制作。制作前老师先和小朋友们一起回顾了家务有哪些？小朋友们分享到：“洗碗、洗衣服、熨衣服、扫地、擦桌子、折衣服、收衣服、收玩具。”老师赞扬了小朋友通过学习已经了解了很多类型的家务活动，也鼓励到小朋友们可以在家做一些力所能及的家务，和家人一起为共同的家负责任。随后老师带出“责任立约卡”中责任和立约的概念，引导小朋友们了解责任就是我们应该去做到的事情，立约就是约定好要做就要做到的事情。最后小朋友们纷纷在责任立约卡中圈画出自己回家会做的家务！下周我们会将责任立约卡让小朋友们带回家，希望小朋友们能够做到责任与约定，一起和家人去维系美好的家。

title: 用艺术形式表现和表达对责任的看法
description: 朋友们通过绘画的形式，表现自己对自己应该要做的事情的认识，比如自己穿衣服，自己整理玩具，自己收拾书包，自己洗澡，而且还能帮助朋友和家人做一些自己能做的事情，增强他们的责任意识。他们也通过分享来表达自己对于做家务事情的看法，并且他们也说自己的事情应该自己做，能帮忙的事情也愿意去帮助朋友和家人，这是他们责任意识的表现。

title: 第一学期第九周照片上传
description:
Hi家长们好！

首先非常感谢家长们的积极参与及配合，给幼儿们发来了家庭照片及带来亲子活动的作品，为幼儿们提供了充足的材料进行展示及分享。

幼儿们在愉快的气氛中展示分享了自己的家庭照片，并在老师的鼓励引导下尝试进行分享自己的家人，并能积极的进行夸奖自己的家人，还能非常愿意的讲述照片中的情节，部分幼儿还能清楚讲述当时发生的一些有趣的故事。

description:

title: Term 1 Week 9
description:
This week, we embraced self-expression, creativity, and problem-solving as we explored our unique talents and engaged in hands-on building activities. We began the week by talking about our unique talents. The children eagerly shared the special things they love to do, from singing and dancing to storytelling and building. This discussion encouraged self-confidence and helped them appreciate the diverse talents within our class. We continued our exploration of talents, with some children taking their excitement a step further by attempting to create their own costumes for the upcoming talent showcase. This activity sparked creativity and allowed them to express their personalities through design and imaginative play.

Our focus shifted to hands-on construction as we built cities using Duplo blocks. The children worked collaboratively, using their creativity and problem-solving skills to design and construct different structures. After building, we ordered the cities according to their height, introducing concepts of measurement and comparison in an engaging and interactive way.

This week was filled with opportunities for self-discovery, teamwork, and creativity. 
We cannot wait to see what the children have to share and showcase for the talent show on the 11th of March, Tuesday!!

Have a lovely week ahead
Tr Jia Yan

title: Weekly Highlight: Term 1 Week 9
description: The children participated in an engaging activity called Bowling Master!, where the classroom was transformed into a mini bowling alley. The children practiced their one-handed underarm throws, challenged by varying distances, while also improving their counting skills as they tallied knocked-down pins.

title: Growing green beans
description: This week, the children engaged in a green bean planting activity to further expand their learning about growth, development, and changes that occur with time. They planted and watered their green beans in cups with cotton wool at the beginning of the week. They then spent the subsequent days observing the growth of their plants and talking about the changes they noticed to the individual beans.

title: Journal Writing - changes in our green beans
description: In order for children to make keen observations and record their findings, the children were encouraged to draw out the growth of their green beans. They took some time to observe how their plants had changed from bean to sprout over the past few days and naturally shared their observations with their friends. They then drew out their green bean plants in their journals.

title: Building a Tower City
description: In this activity, the children were invited to build towers using a single colour of unifix cubes. They used their strength and fine motor control to join the cubes and make towers of different heights. They were then encouraged to put their towers side by side to create their city, during which they compared and talked about the differences in heights. Lastly, the children applied their knowledge of ordering and sequencing to arrange their towers from shortest to tallest.

title: RSGK-折返跑
description: 在体能活动开始时，小朋友们首先进行简短的热身运动，随着教师的引导，孩子们开心地做着伸展、踮脚和扭腰等动作，逐渐活跃起来，身体也变得更加灵活。热身结束后，教师耐心地向小朋友们讲解折返跑的注意事项，重点强调如何用力起跑、跑步时保持身体平衡等。小朋友们认真听讲，眼神专注，有的还会模仿老师的动作。接着，教师邀请小朋友们轮流进行折返跑。每个小朋友都充满了兴趣，跃跃欲试，纷纷排队等待轮流参与。有的小朋友起跑时迅速冲出，双腿用力，镜头都来不及捕捉他的身影；有的孩子稍微犹豫，但在老师和小伙伴们的鼓励下，渐渐放开脚步，跑得越来越快。个别孩子停下时摔倒了，但他们很快爬起来，展示了顽强的毅力和勇敢的精神。整个活动场面热烈而欢快，小朋友们不仅锻炼了身体，也在过程中收获了自信与快乐。

title: 我喜欢自己
description: 在“我喜欢自己”的活动中，老师首先和小朋友们分享了一个关于自信与自爱的故事《我喜欢自己》。通过故事的引导，小朋友们开始思考自己喜欢自己的哪些地方。接着，老师邀请小朋友们寻找自己的照片，并通过看照片和照镜子两种方式，帮助他们更加清晰地看到自己的外貌和独特之处。小朋友们有的会开心地指着自己的鼻子，有的则自豪地展示自己小脚可以走、可以跑。每个小朋友都在老师的鼓励下，勇敢地分享自己喜欢的地方。通过这一活动，小朋友们不仅增强了自信心，也学会了欣赏自己、爱自己，感受到内心的满足和快乐。

title: 我们的新朋友——毛毛虫🐛
description:
老师将毛毛虫和茧带回幼儿园后，小朋友们都很兴奋。他们围坐在老师旁边，眼睛睁得大大的，充满了好奇。老师首先将毛毛虫放在透明的盒子里，然后邀请小朋友们轮流来进行观察，他们仔细观察毛毛虫的身体，有的小朋友观察到毛毛虫在盒子里蠕动、吃叶子的时候都发出了惊喜的叫声。有的小朋友还观察到了盒子里有毛毛虫的大便，并数了一数，总共有三粒；有的小朋友认真地看着毛毛虫的身体，发现它身体的形态、颜色和身体上特殊的花纹。接着，老师给每个孩子发放了放大镜，让他们用放大镜观察毛毛虫的细节。孩子们兴奋地把放大镜贴着眼睛，看向毛毛虫。在老师的引导下小朋友们将放大镜靠近毛毛虫，透过放大镜，他们看到了毛毛虫身上细小的毛发和微小的足部，仿佛进入了一个神奇的微观世界。除了毛毛虫，老师还带来了一个毛毛虫的茧，孩子们围在一起，猜测毛毛虫是如何在茧里变成蝴蝶的。这个活动不仅让孩子们感受到了自然的奇妙，也激发了他们对生物世界的浓厚兴趣。
到周五，班级内的毛毛虫全部变成了蝴蝶，一只蝴蝶破茧失败，目前班级内还有三只茧，让我们和小朋友们共同期待下周它们可以成功蜕变为蝴蝶🦋。

title: United caterpillars
description: The children were grouped and tasked to move through obstacles, while holding onto the hoola hoops. They were instructed not to let the hoops break, or else they had to repeat the obstacle course. The children had to learnt to trust their group leaders at the front and work as a group.

title: Through the Needle
description:
Obj : Children will be able to do a dynamic balance.

Two hoops were set up at different heights for children go through. We pretended that the hoops had needles around them and children were invited to go through without touching the hoops. Children used different methods such as, stepping over one foot at a time while bending their heads lower. They also went through the hoop by crawling over the hoops, they carefully lifted their legs higher to avoid touching the hoops.

title: Weekly Update
description:
Hi Parents!

This month, we’ve introduced a new theme that continues our exploration of “All About Myself,” focusing now on emotions. We’ve discussed common emotions that children experience, such as happiness, sadness, anger, fear, and calmness. We also read a book about feelings and explained how each emotion affects us differently, providing examples for the children. The children have been practicing showing different facial expressions to represent these emotions.

We did a hand painting activity to represent each emotion: yellow for happiness, blue for sadness, green for calmness, red for anger, and black for fear. After painting, the children added cut-out straws to decorate their artwork.

As we continue to explore emotions, we ask for your support in talking to your child about these feelings and helping them understand how to cope when they experience them. Please feel free to reach out if you have any suggestions or activities to share to our children to help them learn more about emotions. We would love to have you in our class!

title: Broken Telephone
description: During Digital Literacy, the children were introduced to fake news and the importance of spreading fake news. To make it more fun and more relatable for the children, we played a game of 'broken telephone' to see what happens when we pass down a dubious/ 'fake' news and how misinformation can get spread.

title: String the Words (Guided Reading Book - At School)
description:
Obj: Use eye-hand coordination to perform tasks. 

This activity reinforces the reading strategy of, “Look at the picture”. It encourages children to look at the picture cues to guess the word. It also introduces children to words and that words have meanings too. Children made good attempts to form a sentence, “I like…” and chose an activity (from the picture-word card) that they like to do at school. They laced the words and pointed at each word to read. Kudos, little ones! :)

title: Playground Fun! 🛝
description:
Obj: Children will be able to explore the equipment at the playground. 

Children had so much fun at the playground and even challenged themselves to climb the mini rock climbing. Playground times also allowed children to have positive social interactions with their friends too! Look at all of them having so much fun! :)

title: East meets West: Impasto VS Batik Painting
description: The children were introduced to famous artists Vincent Van Gogh and Lim Tze Ping and their different art styles. Using art mediums like crayons and water colours, some of the children tried to recreate batik painting. As for children who were inspired by Van Gogh's impasto technique, they used layers of acrylic paint to create their works.

title: 本周动态分享
description: 从本周开始我们开启了情绪的单元，通过不同过的活动来感知认识自己的情绪，我们为幼儿介绍了故事书《我的情绪小怪兽》我们通过故事中的一些有趣的描述帮助幼儿来感知自己的情绪，开心像黄色的阳光，平静像绿色的植物，害怕是黑黑的，伤心像是湿湿的蓝色鱼缸，当你觉得乱乱的时候，可以将不同的颜色分开，我们也准备了一些情绪平息一起进行情绪整理的分类游戏。表情是心情的外显，老师将孩子们不同情绪的图片做成表情板，带领幼儿观察我们体会到的不同的情绪，孩子们会与朋友分享自己的表情板，对比不同的表情。在艺术活动中，我们进行了十分解压的纸条派对，将不同颜色的纸条撕开，贴在自己的身上，就像情绪小怪兽一样，身上有着不同的颜色，我们随着音乐舞动纸条，尽情的探索自己的情绪。来看看我们的精彩瞬间吧！

The mastermind will inform the children if they had the correct coloured tape on the correct positions.

Unfortunately... the clay did not stick as intended, but the children were open-minded with the teacher gluing the parts together. -- A pointer for us to take note when using clay next time!

title: Numicons: What does the number word represent?
description:
The children were introduced to number words 11 - 15, and were asked to use the numicon shapes to represent the value of the number words. As they get used to the game, the children were challenged to create two ways to form the value instead! 

Let's just say, they are up for the challenge! :-)

title: Scooping Challenge
description: In this activity, the children were invited to use a variety of tools to scoop different types of circular objects, such as pom poms, ping pong balls, and heavier stones, all floating in water. The goal of the activity was to foster hand-eye coordination as the children tracked the movement of the objects in the water. Additionally, it aimed to enhance fine motor skills as the children carefully scooped the objects using spoons, or bigger shovels, and then poured them into cups. This activity encouraged focus and precision, as the children had to adjust their grip and control to manage the varying weights and sizes of the objects. By engaging in this hands-on, sensory-rich task, it fosters both their motor skills and an understanding of how different objects behave in water, all while having fun experimenting with the tools and objects.

title: Thinker's Box
description: Here are some pictures of the children exploring during 'Thinker's Box' this week!

title: Wriggly Earthworms!
description:
As part of our ongoing exploration of creepy crawlies, we created our very own wriggly worms! We began by sharing our knowledge about earthworms, discussing their small size, where they live underground, and how they move in a "wriggly" way.

To bring our worms to life, we used brown pipe cleaners for their bodies. Carefully threading colourful beads onto the pipe cleaner, we practised our fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Once we were happy with our colour arrangements and the number of beads used, we bent the pipe cleaners into shape, making them look just like real wriggly worms!

title: Beautiful Dragonflies!
description:
Previously, we explored wriggly earthworms that squirm and wriggle on the ground. This time, we turned our attention to a creepy-crawly with wings that can fly! It also has a long, slender body. Can you guess what it is? A dragonfly!

To create our dragonflies, we worked on two separate parts—the wings and the body. For the wings, we experimented with a new technique. Using coloured markers, we carefully decorated filter paper with vibrant patterns. Once we were happy with our designs, we added drops of water and watched in amazement as the colours bled and spread, creating a beautiful, psychedelic effect. Our teacher then helped us cut out the wing shapes.

For the body, we used ice cream sticks. After selecting our preferred yarn colours, we carefully wrapped the yarn around the stick. Though it seemed like a simple task, it required a great deal of focus, concentration, and coordination to wrap the yarn neatly and securely.

With both parts complete, all that was left was to put them together—bringing our stunning dragonflies to life!

title: T1W10 Album: Chasing Teddy
description:
**OBJECTIVE:**
- The children caught an item by moving their arms or bodies to adjust for the direction in which the item was travelling.

- The children used sight words like "I", "my", and "am" to form complete sentences and introduce themselves.


**ACTIVITY:**
**Chase Teddy**

1. The teacher role-played with the children by holding and looking at a toy (e.g., Teddy) and saying, “Hello, Teddy, my name is ___.” The teacher then passed the toy to the child, moving counterclockwise. The child who received the toy said “thank you” to the one who passed it to them.
2. The child who received the toy looked at Teddy and said, “Hello, Teddy, my name is ___,” before passing the toy to the next child.
3. This process continued until every child had introduced themselves to Teddy.
4. The children were then encouraged to pass the toy around the circle quickly. When the children started to have fun, a second toy (e.g., Rabbit) was introduced with the statement, “Teddy is going to chase Rabbit around the circle, so let’s help Rabbit run quickly.”
5. The teacher reminded the children, “Don’t drop Teddy/Rabbit. We don’t want them to get hurt.”

This activity was conducted on 10th March 2025.

title: 如果你变成....,我就变成....。

title: 高和矮

title: Ribbon Race
description: The children participated in a ribbon race, where they were invited to arrange ribbons of different lengths in order. They first observed the varying lengths and learned how to sequence them, ensuring that one end of each ribbon aligned with the others. After this, they excitedly raced to pick a ribbon and compared its length with their peers, and arranged the ribbons in order from shortest to longest.

title: Green Bean Planting
description: Following the story Titch by Pat Hutchins, the children engaged in a green bean planting activity to deepen their understanding of growth and change over time. At the start of the week, they carefully planted green beans in cups filled with cotton wool and watered them. Over the following days, they took responsibility for caring for their plants, closely observing changes, and discussing what they noticed about the growing beans using magnifying glasses. The children were then encouraged to record their observations in their journals, capturing the transformation of their plants.

title: Tower Building
description: The children explored building towers using Unifix cubes, strengthening their fine motor skills as they carefully joined the cubes to construct tall structures. Once their towers were built, they placed them side by side to compare heights and engaged in discussions about the differences. They were encouraged to arrange their towers from shortest to tallest. Additionally, they were provided with cardboard tubes to experiment with stacking, adding an extra challenge to their tower-building exploration.

title: Term 1 Week 8 Weekly Highlight
description:
n this activity, the class engaged in a hands-on exploration of an array of ribbons, each with a different width. They began by examining the ribbons closely, discussing their unique characteristics and comparing their sizes. Working collaboratively in pairs, the students practiced sorting by arranging the ribbons from the thinnest to the thickest. This exercise not only enhanced their observational skills but also deepened their understanding of measurement and comparison.
After the sorting activity, the class came together to create a shared piece of art. Each pair contributed by gluing their arranged ribbons onto a large sheet of paper in the correct order. Once all the ribbons were in place, the class added a creative twist by painting over the ribbons with mixed shades, transforming the sorted ribbons into a vibrant, collective artwork.

title: Term 1 Week 10: Animal Race Parade
description:
Objectives:
1) Children will practice organising objects based on their position in a sequence, developing an understanding of order through play. 
2) Children will use precise hand movements to handle small objects with control and care. 


The children were given small animal figurines and a racetrack template. They took turns rolling a virtual die to move their figurines along the track. Once all the animals have crossed the finish line, the children then determine the positions (e.g., 1st, 2nd, 3rd) based on the order they finish. It was also emphasized to the children the importance of taking turns, celebrating achievements, and showing appreciation for the group effort to make this activity an enjoyable and learning through play.

title: March Week 2 Weekly Highlight: Fruity Pom Pom Sorting
description:
Learning objective: Develop beginning understanding of basic Numeracy concepts by likeness and differences in size, shape, texture etc. 

This week, our little ones had a blast with a colourful pom-pom sorting activity! They were provided with bottles labelled with pictures of fruits —grape, orange, pear, and apple—and was invited to find pom-poms that matched the fruit’s colour. We mixed in a few pom-poms of different colours, encouraging them to focus and pick out only the matching ones. With eager little hands pushing pom-poms through the bottle openings, they practiced noticing similarities and differences while strengthening their fine motor skills. Well done our dear little fruit sorters!

title: 每周活动分享
description:
尊敬的家长您好，这一周是我们家庭主题探索的第二周。这一周教师和幼儿一起分享了家庭照片，在教师的引导下幼儿在同伴面前指认自己的家庭成员，同时也学习认出同伴的家庭成员。为了契合我们的活动，在美工活动当中，幼儿给爸爸做了个领带。 活动中幼儿在领带的形状上面自由涂色，然后练习幼儿手指肌肉的灵活性，让幼儿把小贴纸粘贴在领带上面做装饰，最后幼儿用胶水把领带图形粘贴在背景纸上以及贴上爸爸的照片。 
星期一幼儿上了一节音乐律动课，活动当中教师利用纱巾和摇铃跟跟随音乐来做律动。纱巾是幼儿喜欢的一个音乐器材，他们喜欢跟随着音乐挥舞手中的纱巾，幼儿还模仿音乐老师的动作转动自己的身体。Thinking Box 的脑力思维训练中，老师们和幼儿一起玩颜色的配对游戏。以及听指令把不同颜色的球放进指定的框里面。从幼儿的反应来看，幼儿开始有了颜色配对的概念，他们能够把一样颜色的物品放在一起。
游乐场探索中，幼儿选择自己喜欢的器材和玩具进行探索。 一些幼儿和教师一起做踢球的游戏，从幼儿玩球的过程当中可以看得出来，幼儿能够一边小跑一边做出踢球的状态，有的孩子能够在立定的状态下做出踢球的动作，可见幼儿身体的协调性和空间感知能力有了很大的进步。
除此之外，我们一起学习了儿歌《手指家庭》，通过手指谣的儿歌韵律，让幼儿能够学习模仿说出家庭里面的成员，例如：爸爸，妈妈，哥哥，妹妹和宝宝的词语。图书角落我们提供了很多关于家庭成员的书本，鼓励幼儿在图书角进行自我阅读以及师生共读，培养幼儿从小爱读书的习惯。

教师为幼儿营造故事情景，我们的小松鼠喜欢吃松果，但是现在松果散落在森林的各个地方，想要请小朋友来帮助小松鼠将松果带回家。

title: weekly update
description:
This week, the little ones were introduced to basic shapes such as squares, circles, and triangles, and they had fun exploring these shapes with paper cutouts. As they engaged with the paper shapes, some children even matched identical shapes together!

To extend their learning, the children were encouraged to create a house using the paper shapes, fostering creativity and shape recognition.

Additionally, the children had a blast jumping and moving with scarves while listening to the song “Jump” by Patty Shukla. You can find the song on YouTube, and we encourage you to dance along at home with your little ones!

In another exciting activity, the children took part in a simple flower experiment, where they dyed white flowers. Later in the afternoon, they observed the flowers closely and noticed that some of the petals were changing color. The children were so excited about this discovery that they brought their flowers home to share with you.

Happy weekend!

title: Dump Truck Craft Part 1

This will be the background of their dump truck artwork!

title: SRT Play - Emperor's New Clothes
description:
We enjoyed a fresh and fashionable twist on the classic Hans Christian Andersen tale, The Emperor’s New Clothes, designed to entertain both children and parents alike!

In this delightful retelling, we followed Millie, a talented young fashion designer with big dreams. When Arnold Wintor, the powerful and ego-driven editor of Emperor Magazine, attempts to take over Millie’s fashion label, Threads, she cleverly turns the tables. Through creativity, courage, and quick thinking, Millie reminds everyone that even the most powerful can be humbled.

As part of our post-play debrief, we had meaningful conversations with the children about the story’s key message — that what truly matters is what’s on the inside, such as our character, kindness, and values, rather than appearances or clothing. This important lesson in character building was a highlight of our reflection.

For those curious, rest assured that during the humorous “no clothes” scene, the actor was indeed wearing shorts!

title: Term 1 Week 10: Number Name Mosaic
description:
Learning Objectives: 

• Match up to 20 or more: Number names with quantity

This week, our children engaged in a fun and creative math activity called the Number Name Mosaic. Each child received a strip of paper and coloured tiles where the children focused on designing their own individual mosaics.

During the activity, the teacher called out or showed a number name (e.g., “sixteen”), and the children counted and placed the corresponding number of tiles onto their strip. To reinforce their learning, they also wrote down the number name and numeral on their mosaic.

Through this process, the children had the opportunity to express their individuality by choosing colours and patterns that reflect their personal preferences or cultural experiences — a wonderful way to build both math skills and self-identity.

title: 🐝🦋 Final Phase: Creepy Crawlies Exploration Wrap-Up! 🌿🐜
description:
What an incredible journey we’ve had exploring the world of creepy crawlies! Over the past two months, the children have immersed themselves in the fascinating lives of insects, learning about their habitats, behaviours, and how they contribute to our environment. 

To cap off our exploration, we’ve transformed our dramatic play corner into a bee hive! 🐝 The children have eagerly embraced the role of beekeepers, using their imagination to act out the process of extracting honey from the hive. They’ve been working together, pretending to care for the bees, collect the honey, and learn about the vital role bees play in pollination.

This final phase has allowed the children to apply their learning in a creative way, reinforcing their understanding of the natural world while also developing their social and problem-solving skills. What a wonderful way to conclude our creepy crawly exploration; through play, teamwork, and a whole lot of buzzing excitement!

We are excited to anticipate on the next adventure coming our way!

description: As a conclusion to their Term 1 learning on "Who Am I", the children were invited to create artworks or booklets portraying interesting facts about themselves, such as their likes and dislikes, their families, and anything they were keen on sharing. During their show and tell session, the children presented their masterpieces to their friends and teachers, talking about all the things that they liked or did not like. The children in the audience also had opportunities to ask questions about their friends' sharing!

description: Mathstro

title: 水中的玩具：
description: 沉浮在水中的玩具让好奇的幼儿不停地玩着，游戏通过自由探索（水、不同材质、玩水等），发展了幼儿对于物质属性的认识。

title: 玩丝巾
description: 幼儿十分开心地地拉扯和触摸丝巾，活动提供轻柔、适宜的材料，以促进幼儿触觉能力的发展。

title: 本周动态分享
description: 通过两周的学习和探索，我们在幼儿的游戏和日常活动中越来越观察到幼儿们关照他人情绪，处理自己的情绪的行为，孩子们会很敏感的发现同伴的情绪变化，孩子们会围在一起，用言语和拥抱安慰同伴，用自己的方式为朋友提供情绪上的支持。在早上的时间，我们会在签到的时候让幼儿们分享自己的情绪，教师很惊奇的发现幼儿对自己的情绪有着很准确的体会，特别是对平静和开心这两种心情的体会中，这是自我认知方面很强的能力体现。在本周我们同样设置了促进幼儿肌肉发展气球和滴管游戏，不管是用脚踢气球还是用头撞气球都很好的促进了大肌肉和空间感知里的发展，滴管和水更是孩子们最爱的游戏，这种简单工具的使用会促进幼儿的手眼协调和对物理规律的思考和探索。来看看我们的精彩瞬间！

title: 音乐活动——《我长大了》
description:
为了引导小朋友们学习长大后自己能够做到哪些力所能及的事情，以及培养小朋友对音乐的感知能力，所以我们开展了本次的活动。活动中老师先播放儿歌《我长大了》https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T87mXejuR2c
请小朋友们聆听，然后再逐句的去解释歌词的含义。接下来老师邀请小朋友们一边听儿歌一边思考应该根据歌词含义去做出怎样的动作，大家纷纷想出不同的动作然后我们大家一起去模仿做出相应的动作。
活动最后，老师也邀请小朋友们展开探讨，自己长大了可以做到哪些事情呢？具体分享内容请各位家长查看下面照片中的记录噢！

title: T1W10活动
description:
这周是本学期的最后一周，我们完成了两本绘本故事的学习，一本早期阅读《毛毛虫》的听、说、读、写的活动。小朋友们大概总结了一下这学期学过的内容，玩了一些角落活动材料，并完成了小书《创意逃家小兔》和《毛毛虫》的制作。
        此外，小朋友们在这周的音乐课上，学习认读音符，并听音乐，用音符排列出节奏规律。

title: 数学游戏（加法）
description:
为了培养小朋友的数学技能，了解数与数相加的计算方式，所以我们开展了本次的活动。活动中老师为小朋友们准备了呼啦圈、乐高、铃鼓。游戏规则是老师摇晃铃鼓，当停止摇晃铃鼓时小朋友们需要快速的跳进前方的呼啦圈中，然后聆听老师说出的数字，小朋友们根据所听到的数字内容去拿取相应数量的乐高放进自己的呼啦圈里，放好后进行一对一的数数，数完后报数再从呼啦圈里退出来。接下来小朋友们重复上述的游戏过程，这时需要去计算第一次的数量与第二次的数量相加后的结果是什么。例如：第一次拿了五个乐高，第二次拿了两个乐高，那么一共有几个乐高？

通过本次活动的过程小朋友们对数字相加的概念有了更多的理解。

title: ThinkersBox
description: In this ThinkersBox session, the children were given pipe cleaners and encouraged to explore their creativity by bending, twisting, and shaping them into various forms. From vibrant flowers to fun bubble blowers and even colorful bracelets, the children demonstrated impressive imagination and fine motor skills. Alongside this hands-on activity, they were also invited to challenge their observation skills by looking at two pictures and spotting the differences between them.

title: 团体意识——拔萝卜
description: 为了培养小朋友们的团体意识，了解同伴合作的力量所以我们开展了本次的活动。活动中老师先为小朋友们播放拔萝卜这首儿歌的短片，请大家观察老爷爷一开始拔起萝卜了吗？为什么拔不起来呢？后来为什么能够拔起来了呢？小朋友分享到：“老爷爷没有拔起来，因为萝卜太大了，很重。后面有很多小动物来帮忙所以萝卜被扒出来了。”于是老师总结到，很多时候我们自己一个人没有办法做到的事情，需要朋友的帮忙才可以做到，这就是合作的力量。随后老师邀请小朋友分组来玩拔萝卜（拔河）的游戏，通过这个过程去感受同伴一起合作的力量。这个过程中大家玩得很开心！

title: 户外玩乐
description: 小朋友们期待已久的户外场地，终于可以半开放去玩耍了，在玩乐之前老师先介绍了安全须知，例如：地面不再是以前光滑的地面，现在更粗糙所以在奔跑或是地上爬行的时候都要更小心。老师也邀请大家观察户外游乐场攀爬的区域，请小朋友们分享自己在玩的时候应该注意什么事情？大家分享到：“不要跳、不要把手、头放进洞里、不要在上面跑。”老师赞扬小朋友们都分享得很棒，也知道如何更好的去保护自己的安全与健康，接下来大家便开始快乐的玩耍了！❤️

title: English Speech and Drama
description: In this week's Speech and Drama session, the children began by revisiting the story We're Going on a Bear Hunt, using dramatisation to bring the adventure to life. Afterward, they read a poem and storybook about 'Daddy,' exploring themes of love and appreciation. Then, the children entered drama land, where they dramatised the creative process of making special gifts for their daddies. Through role-play and imagination, they expressed their gratitude and affection, making this session a fun and meaningful experience!

title: Decorating Our Binoculars
description: In this activity, the children decorated their binoculars in different ways. Some used crayons and coloured markers to draw lines, while others pasted torn pieces of coloured square paper, and a few added shape stickers. This hands-on activity not only encouraged creativity but also exposed the children to basic elements of art, all while helping to hone their fine motor skills through peeling, tearing, pasting, and drawing!

title: Outdoor Walk with Our Binoculars
description: The children put their binocular crafts to great use, which they had decorated earlier. As they explored the surroundings, they were invited to spot different types of vehicles, observe people going about their day, and identify birds perching on tree branches. The children also had fun spotting buildings, cranes from a nearby construction site, and even the iconic Merlion! Through this activity, the children developed their observation and concentration skills, while also enhancing their vocabulary by naming what they saw. The walk also provided an opportunity to strengthen their hand-eye coordination as they used their binoculars to focus on distant objects.

title: 会动的毛毛虫分享
description: 小朋友们在园所内和朋友们展示了自己和爸爸妈妈一起进行亲子活动《会动的毛毛虫》的照片，老师引导小朋友和朋友们分享自己是如何制作的，谁和自己一起完成了作品。通过分享，小朋友们不仅展示了自己的作品和动手能力，也在互动中培养了自信心和成就感。感谢家长们积极提供和分享照片，大家的参与让这个活动更加丰富和有意义。希望未来能够收到更多家长和小朋友们的分享，让我们的活动更加多彩！

title: 第一学期第十周照片上传
description:
Hi 家长们好！

本周幼儿们继续分享自己的家庭照片及亲子活动，并能在老师的展示板旁边与同伴一起欣赏观看及再次分享自己的亲子活动。可以看出幼儿在分享展示的过程中满脸的自豪感及满足感，促进了幼儿们的华文口语表达能力。

为了表达对家人尤其是妈妈的爱，我们组织了这次的面点创作---制作爱心饼干，幼儿们在制作的过程中能积极的参与活动，并能尝试拿着面团进行捏、撮、揉及使用擀面杖进行擀出较薄的面饼，然后选择喜欢的摸具进行按压制作出小饼干。当用烤箱烤出香喷喷的饼干后，幼儿们可开心了，每个幼儿们都有品尝到自己制作出的饼干，还把饼干带回家送给自己亲爱的妈妈及家人品尝。通过此活动不仅让幼儿们学习了烘培技能，还在实际操作中提升了动手的能力，认识和使用了厨房工具。最终带着满满的爱回家与家人分享。幼儿们好棒呀！

幼儿们在早期阅读角落中逐渐的能进行自主游戏，发现他们逐渐对华文字熟悉起来。

二楼户外种植的番茄已经果实了！幼儿们看到不同颜色的果实非常的好奇，在老师的引导下尝试进行观察及了解为什么是不一样的颜色，幼儿在探索探究自然方面有很大进步。

title: Collaborative Process Art: Roll Painting
description: In this activity, the children were invited to engage in a collaborative process art experience inspired by our theme, My Friends and I. Working in pairs, they were encouraged to move a painting box back and forth between them, fostering teamwork and coordination. As they worked together to shift the box, the movement naturally guided the paint inside, and result in the rolling of the egg shakers used, creating unique and dynamic artwork. This activity not only nurtured their creativity but also fostered cooperation through shared experiences.

title: Making Flower Bouquets
description: To encourage meaningful interactions among the children, they were invited to participate in a collaborative play experience, using flowers and flower pots to create friendship bouquets. In this activity, each child contributed a flower, planting it together in a shared pot. As they worked side by side, they navigated the shared space, and took turns, naturally fostering cooperation and social connections. As the children add each flower into the pot, they are also guided with counting to introduce early numeracy through play experiences.

title: 一起学跨栏
description: 幼儿们一起做动物模仿操热身。幼儿们化身可爱的小象伸长手臂低头走；化身高高的长颈鹿抬起手臂踮脚走路；化身小螃蟹伸长手臂横着走。热身运动结束后，老师带领幼儿认识新朋友“栏杆”。幼儿们尝试抬起脚，尝试跨过栏杆。看，他们解锁了新的技能跨栏，分享给你们🤗他们可爱的样子。

title: 对折画——蝴蝶
description: 在活动《对折画——蝴蝶》中，老师首先鼓励小朋友们仔细观察蝴蝶模型的翅膀，帮助他们发现蝴蝶翅膀色彩丰富、图案对称的特点。接着，老师引导小朋友们利用对折画的创作方式，让每个孩子都能亲手制作出独一无二的蝴蝶翅膀。小朋友们自由选择自己喜欢的颜料和图案，发挥想象力和创造力，通过对折画的技巧呈现出对称而充满色彩的蝴蝶翅膀。完成翅膀的创作后，小朋友们为蝴蝶贴上身体和眼睛，将自己的作品完整呈现出来。这一过程不仅锻炼了小朋友们的动手能力，还激发了他们的观察力与艺术创作潜力。

title: Reach for the stars
description: Children practised their jumping skills to reach for the star-shaped cutouts that were pasted at the wall at different heights. They took turns to jump and touch as many stars as they could.

title: 夹出毛毛虫
description: 老师首先向小朋友们展示了一个“钻”满“毛毛虫”的纸盒。每只毛毛虫都藏在纸盒的小洞里，孩子们需要用镊子小心翼翼地夹出每一只毛毛虫。老师引导幼儿集中注意力，练习手部的精细动作，帮助他们掌握正确的夹取方法。孩子们需要把纸盒中的所有毛毛虫夹出来。随着活动的进行，孩子们不断挑战自己的耐心和手眼协调能力，享受着每次成功夹出毛毛虫的成就感。最后，当所有毛毛虫都成功夹出后，活动结束，孩子们纷纷展示自己夹出来的“毛毛虫”，分享自己的快乐与心得。这个活动不仅锻炼了幼儿的手部精细动作、注意力集中和协调能力，还提高了他们的耐心和自信心。

title: Rote Counting 1-10
description: Children practised rote counting from 1 to 10 by engaging in activities, such as jumping and counting in sequence on the colourful mats labelled 1 to 10, and participating in a counting relay game with their peers.

title: Let's Crawl Like Ants!
description:
In this activity, we explored ants—tiny, hardworking insects found almost everywhere. We observed that ants are rarely seen alone; they usually move in groups, often walking in a line, and live underground in tunnels.

To reinforce this learning, we were given a tunnel and imagined ourselves as ants, crawling through it just as they would in their underground homes. We were thrilled by the experience and eagerly rushed back to the entrance after making our way through. However, this excitement sometimes led to a traffic jam at the entrance! This turned into a valuable learning moment, teaching us not only about the incredible teamwork ants have but also the importance of patience. By waiting our turn, we helped ensure a smooth and efficient flow through the tunnel—just like how ants navigate their intricate pathways with coordination and order.

title: Sharpening Our Thinking Skills with ThinkerBox
description:
In this ThinkerBox session, we engaged our logical thinking and keen observation skills as we tackled the activities prepared for us. One task challenged us to compare two seemingly identical pictures and identify subtle differences. For example, we examined two images of bicycles and carefully spotted the variations between them.

In another activity, we worked with pipe cleaners, bending and shaping them to match specific forms shown to us. This hands-on task not only encouraged creativity but also helped strengthen our focus, concentration, and fine motor control. Through these activities, we honed our ability to observe, analyse, and manipulate materials with precision.

title: Our Calm Down Kit Show & Tell
description: The children did a show and tell of their calm down kits for their peers to use in school. Children did a showcase of the items in the kits, and taught their peers how to use the item(s) found in them.

title: Creating Our Own Ants
description:
As we continued our exploration of ants, we took a closer look at their physical attributes. Ants, as we know, are tiny yet hardworking insects found almost everywhere. Using a toy ant as a model, we learned that they have three main body parts—the head, thorax, and abdomen—along with six legs and two antennae.

To bring our learning to life, we created our own ants using egg cartons. We carefully used three sections instead of one or two to ensure our ants had all their proper body parts. For decoration, we used coloured markers to add dots, lines, and patches, making each ant unique and personal.

Next, we attached small strips of black paper to represent the legs. While some of us demonstrated excellent spatial awareness by placing the legs accurately, others found it tricky, leading to some legs being clustered together or even stuck on top of the body! Regardless of the results, this creative activity helped us refine our fine motor skills and deepen our understanding of an ant’s structure in a fun and engaging way.

title: Field Trip to Gardens by the Bay
description: In line with what we have been covering in Term 1, we brought our children to walk around the garden. Children also shared about their feelings and experiences along the way.

title: 三月 第一周：镜子里的我
description:
活动目标：
1.通过镜子观察自己，帮助幼儿建立自我认知和自我认同感。
2.鼓励幼儿用“我”来表达自己，提高语言表达能力。

活动介绍：
通过让幼儿照镜子观察自己的样子，鼓励他们用“我”来表达自己，如“这是我！”“我是叫睿言” “她是Riva”.并模仿不同的表情（如微笑、皱眉等），帮助他们建立自我认知和自我认同感。教师还与幼儿进行语言互动，如：“你叫什么名字？”“你的眼睛在哪里？”“你笑起来是什么样子的？”引导他们用语言描述自己的特征和情绪。这不仅能提升孩子的语言表达能力，还能增强他们对自我和情绪的理解，让他们更加自信地认识和表达自己。



此活动于星期四完成。
